psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፩ - ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኢሖረ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ረሲዓን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 1 - Blessed is the Man
psalms.heading: ፍካሬ ፡ ዘጻድቃን ፡ ወዘኃጥኣን ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኢሖረ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ረሲዓን 
ወዘኢቆመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
ወዘኢነበረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መስተሳልቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

verses.textGeez:
ዘዳእሙ ፡ ሕገ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሥምረቱ 
ወዘሕጎ ፡ ያነብብ ፡ መዕልተ ፡ ወሌሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

verses.textGeez:
ወይከውን ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትክልት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙሓዘ ፡ ማይ 
እንተ ፡ ትሁብ ፡ ፍሬሃ ፡ በበጊዜሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

verses.textGeez:
ወቈጽላኒ ፡ ኢይትነገፍ 
ወኵሎ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ይፌጽም ።
verses.textEnglish: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

verses.textGeez:
አኮ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ኃጥኣንሰ ፡ አኮ ፡ ከመዝ 
ዳእሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሬት ፡ ዘይግሕፍ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእንተዝ ፡ ኢይትነሥኡ ፡ ረሲዓን ፡ እምደይን 
ወኢኃጥኣን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ያአምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፍኖቶሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን 
ወፍኖቶሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ ትጠፍእ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ስምከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፪ - ለምንት ፡ አንገለጉ ፡ አሕዛብ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 2 - Why Do the Nations Rage
psalms.heading: ትንቢት ፡ እንበይነ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወጽውዐ ፡ አሕዛብ ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ አንገለጉ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወሕዘብኒ ፡ ነበቡ ፡ ከንቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

verses.textGeez:
ወተንሥኡ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር 
ወመላእክትኒ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ኅብረ 
ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ መሲሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,

verses.textGeez:
ንበትክ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ መኣሥሪሆሙ 
ወንገድፍ ፡ እምላዕሌነ ፡ አርዑቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ይሥሕቆሙ 
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሳለቅ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ ይነቦሙ ፡ በመዐቱ ወበመዐቱ ፡ የሀውኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ተሠየምኩ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ 
በጽዮን ፡ በደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ እንግር ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይቤለኒ ፡ ወልዱየ ፡ እንተ 
ወአነ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወለድኩከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

verses.textGeez:
ሰአል ፡ እምነየ ፡ ወእሁብከ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ለርስትከ 
ወምኵናኒከኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.textGeez:
ወትሬዕዮሙ ፡ በበትረ ፡ ኀጺን 
ወከመ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ለብሓ ፡ ትቀጠቅጦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

verses.textGeez:
ወይእዜኒ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ለብዉ 
ወተገሠጹ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትኬንንዋ ፡ ለምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ተቀነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በፍርሀት 
ወተሐሠዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በረዐድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.textGeez:
አጽንዕዋ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትመዓዕ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ወኢትትሐጐሉ ፡ እምፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ ነደት ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ መዐቱ ብፁዓን ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፫ - አግዚኦ ፡ ሚበዝኁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፫ (3) - አቤቱ ፥ የሚያስጨንቁኝ፡ምንኛ፡በዙ! በእኔ፡ላይ፡የሚቆሙት፡ብዙ፡ናቸው
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 3 - The Lord Helps His People
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘአመ ፡ ጐየ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ አቤሰሎም ።

verses.textGeez:
አግዚኦ ፡ ሚበዝኁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ 
ብዙኃን ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኃን ፡ ይቤልዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ኢያድኅነኪ ፡ አምላክኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
አንተሰ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ምስካይየ ፡ አንተ 
ክብርየ ፡ ወመልዕለ ፡ ርእስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

verses.textGeez:
ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸራኅኩ 
ወሰምዐኒ ፡ እምደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ ሰከብኩ ፡ ወኖምኩ 
ወተንሣእኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አንሥአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይፈርህ ፡ እምአእላፍ ፡ አሕዛብ 
እለ ፡ ዐገቱኒ ፡ ወቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወአድኅነኒ 
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ቀሠፍኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፃረሩኒ ፡ በከንቱ ።
ስነኒሆሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ ሰበርከ ።
verses.textAmharic: ተነሥ ፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አድነኝ አንተ፡የጠላቶቼን፡መንጋጋ፡መትተኻልና ፥ የክፉዎችንም፡ጥርስ፡ሰብረኻ ልና።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.textGeez: ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አድኅኖ ወላዕለ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ በረከትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፬ - ሶበ ፡ ጸዋዕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ ጽድቅየ ፡ወእምንዳቤየ...
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፬ (4) - የጽድቄ፡አምላክ፡በጠራኹት፡ጊዜ፡መለሰልኝ ፥ በጭንቀቴም፡አሰፋኽልኝ ማረኝ...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 4 - Answer Me When I Call
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘአኩቴት ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ ጸዋዕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ ጽድቅየ ፡ወእምንዳቤየ ፡ አርሐበ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.textGeez: ተሥሀለኒ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ታከብዱ ፡ ልብክሙ ፡
ለምንት ፡ ታፈቅሩ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ወተኀሡ ፡ ሐሰተ ።
verses.textEnglish: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.

verses.textGeez:
ኣእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በጻድቁ 
እግዚአብሔር፡ ይሰምዐኒ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተምዑ ፡ ወኢተአብሱ 
ወዘትሔልዩ ፡ በልብክሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መስካቢክሙ ፡ ይትዐወቀክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ሡዑ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ወተወከሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኃን ፡ እለ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ መኑ ፡ ያርእየነ ፡ ሠናይቶ 
ተዐውቀ ፡ በላዕሌነ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

verses.textGeez:
ወወደይከ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብነ 
እምፍሬ ፡ ስርናይ ፡ ወወይን ፡ ወቅብእ ፡ በዝኃ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

verses.textGeez: በሰላም ፡ ቦቱ ፡ እሰክብ ፡ ወእነውም ።
verses.textEnglish: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ እንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በተስፋ ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ኣኅደርከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፭ - ቃልየ ፡ አፅምእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወለቡ ፡ ጽራኅየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፭ (5) - አቤቱ ፥ ቃሌን፡አድምጥ ፥ ጩኸቴንም፡አስተውል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 5 - Give Ear to My Words, O Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ተወርሶ ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት

verses.textGeez: ቃልየ ፡ አፅምእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወለቡ ፡ ጽራኅየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

verses.textGeez: ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ንጉሥየኒ ፡ ወአምላክየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ እጼሊ ።
እግዚኦ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ቃልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

verses.textGeez: በጽባሕ ፡እቀውም ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ወኣስተርኢ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢኮንከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ዘዐመፃ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡
ወኢየኀድሩ ፡ እኩያን ፡ ምስሌከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይነብሩ ፡ ዐማፅያን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ፡
ጸላእከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወትገድፎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነቡ ፡ ሐሰተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

verses.textGeez: ብእሴ ፡ ደም ፡ ወጕሕላዌ ፡ ይስቆርር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ እበውእ ፡ ቤተከ 
ወእሰግድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅደስከ ፡ በፍሪሆትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ምርሐኒ ፡ በጽድቅከ 
ወበእንተ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ አርትዕ ፡ ፍኖትየ ፡ ቅድሜከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሆሙ 
ወልቦሙኒ ፡ ከንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ መቃብር ፡ ክሡት ፡ ጐራዒቶሙ 
ወጸልሕዉ ፡ በልሳናቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

verses.textGeez:
ኰንኖሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወይደቁ ፡ በውዴቶሙ 
ወበከመ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ሕብሎሙ ፡ ስድዶሙ 
እስመ ፡ አምረሩከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትፌሥሑ ፡ ብከ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዌከሉከ ፡
ለዓለም ፡ ይትሐሠዩ ፡ ወተኀድር ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
ወይትሜክሑ ፡ ብከ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ያፈቅሩ ፡ ስመከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትባርኮ ፡ ለጻድቅ 
እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወልታ ፡ ሥሙር ፡ ከለልከነ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፮ - እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ ፡ ኢትቅሥፈኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፮ (6) - አቤቱ ፥ በቍጣኽ፡አትቅሠፈኝ ፥ በመዓትኽም፡አትገሥጸኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 6 - O Lord, Rebuke Me Not
psalms.heading: ፍጹሜ ፡ ዘስብሐት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሳምንት ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ ፡ ኢትቅሥፈኒ 
ወበመቅሠፍትከ ፡ ኢትገሥጸኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.textGeez:
ትሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ድውይ ፡ አነ 
ወፈውሰኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተሀውከ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.textGeez:
ወነፍስየኒ ፡ ተሀውከት ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወአንተኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

verses.textGeez:
ተመየጥ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወባልሓ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምሕረትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሞት ፡ ዘይዘከረከ 
ወበሲኦልኒ ፡ መኑ ፡ የአምነከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

verses.textGeez:
ሰራሕኩ ፡ በምንዳቤየ ፡
ወአኀፅብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ዐራትየ 
ወበአንብዕየ ፡ አርሐስኩ ፡ ምስካብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.textGeez:
ወተሀውከት ፡ እመዐት ፡ ዐይንየ 
ወበለይኩ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ረሐቁ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
እስመ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ብካይየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ስእለትየ 
ወተወክፈ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸሎትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

verses.textGeez:
ለይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ለይገብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወፍጡነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፯ - እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክየ ፡ ብከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ወኢትግድፈኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፯ (7) - አቤቱ፡አምላኬ ፥ ባንተ፡ታመንኹ ከሚያሳድዱኝ፡ዅሉ፡አድነኝና፡አውጣኝ ፥
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 7 - In You Do I Take Refuge
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፤ ዘዘመረ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ኩዝ ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሚናዳብ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክየ ፡ ብከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ወኢትግድፈኒ 
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ እምኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ ወባልሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይምስጥዋ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
እንዘ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘያድኅን ፡ ወዘይባልሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክየ ፡ እመሰ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ገበርኩ 
ወእመኒቦ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.textGeez:
ወእመኒ ፡ ፈደይክዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈድዩኒ ፡ እኩየ 
ለያውድቁኒ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ ዕራቅየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

verses.textGeez:
ወይዴግና ፡ ፀራዊ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ወይርከባ 
ወይኪዳ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለሕይወትየ ።
ወያኅስሮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሬት ፡ ለክብርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ 
ወተለዐል ፡ መልዕልቶሙ ፡ ለጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክየ ፡ በሥርዐት ፡ ዘአዘዝከ ።
ወማኅበረ ፡ አሕዛብኒ ፡ የዐውደከ
verses.textEnglish: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

verses.textGeez: ወበእንተዝ ፡ ተመየጥ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

verses.textGeez:
ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ጽድቅከ 
ወይኩነኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ የዋሃትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.textGeez:
የኀልቅ ፡ እከዮሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን 
ወታረትዖሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን 
ይፈትን ፡ ልበ ፡ ወኵልያተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

verses.textGeez:
አማን ፡ ይረድአኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ዘያድኅኖሙ ፡ ለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ መኰንነ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡
ኀያል ፡ ወመስተዐግስ 
ወኢያምጽእ ፡ መንሱተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.textGeez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ኢተመየጥክሙ ፡ ሰይፎ ፡ ይመልኅ 
ቀስቶኒ ፡ ወተረ ፡ ወአስተዳለወ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.textGeez:
ወአስተዳለወ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ሕምዘ ፡ ዘይቀትል 
ወአሕጻሁኒ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነዲ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ሐመ ፡ በዐመፃ 
ፀንሰ ፡ ጻዕረ ፡ ወወለደ ፡ ኃጢአተ ።
verses.textEnglish: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.textGeez:
ግበ ፡ ከረየ ፡ ወደሐየ 
ወይወድቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ፡ ዘገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.textGeez:
ወይገብእ ፡ ጻማሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ 
ወትወርድ ፡ ዐመፃሁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ድማሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ ጽድቁ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፰ - እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ስምክ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 8 - How Majestic is Your Name
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መክብብት ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ተሰብሐ ፡ ስምክ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር
verses.textEnglish: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ተለዐለ ፡ እበየ ፡ ስብሓቲከ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት ።
verses.textEnglish: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.textGeez:
እምአፈ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ወሕፃናት ፡ አስተዳሉከ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡በእንተ ፡ ጸላኢ 
ከመ ፡ ትንሥቶ ፡ ለጸላኢ ፡ ወለገፋዒ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ንሬኢ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ አጻብዒከ 
ወርኀ ፡ ወከዋክብተ ፡ ዘለሊከ ፡ ሳረርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.textGeez:
ምንትኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዝክሮ 
ወምንትኑ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሐውጾ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.textGeez:
ሕቀ ፡ አሕጸጽኮ ፡ እምላእክቲከ 
ክብረ ፡ ወስብሐተ ፡ ከለልኮ ።
ወሢምኮ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እደዊከ
verses.textEnglish: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.textGeez:
ወኵሎ ፡ አግረርከ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገሪሁ ።አባግዐኒ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አልህምተ 
ወዓዲ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ዘገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

verses.textGeez:
አዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይኒ ፡ ወዐሣተ ፡ ባሕር 
ወዘኒ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.textEnglish: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፱ - እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፱ (9) - አቤቱ ፥ በልቤ፡ዅሉ፡አመሰግንኻለኹ ፥ ተኣምራትኽንም፡ዅሉ፡እነግራለኹ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 9 - I Will Give Thanks to the Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኅቡኣተ ፡ ወልድ ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ 
ወእነግር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስብሓቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.textGeez:
እትፌሣሕ ፡ ወእትሐሠይ ፡ ብከ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ገብኡ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ 
ይድወዩ ፡ ወይትሐጐሉ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ፍትሕየ ፡ ወበቀልየ 
ወነበርከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበርከ ፡ መኰንነ ፡ ጽድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

verses.textGeez:
ገሠጽኮሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ወተሐጕሉ ፡ ረሲዓን 
ወደምሰስከ ፡ ስሞሙ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ፀርሰ ፡ ተገምሩ ፡ በኲናት ፡ ለዝሉፍ ።
ወአህጒሪሆሙኒ ፡ ነሠትከ
verses.textEnglish: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

verses.textGeez: ወትስዕር ፡ ዝክሮሙ ፡ ኅቡረ ።ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይነብር ፡ ለዓለም
verses.textEnglish: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.textGeez:
ወአስትዳለወ ፡ መንበሮ ፡ ለኰንኖ ።ወውእቱ ፡ ይኴንና ፡ ለዓለም ፡ በጽድቅ 
ወይኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ በርትዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮኖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስካዮሙ ፡ ለነዳያን 
ወረዳኢሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በጊዜ ፡ ምንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትዌከሉ ፡ ብከ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ያፈቅሩ ፡ ስመከ 
እስመ ፡ ኢተኀድጎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ የኀሡከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.textGeez:
ዘምሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘየኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን 
ወንግርዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ምግባሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተዘክረ ፡ ዘይትኃሠሥ ፡ ደሞሙ 
ወኢረስዐ ፡ ዐውያቶሙ ፡ ለነዳያን ።
verses.textEnglish: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.textGeez: ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወርኢ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ያሐሙኒ ፡ ጸላእትየ
verses.textEnglish: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.textGeez:
ዘያሌዕለኒ ፡ እምአናቅጸ ፡ ሞት ።ከመ ፡ እንግር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስብሓቲከ 
በአናቅጺሃ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ጽዮን
verses.textEnglish: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.textGeez: ወንትፌሣሕ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ።ጠግዑ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ በጌጋዮሙ ፡ ዘገብሩ
verses.textEnglish: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.textGeez: ወበይእቲ ፡ መሥገርት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀብኡ ፡ ተሠግረ ፡ እግሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ያአምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ገቢረ ፡ ፍትሕ ወበግብረ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ተሠግረ ፡ ኃጥእ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

verses.textGeez:
ያግብኡ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ይረስዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አኮ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ፡ ዘይትረሳዕ ፡ ነዳይ 
ወኢያሕጕሉ ፡ ትዕግሥቶሙ ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢይጽናዕ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው 
ወይትኴነኑ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ በቅድሜከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲ - ሢም ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ መምህረ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 10 - In the Lord I Take Refuge

verses.textGeez:
ሢም ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ መምህረ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ 
ወያእምሩ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ከመ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ እሙንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቆምከ ፡ እምርሑቅ 
ወትትዔወር ፡ በጊዜ ፡ ምንዳቤ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

verses.textGeez:
በትዕቢቱ ፡ ለኃጥእ ፡ ይውዒ ፡ ነዳይ 
ወይሠገሩ ፡ በውዴቶሙ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሐለዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ይትዌደስ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ በፍትወተ ፡ ነፍሱ 
ወዐማፂኒ ፡ ይትባረክ ፡
verses.textEnglish: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

verses.textGeez: ወሐኮ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።ወኢተኃሥሦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ መዐቱ
verses.textEnglish: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.textGeez: ወአልቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በቅድሜሁ ።ወርኩስ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊሁ ፡
verses.textEnglish: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

verses.textGeez: ወንሡት ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ወይቀንዮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

verses.textGeez:
ወይብል ፡ በልቡ ፡ ኢይትሀወክ 
ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ኢይረክበኒ ፡ እኩይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

verses.textGeez:
ምሉእ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ መርገመ ፡ ወጽልሑተ 
ወታሕተ ፡ ልሳኑ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ወሕማም ።
verses.textEnglish: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

verses.textGeez:
ወይጸንሕ ፡ ወይንዑ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ብዑላን ፡
ከመ ፡ ይቅትሎ ፡ ለንጹሕ ፡ በጽሚት
verses.textEnglish: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

verses.textGeez: ወአዕይንቲሁኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ያስትሐይጻ ።ይጸንሕ ፡ ወይትኀባእ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ፡
verses.textEnglish: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

verses.textGeez: ወይጸንሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምስጦ ፡ ለነዳይ ወይመስጦ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ ወይስሕቦ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

verses.textGeez: ወያኀስሮ ፡ በመሥገርቱ ።ይትቀጻዕ ፡ ወይወድቅ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ቀነዮ ፡ ለነዳይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

verses.textGeez:
ወይብል ፡ በልቡ ፡ ይረስዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወሜጠ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርአይ ፡ ለግሙራ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክየ ፡ ወትትሌዐል ፡ እዴከ 
ወኢትርስዖሙ ፡ ለነዳያን ።
verses.textEnglish: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተ ፡ ምንት ፡ አምዕዖ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እስመ ፡ ይብል ፡ በልቡ ፡ ኢይትኃሠሠኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.textGeez:
ትሬኢኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ትኔጽር ፡ ጻማ ፡ ወመዐተ 
ወከመ ፡ ትመጥዎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ
verses.textEnglish: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

verses.textGeez: ላዕሌከኑ ፡ እንከ ፡ ተገድፈ ፡ ነዳይ ወአንተኑ ፡ ረዳኢሁ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ።
verses.textEnglish: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.textGeez:
ቀጥቅጥ ፡ መዝራዕቶ ፡ ለኃጥእ ፡ ወለእኩይ 
ወትትኀሠሥ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ ወኢትትረከብ ።
verses.textEnglish: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.textGeez:
ይነግሥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወይትሐጕሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.textGeez:
ፍትወቶሙ ፡ ለነዳያን ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወሕሊና ፡ ልቦሙኒ ፡ አፅምአት ፡ እዝኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.textGeez:
ፍትሑ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ ወለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ 
ከመ ፡ ኢይድግሙ ፡ እንከ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ፡ አዕብዮ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፩ - በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እፎ ፡ ትብልዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 11 - Help, Lord, for the Godly Man Ceases
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እፎ ፡ ትብልዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ተዐይል ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ከመ ፡ ዖፍ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ወሰቁ ፡ ቀስቶሙ ፡
ወአስተዳለው ፡ አሕጻቲሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምጕንጳቶሆሙ 
ከመ ፡ ይንድፍዎ ፡ ለርቱዕ ፡ ልብ ፡ በጽሚት ።
verses.textAmharic: ኀጢአተኛዎች ፥ እንሆ ፥ ቀስታቸውን፡ገትረዋልና ፥ ፍላጻቸውንም፡በአውታር፡አዘጋጅተዋልና ፥ ልበ፡ቅኖችን፡በስው ር፡ይነድፉ፡ዘንድ።
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ዘአንተ ፡ ሠራዕከ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ነሠቱ 
ወጻድቅሰ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅድሱ ፡
እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ መንብሩ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.textGeez: ወአዕይንቲሁኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ይኔጽራ ፡ወቀራንብቲሁኒ ፡ የሐቶ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር፡ የሐቶ ፡ ለጻድቅ ፡ ወለኃጥእ 
ወዘሰ ፡ አፍቀራ ፡ ለዐመፃ ፡ ጸልአ ፡ ነፍሶ ።
verses.textEnglish: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.textGeez:
ይዘንም ፡ መሣግር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
እሳት ፡ ወተይ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ዐውሎ ፡ መክፈልተ ፡ ጽዋዖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጽድቀ ፡ አፍቀረ 
ወለርትዕሰ ፡ ትሬእዮ ፡ ገጹ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

verses.textGeez: ፍጻሜ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ በእንተ ሳምንት ።
verses.textEnglish: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፪ - አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ኄር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፲፪ (12) - አቤቱ ፥ አድነኝ ደግ፡ሰው፡አልቋልና ፥ ከሰው፡ልጆችም፡መተማመን፡ጐድሏልና
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 12 - How Long, O Lord?

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ኄር 
ወውሕደ ፡ ሀይማኖት ፡ እምአጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.textGeez:
ከንቶ ፡ ይትናገሩ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ካልኡ 
በከናፍረ ፡ ጕሕሉት ፡ በልብ ፡ ወበልብ ፡ ይትናገሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

verses.textGeez:
ይሤርዎን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለከናፍረ ፡ ጕሕሉት 
ወለልሳን ፡ እንተ ፡ ታዐቢ ነቢበ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ናዐቢ ፡ ልሳናቲነ ፡ ወከናፍሪነኒ ፡ ኀቤነ ፡ እሙንቱ 
መኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚእነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.textGeez:
በእንተ ፡ ሕማዎሙ ፡ ለነዳያን ፡
ወበእንተ ፡ ገዐሮሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን 
ይእዜ ፡ እትነሣእ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
verses.textEnglish: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

verses.textGeez: እሬሲ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ወእግህድ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃል ፡ ንጹሕ ከመ ብሩር ፡ ጽሩይ ፡ ወንጡፍ ፡ ወፍቱን ፡ እምድር ፡
ዘአጽረይዎ ፡ ምስብዒተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዕቀበነ 
ወተማኅፀነነ ፡ እምዛቲ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

verses.textGeez:
ዐውደ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ረሲዓን 
ወበከመ ፡ ልዕልናከ ፡ ሠራዕኮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፫ - እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትረስዐኒ ፡ ለግሙራ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 13 - The Fool Says There is No God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትረስዐኒ ፡ ለግሙራ ፡
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ትመይጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ኣነብር ፡ ሐዘነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡
ወትጼዕረኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ
verses.textEnglish: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

verses.textGeez: እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ይትዔበዩ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።ነጽረኒ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ
verses.textEnglish: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.textGeez: አብርሆን ፡ ለአዕይንትየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይኑማ ፡ ለመዊት ።ወከመ ፡ ኢይበሉኒ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ ሞእናሁ
verses.textEnglish: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.textGeez: ወእለሰ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ተሀወኩ ።ወአንሰ ፡ በምሕረትከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡
verses.textEnglish: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሐኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ እሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘረድአኒ ፡
ወእዜምር ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፬ - ይብል ፡ አብድ ፡ በልቡ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 14 - Who Shall Dwell on Your Holy Hill?
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: ይብል ፡ አብድ ፡ በልቡ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

verses.textGeez: ኀስሩ ፡ ወረኵሱ ፡ በምግባሪሆሙ አልቦ ፡ ዘይገብራ ፡ ለሠናይት ፡ አልቦ ፡ ወኢአሐዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር፡ ሐወጸ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው 
ከመ ፡ ይርአይ ፡ እመቦ ፡ ጠቢበ ፡ ዘየኀሦ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ዐረየ ፡ ወኅቡረ ፡ ዐለወ 
አልቦ ፡ ዘይገብራ ፡ ለሠናይት ፡ አልቦ ፡ ወኢአሐዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ መቃብር ፡ ክሡት ፡ ጐራዒቶሙ ፡
ወጸልሐዉ ፡ በልሳናቲሆሙ ፡
ሕምዘ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ታሕተ ፡ ከነፍሪሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.textGeez:
መሪር ፡ አፋሆሙ ፡ ወምሉእ ፡ መርገም 
በሊኅ ፡ እገሪሆሙ ፡ ለክዒወ ፡ ደም ።
verses.textEnglish: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

verses.textGeez:
ኀሳር ፡ ወቅጥቃጤ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖቶሙ 
ወኢያአምርዋ ፡ ለፍኖተ ፡ ሰላም ።
ወአልቦ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢያአምሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
እለ ፡ ይውኅጥዎሙ ፡ ለሕዝብየ ፡ ከመ ፡ በሊዐ ፡ እክል ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez:
ወለእግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ኢጸውዕዎ ።
ወበህየ ፡ ፈርሁ ፡ ወገረሞሙ ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ግሩመ
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ጻድቃን ።ወአስተኀፈርክሙ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ነዳይ 
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተስፋሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ እምጽዮን ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
አመ ፡ ሜጠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፄዋ ፡ ሕዝቡ 
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወይትሐሠይ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፭ - እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ይኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽላሎትከ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 15 - Preserve Me, O God
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ይኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽላሎትከ 
ወመኑ ፡ ያጸልል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅድስከ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

verses.textGeez: ዘየሐውር ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ጽድቀ
verses.textEnglish: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

verses.textGeez: ወዘይነብብ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ በልቡ ።ወዘኢጓሕለወ ፡ በልሳኑ ፡
verses.textEnglish: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

verses.textGeez: ወዘኢገብረ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቢጹ ወዘኢያጽአለ ፡ አዝማዲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

verses.textGeez:
ወዘምኑን ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ እኩይ ፡
ወዘያከብሮሙ ፡ ለፈራህያነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይምሕል ፡ ለቢጹ ፡ ወኢይሔሱ ።ወዘኢለቅሐ ፡ ወርቆ ፡ በርዴ ፡
ወዘኢነሥአ ፡ ሕልያነ ፡ በላዕለ ፡ ንጹሕ
verses.textEnglish: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

verses.textGeez: ዘይገብር ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፮ - ለቅዱሳን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ተሰብሐ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሥምረትከ ፡...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 16 - Hear a Just Cause, O Lord
psalms.heading:
ሥርዐተ ፡ አርአያ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ዘዳዊት ።1 ዕቀበኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ። እብሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ አንተ
እስመ ፡ ኢትፈቅዳ ፡ ለሠናይትየ ፡

verses.textGeez: ለቅዱሳን ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ተሰብሐ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሥምረትከ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

verses.textGeez: በዝኀ ፡ ደዌሆሙ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ አስፋጠኑ
verses.textEnglish: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

verses.textGeez: ወኢይትኃበር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅበሮሙ ፡ ዘደም ፡ወኢይዜከር ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ በአፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር፡ መክፈልተ ፡ ርስትየ ፡ ወጽዋዕየ 
አንተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘታገብአ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ርስትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

verses.textGeez:
አሕባለ ፡ ወረው ፡ ሊተ ፡ የአኅዙኒ 
ወርስትየሰ ፡ እኁዝ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

verses.textGeez:
እባርኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአለበወኒ 
ወዐዲ ፡ ሌሊተኒ ፡ ገሠጻኒ ፡ ኵልያትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.textGeez:
ዘልፈ ፡ እሬእዮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ 
እስመ ፡ በየማንየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትሀወክ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተዝ ፡ ተፈሥሐ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወተሐሥየ ፡ ልሳንየ 
ወዐዲ ፡ በተስፋሁ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ሥጋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢተኀድጋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወኢትሁቦ ፡ ለጻድቅከ ፡ ይርአይ ፡ ሙስና ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርአይከኒ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ሕይወት 
ወአጽገብከኒ ፡ ሐሤተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ገጽከ ፡
ወትፍሥሕት ፡ ውስተ ፡ የማንከ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፯ - እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጽድቅየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 17 - The Lord is My Rock
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጽድቅየ ፡
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

verses.textGeez: ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ዘኢኮነ ፡ በከናፍረ ፡ ጕሕሉት ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

verses.textGeez:
እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ ፍትሕየ 
አዕይንትየኒ ፡ ርእያ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.textGeez:
ሐወጽከኒ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ወፈተንኮ ፡ ለልብየ ፡
ወአመከርከኒ ፡ ወኢተረክበ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ በላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይንብብ ፡ አፉየ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡
በእንተ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ከናፍሪከ
verses.textEnglish: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

verses.textGeez:
አነ ፡ ዐቀብኩ ፡ ፍናወ ፡ ዕፁባተ ።አጽንዖን ፡ ለመካይድየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖትከ 
ከመ ፡ ኢይድኀፃ ፡ ሰኰናየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
አፅምእ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ፡ ቃልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሓ ፡ ለምሕረትከ ፡
ዘያድኅኖሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትዌከሉከ 
እምእለ ፡ ይትቃወምዋ ፡ ለየማንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

verses.textGeez:
ዕቀበኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ብንተ ፡ ዐይን 
ወበጽላሎተ ፡ ክንፊከ ፡ ክድነኒ ።
እምገጸ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እለ ፡ ያኀስሩኒ
verses.textEnglish: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

verses.textGeez:
ጸላእትየሰ ፡ አስተሐየጽዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።ወቈጸሩ ፡ አማዑቶሙ 
ወነበበ ፡ ትዕቢተ ፡ አፉሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.textGeez:
ሰደዱኒ ፡ ይእዜኒ ፡ ዐገቱኒ 
ወአትሐቱ ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

verses.textGeez:
ወተመጠዉኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ዘጽኑሕ ፡ ለመሲጥ 
ወከመ ፡ እጓለ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ተኀቢኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥአ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በጽሖሙ ፡ ወአዕቅጾሙ 
ወበልሓ ፡ እምኲናት ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
ሰይፍከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ፀረ ፡ እዴከ
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ እምውኁዳን ፡ ምድር ፡ንፍቆሙ ፡ በሕይወቶሙ 
እምኅቡኣቲከ ፡ ጸግበት ፡ ከርሦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

verses.textGeez: ጸግቡ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ወኀደጉ ፡ ትራፋቲሆሙ ፡ ለሕፃናቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ በጽድቅከ ፡ እሬኢ ፡ ገጸከ 
ወእጸግብ ፡ በርእየ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፰ - ኣፈቅረከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 18 - The Heavens Declare the Glory of God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘዳዊት ። ዘተናገሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በቃለ ፡ ማኅሌት   በዕለተ ፡ አድኅኖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእቱ ፡ ወእምእደ ፡ ሳኦል ፡ ወይቤ ።

verses.textGeez:
ኣፈቅረከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልየ ።
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀይልየ ፡ ወጸወንየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

verses.textGeez: አምላኪየ ፡ ወረዳኢየ ፡ ወእትዌከል ፡ ቦቱ
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡አለቴ ፥ ዐምባዬ ፥ መድኀኒቴ ፥ አምላኬ ፥ በርሱም፡የምተማመንበት፡ረዳቴ ፥ መታመኛዬና፡የደኅንነቴ፡ ቀንድ፡መጠጊያዬም፡ነው።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.textGeez: ምእመንየ ፡ ወቀርነ ፡ ሕይወትየ ፡ ወምስካይየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.textGeez:
እንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ጸዋዕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር እድኅን ፡ እምፀርየ ።5 አኀዘኒ ፡ ጻዕረ ፡ ሞት 
ወውሒዘ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ሆከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐገተኒ ፡ ጻዕረ ፡ ሲኦል 
ወበጽሐኒ ፡ መሣግረ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

verses.textGeez:
ወሶበ ፡ ተመንድብኩ ፡ ጸዋዕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
ወጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰምዐኒ ፡ በጽርሐ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ቃልየ 
ወጽራኅየኒ ፡ ቦአ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዝኒሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.textGeez:
ርዕደት ፡ ወአድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር ፡
ወአንቀልቀሉ ፡ መሰረታተ ፡ አድባር 
ወተሀውኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተምዖሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.textGeez:
ዐርገ ፡ ጢስ ፡ እመዐቱ ፡
ወነደ ፡ እሳት ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ 
ኀተወ ፡ አፍሓም ፡ እምኔሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.textGeez:
አጽነነ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወወረደ 
ወቆባር ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገሪሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.textGeez:
ተጽእነ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኪሩቤል ፡ ወሠረረ 
ወሠረረ ፡ በክንፈ ፡ ነፋስ ።
verses.textEnglish: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰየ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ምስዋር ፡
ወዐውዶሂ ፡ ጽላሎቱ 
ወጸልሙ ፡ ማያት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደመናት ።
verses.textEnglish: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምብርሃነ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ኀለፋ ፡ ደመናት ፡ ቅድሜሁ 
በረድ ፡ ወአፍሓመ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንጐድጐደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በሰማያት ፡
ወልዑል ፡ ወሀበ ፡ ቃሉ
verses.textEnglish: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.textGeez: ፈነወ ፡ አሕፃሁ ፡ ወዘረዎሙ ፡አብዝኀ ፡ መባርቅቲሁ ፡ ወሀኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

verses.textGeez:
ወአስተርአየ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ማያት ፡
ወተከሥተ ፡ መሰረታተ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.textGeez:
እምተግሣጽከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእምእስትንፋሰ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ መዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ እምአርያም ፡ ወነሥአኒ 
ወተመጠወኒ ፡ እማይ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኀነኒ ፡ እምፀርየ ፡ ጽኑዓን 
ወእምጸላእትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይኄይሉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.textGeez:
ወበጽሑኒ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ መንዳቤየ 
ወኮነኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስካይየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅአኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መርሕብ 
ወአድኀነኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይፈቅደኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.textGeez:
የዐስየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ ጽድቅየ 
ወይፈድየኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ እደውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐቀብኩ ፡ ፍናዊሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወኢአበስኩ ፡ ለአምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኵነኔሁ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ውእቱ 
ወጽድቁኒ ፡ ኢርሕቀ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.textGeez:
ወእከውን ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ምስሌሁ 
ወእትዐቀብ ፡ እምኃጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

verses.textGeez:
የዐስየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ ጽድቅየ 
ወይፈድየኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ እደውየ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

verses.textGeez:
ምስለ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ትጸድቅ 
ወምስለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ትከውን ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.textGeez:
ወምስለ ፡ ኅሩይ ፡ ኅሩየ ፡ ትከውን 
ወምስለ ፡ ጠዋይ ፡ ትጠዊ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ታድኅኖ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ትሑት 
ወታኀስሮሙ ፡ ለአዕይንተ ፡ ዕቡያን ።
verses.textEnglish: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ታብርህ ፡ ማኅቶትየ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡
አምላኪየ ፡ ያበርህ ፡ ጽልመትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ብከ ፡ እድኅን ፡ እመንሱት 
ወበአምላኪየ ፡ እትዐደዋ ፡ ለአረፍት ።
verses.textEnglish: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?

verses.textGeez:
ለአምላኪየሰ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ፍኖቱ ።
ቃል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ርሱን 
ወምእመኖሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

verses.textGeez:
ወኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወመኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘያቀንተኒ ፡ ኀይለ 
ወረሰያ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ለፍኖተየ ።
verses.textEnglish: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.textGeez:
ዘያረትዖን ፡ ከመ ፡ ኀየል ፡ ለእገርየ 
ወያቀውመኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መልዕልት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሜህሮን ፡ ፀብአ ፡ ለእደውየ 
ወረሰየ ፡ ቀስተ ፡ ብርት ፡ ለመዝራዕትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበኒ ፡ ምእመነ ፡ ለመድኀኒትየ ።
ወየማንከ ፡ ተወክፈኒ
verses.textEnglish: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.textGeez: ወትምህርትከ ፡ ያጸንዐኒ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።ወተግሣጽከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘይሜህረኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርሐብከ ፡ መካይድየ ፡ በመትሕቴየ 
ወኢደክማ ፡ ሰኩናየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

verses.textGeez:
እዴግኖሙ ፡ ለፀርየ ፡ ወእኅዞሙ 
ወኢይትመየጥ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኣጠፍኦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.textGeez:
ኣመነድቦሙ ፡ ወኢይድክሉ ፡ ቀዊመ 
ወይወድቁ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: They cried, but there was none to save unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

verses.textGeez:
ወታቀንተኒ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ በፀብእ 
አዕቀጽኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ በመትሕቴየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.textGeez:
ወመጠውከኒ ፡ ዘባኖሙ ፡ ለፀርየ 
ወሠረውኮሙ ፡ ለጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.textGeez:
ዐውየዉ ፡ ወኀጥኡ ፡ ዘይረድኦሙ 
ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢሰምዖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

verses.textGeez:
አኀርጾሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጸበል ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ነፋስ 
ወእኪይዶሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽንጕነ ፡ መርሕብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምነቢበ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
ወትሠይመኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ሕዝብ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.textGeez: ሕዝብ ፡ ዘኢያአምር ፡ ተቀንየ ፡ ሊተ ።ውስተ ፡ ምስማዐ ፡ እዝን ፡ ተሠጥዉኒ
verses.textEnglish: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

verses.textGeez: ውሉደ ፡ ነኪር ፡ ሐሰዉኒ ።ውሉደ ፡ ነኪር ፡ በልዩ ወሐንከሱ ፡ በፍኖቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.textGeez:
ሕያው ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወቡሩክ ፡ አምላኪየ 
ወተለዐለ ፡ አምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ ያገብእ ፡ በቀልየ 
ወአግረረ ፡ ሊተ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ በመትሕቴየ ።
ዘይባልሐኒ ፡ እምጸላእትየ ፡ ምንስዋን ፡
verses.textEnglish: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.textGeez: ወዘያሌዕለኒ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ እምብእሲ ፡ ገፋዒ ፡ ባልሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተዝ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
ዘያዐብያ ፡ ለመድኀኒተ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
ወይገብር ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ ለመሲሑ ፡
ለዳዊት ፡ ወለዘርዑ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፲፱ - ሰማያት ፡ ይነግራ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 19 - May the Lord Answer You in Trouble
psalms.heading: ፍጽሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰማያት ፡ ይነግራ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወግብረ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ያየድዓ ፡ ሰማያት ።
verses.textEnglish: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

verses.textGeez:
ዕለት ፡ ለዕለት ፡ ትጐሥዕ ፡ ነቢበ 
ወሌሊት ፡ ለሌሊት ፡ ታየድዕ ፡ ጥበበ ።
verses.textEnglish: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

verses.textGeez: አልቦ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ነቢበ ፡ ዘኢተሰምዐ ፡ ቃሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወፅአ ፡ ነገሮሙ ፡
ወእስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ዓለም ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ነቢቦሙ
verses.textEnglish: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.textGeez: ወውስተ ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ ሤመ ፡ ጽላሎቶ ።ወውእቱሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ መርዓዊ ፡ ዘይወፅእ ፡ እምጽርሑ
verses.textEnglish: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

verses.textGeez: ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይርባሕ ፡ ዘይሜርድ ፡ ፍኖቶ ።እምአጽናፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ሙፅኡ ፡
verses.textEnglish: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.textGeez: ወእስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ምእታዉ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትኀባእ ፡ እምላህቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.textGeez:
ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ወይመይጣ ፡ ለነፍስ 
ስምዑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እሙን ፡ ዘያጠብብ ፡ ሕፃናተ ።
verses.textEnglish: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.textGeez:
ኵነኔሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ወይስተፌሥሕ ፡ ልበ 
ትእዛዙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ብሩህ ፡ ወይበርህ ፡ አዕይንተ ።
verses.textEnglish: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

verses.textGeez:
ፈሪሀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ወየሐዩ ፡ ለዓለም 
ፍትሑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ጽድቅ ወርትዕ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትፈተው ፡ እምወርቅ ፡ ወእምዕንቍ ፡ ክቡር 
ወይጥዕም ፡ እመዓር ፡ ወሶከር ።
verses.textEnglish: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.textGeez:
ወገብርከሰ ፡ የዐቅቦ 
ወበዐቂቦቱ ፡ ይትዐሰይ ፡ ብዙኀ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

verses.textGeez:
ለስሒት ፡ መኑ ፡ ይሌብዋ 
እምኅቡኣትየ ፡ አንጽሐኒ ።
ወእምነኪር ፡ መሐኮ ፡ ለገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

verses.textGeez:
እመሰ ፡ ኢቀነዩኒ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ እከውን 
ወእነጽሕ ፡ እምዐባይ ፡ ኀጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.textGeez:
ወይከውን ፡ ሥሙረ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉየ ፡
ወሕሊና ፡ ልብየኒ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.textGeez: እግዚእየ ፡ ረዳኢየ ፡ ወመድኀንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.textGeez: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳ - ይስማዕከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤከ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 20 - The King Rejoices in Your Strength

verses.textGeez:
ይስማዕከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤከ 
ወይቁም ፡ ለከ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

verses.textGeez:
ወይፈኑ ፡ ለከ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ እምቅደሱ 
ወእምጽዮን ፡ ይትወከፍከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.textGeez:
ወይዝክር ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መሥዋዕተከ 
ወያጥልል ፡ ለከ ፡ ቍርባነከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.textGeez:
የሀብክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ልብከ 
ወይፈጽም ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሥምረተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.textGeez:
ወንትፌሣሕ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ፡
ወነዐቢ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ
verses.textEnglish: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.textGeez: ወይፈጽም ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስእለተከ ።ይእዜ ፡ ኣእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አድኀኖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለመሲሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሠጠዎ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወቅደሱ 
በኀይለ ፡ አድኅኖተ ፡ የማኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.textGeez:
እሙንቱሰ ፡ በአፍራስ ፡ ወበሰረገላት 
ወንሕነሰ ፡ ነዐቢ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.textGeez:
እሙንቱሰ ፡ ተዐቅጹ ፡ ወወድቁ 
ወንሕነሰ ፡ ተንሣእነ ፡ ወረታዕነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አድኅኖ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡
ወስምዐነ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ንጼውዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፩ - እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልከ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ንጉሥ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፳፩ (21) - አቤቱ ፥ በኀይልኽ፡ንጉሥ፡ደስ፡ይለዋል በማዳንኽ፡እጅግ፡ሐሤትን፡ያደርጋል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 21 - My God, My God, Why Have You Forsaken Me?
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልከ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ንጉሥ 
ወብዙኀ ፡ ይትሐሠይ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.textGeez:
ፍትወተ ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ ወሀብኮ 
ወስእለተ ፡ ከናፍሪሁ ፡ ኢከላእኮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በጻሕኮ ፡ በበረከት ፡ ሠናይ 
ወአንበርከ ፡ አክሊለ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ዘእምዕንቍ ፡ ክቡር ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.textGeez:
ሐይወ ፡ ሰአለከ ፡ ወወሀብኮ 
ለነዋኅ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቢይ ፡ ክብሩ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ 
ክብረ ፡ ወስብሐተ ፡ ወሰኮ ።
verses.textEnglish: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ወሀብኮ ፡ በረከተ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወታስተፌሥሖ ፡ በሐሤተ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተወከለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወኢይትሀወክ ፡ በምሕረቱ ፡ ለልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.textGeez:
ትርከቦሙ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ፀርከ 
ወትትራከቦሙ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወትረስዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ እቶነ ፡ እሳት ፡ ለጊዜ ፡ ገጽከ ።
እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ ፡ ሁኮሙ ወትብልዖሙ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.textGeez:
ወፍሬሆሙኒ ፡ ሰዐር ፡ እምድር 
ወዘርዖሙኒ ፡ እምእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሜጥዋ ፡ ለዐመፃ ፡ ላዕሌከ 
ወሐለዩ ፡ ምክረ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢይክሉ ፡ አቅሞ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

verses.textGeez:
ወታገብኦሙ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ 
ወታስተደሉ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ለጊዜ ፡ መዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐልከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልከ 
ንሴብሕ ፡ ወንዜምር ፡ ለጽንዕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፪ - አምላኪየ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ነጽረኒ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ኀደገኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 22 - The Lord is My Shepherd
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ተወክፎ ፡ እንተ ፡ ጸብሐት ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ነጽረኒ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ኀደገኒ 
ርሑቅ ፡ እምአድኅኖትየ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ኃጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ዕለትየ ፡ ወኢሰማዕከኒ 
ወሌሊትየኒ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ወኢሐለይከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.textGeez: ወአንተሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅዱሳኒከ ፡ ተኀድር ፡ ስቡሐ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ኪያከ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ አበዊነ 
ተወከሉከኒ ፡ ወአድኀንኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

verses.textGeez:
ኀቤከ ፡ ጸርኁ ፡ ወድኅኑ 
ኪያከ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ ወኢተኀፍሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ ዕፄ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ሰብእ 
ምኑን ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወትሑት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሬእዩኒ ፡ ይትቃጸቡኒ 
ይብሉ ፡ በከናፍሪሆሙ ፡ ወየሐውሱ ፡ ርእሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

verses.textGeez:
ተወከለ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለያድኅኖ 
ወያድኅኖ ፡ እመ ፡ ይፈቅዶ ።
verses.textEnglish: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እንተ ፡ አውፃእከኒ ፡ እምከርሥ 
ወተወከልኩከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀለውኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አጥባተ ፡ እምየ ።
ላዕሌከ ፡ ተገደፍኩ ፡ እማኅፀን
verses.textEnglish: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

verses.textGeez: እምከርሠ ፡ እምየ ፡ አንተ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

verses.textGeez: ኢትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ እስመ ፡ አልጸቁ ፡ እትመንድብ እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይረድአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

verses.textGeez:
ዐገቱኒ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ብዙኃን 
ወአኀዙኒ ፡ አስዋር ፡ ሥቡሓን
verses.textEnglish: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.textGeez: ወአብቀዉ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ከመ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ዘጽኑሕ ፡ ለመሲጥ ።
verses.textEnglish: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.textGeez: ተከዐውኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወተዘርወ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

verses.textGeez: ወኮነ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰምዕ ፡ ዘይትመሰው ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ከርሥየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

verses.textGeez:
ወየብሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ገልዕ ፡ ኀይልየ ፡
ወጠግዕ ፡ ልሳንየ ፡ በጕርዔየ 
ወአውረድከኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሬተ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.textGeez:
ዐገቱኒ ፡ ከለባት ፡ ብዙኃን 
ወአኀዙኒ ፡ ማኅበሮሙ ፡ ለእኩያን ።
ቀነዉኒ ፡ እደውየ ፡ ወእገርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኈለቁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
እሙንተሰ ፡ ጠይቆሙ ፡ ተዐወሩኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.textGeez:
ወተካፈሉ ፡ አልባስየ ፡ ለርእሶሙ 
ወተዓፀዉ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ዐራዝየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኢትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔየ 
ወነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዱኦትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅና ፡ አምኲናት ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
ወእምእደ ፡ ከለባት ፡ ለብሕቱትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምአፈ ፡ አንበሳ 
ወእምአቅርንት ፡ ዘአሐዱ ፡ ቀርኑ ፡ ለብሕቱትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

verses.textGeez:
እነግሮሙ ፡ ስምከ ፡ ለአኀውየ 
ወበማእከለ ፡ ማኅበር ፡ እሴብሐከ ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔርን፡የምትፈሩ ፥ አመስግኑት የያዕቆብ፡ዘር፡ዅላችኹ ፥ አክብሩት ፥ የእስራኤልም፡ዘር፡ዅላችኹ ፥ ፍ ሩት።
verses.textEnglish: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ትፈርህዎ ፡ ልእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰብሕዎ 
ኵልክሙ ፡ ዘርዐ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አክብርዎ
verses.textAmharic: የችግረኛን፡ችግር፡አልናቀምና ፥ ቸልም፡አላለምና ፊቱንም፡ከእኔ፡አልሰወረምና ፥ ነገር፡ግን ፥ ወደ፡ርሱ፡በ ጮኽኹ፡ጊዜ፡ሰማኝ።
verses.textEnglish: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.textGeez: ወፍርህዎ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ዘርዕ ፡ እስራኤል ።እስመ ፡ ኢመነነ ፡ ወኢተቈጥዐ ፡ ስእለተ ፡ ነዳይ
verses.textEnglish: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.textGeez: ወኢሜጠ ፡ ገጾ ፡ እምኔየ ሶበ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ይሰምዐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እምኀቤከ ፡ ክብርየ ፡ በማኅበር ፡ ዐቢይ 
ወእሁብ ፡ ብፅአትየ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

verses.textGeez:
ይብልዑ ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ወይጽገቡ ፡
ወይሴብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሥዎ 
ወየሐዩ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: For the kingdom is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.

verses.textGeez: ወይዝክሩ ፡ ወይትመየጡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር
verses.textEnglish: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

verses.textGeez: ወይስግዱ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በሐውርተ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ መንግሥት ወውእቱ ፡ ይኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

verses.textGeez:
ብልዑ ፡ ወስግዱ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ጥሉላነ ፡ ምድር ፡
ቅድሜሁ ፡ ይወድቁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር
verses.textEnglish: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

verses.textGeez: ወነፍስየኒ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ተሐዩ ።ወዘርዕየኒ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ይትቀነይ
verses.textEnglish: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

verses.textGeez:
ትዜንዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ትውልድ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትመጽእ ።ወይዜንዉ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ዚአሁ 
ሕዝብ ፡ ዘይትወለድ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፫ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሬዕየኒ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየኀጥአኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 23 - The Earth is the Lord's
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሬዕየኒ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየኀጥአኒ ።
ውስተ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ሥዑር ፡ ህየ ፡ ያኀድረኒ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.textGeez: ወኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ ሐፀነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

verses.textGeez: ሜጣ ፡ ለነፍስየ ወመርሐኒ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስመ ፡ ዚአሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት ፡
ኢይፈርሆ ፡ ለእኩይ ፡ እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ምስሌየ
verses.textEnglish: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

verses.textGeez: በትርከ ፡ ወቀስታምከ ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ገሠጻኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

verses.textGeez: ወሠራዕከ ፡ ማእደ ፡ በቅድሜየ ፡በአንጻሪሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ
verses.textEnglish: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፬ - ወአጽሐድከ ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ጽዋዕከኒ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ያረዊ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 24 - To You, O Lord, I Lift Up My Soul

verses.textGeez: ወአጽሐድከ ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ጽዋዕከኒ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ያረዊ ።
verses.textEnglish: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.textGeez: ምሕረትከ ፡ ይትልወኒ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትየ
verses.textEnglish: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ታንብረኒ ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለነዋኅ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.textEnglish: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.textGeez:
መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘቀዳሚተ ሰንበት ።1 ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምድር ፡ በምልኣ 
ወዓለምኒ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.textGeez:
ወውእቱ ፡ በባሕር ፡ ሳረራ 
ወበአፍላግኒ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አጽንዓ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ የዐርግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወመኑ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካነ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዘንጹሕ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ወንጹሕ ፡ እደዊሁ ።
ወዘኢነሥአ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነፍሱ 
ወዘኢመሐለ ፡ በጕሕሉት ፡ ለቢጹ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ ይነሥእ ፡ በረከተ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወሣህሉኒ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

verses.textGeez:
ዛቲ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ተኀሦ ፡ ሎቱ 
ወተኀሥሥ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.textGeez:
አርኅው ፡ ኆኃተ ፡ መኳንንት ፡
ወይትረኀዋ ፡ ኆኃት ፡ እለ ፡ እምፍጥረት 
ወይባእ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ስብሐት ።
verses.textEnglish: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ስብሐት ።
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀያል ፡ ወጽኑዕ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀያል ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፀብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
አርኅው ፡ ኆኃተ ፡ መኳንንት ፡
ወይትረኀዋ ፡ ኆኃት ፡ እለ ፡ እምፍጥረት 
ወይባእ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ስብሐት ።
verses.textEnglish: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ስብሐት 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ስብሐት ።
verses.textEnglish: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፭ - ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አንቃዕደውኩ ፡ ነፍስየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 25 - Vindicate Me, O Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አንቃዕደውኩ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡
አምላኪየ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ኢይትኀፈር ፡ ለዓለም
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

verses.textGeez: ወኢይስሐቁኒ ፡ ጸላእትየ ።እስመ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሴፈዉከ ፡ ኢይትኀፈሩ
verses.textEnglish: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

verses.textGeez: ለይትኀፈሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይኤብሱ ፡ ዘልፈ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.textGeez: ፍኖተከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምረኒ ወአሰረ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ ምህረኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

verses.textGeez:
ወምርሐኒ ፡ በጽድቅከ ፡ ወምህረኒ ፡
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ 
ወኪየከ ፡ እሴፎ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘከር ፡ ሣህለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወምሕረተከኒ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

verses.textGeez: ኃጢአትየ ፡ ዘበንእስየ ፡ ወእበድየ ፡ ኢተዝክር ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ ተዘከረኒ 
በእንተ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.textGeez:
ኄርኒ ፡ ወጻድቅኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
በእንተዝ ፡ ይመርሖሙ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይስሕቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሜህሮሙ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ለየዋሃን 
ወይኤምሮሙ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ ለልቡባን ።
verses.textEnglish: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ፍኖቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህል ፡ ወጽድቅ 
ለእለ ፡ የኀሡ ፡ ሕጎ ፡ ወስምዖ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተ ፡ ስምከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወስረይ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኃጢአትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወይመርሖ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወነፍሱሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ተኀድር 
ወዘርዑሂ ፡ ይወርስዋ ፡ ለምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

verses.textGeez:
ኀይሎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ 
ወስሙሂ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይጼውዕዎ ።
ወሕጎሂ ፡ ይሜህሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.textGeez:
አዕይንትየሰ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይባልሖን ፡ እመሥገርት ፡ ለእገርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.textGeez:
ነጽር ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወተሣሀለኒ 
እስመ ፡ ባሕታዊ ፡ ወነዳይ ፡ አነ ።
verses.textEnglish: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

verses.textGeez:
ወብዙኅ ፡ ሐዘኑ ፡ ለልብየ 
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምንዳቤየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.textGeez:
ርኢ ፡ ሕማምየ ፡ ወስራሕየ 
ወኅድግ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኃጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.textGeez:
ወርኢ ፡ ከመ ፡ በዝኁ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ጽልአ ፡ በዐመፃ ፡ ይጸልኡኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

verses.textGeez:
ዕቀባ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ወአድኅና 
ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኪየከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

verses.textGeez:
የዋሃን ፡ ወራትዓን ፡ ተለዉኒ 
እስመ ፡ ተሰፈውኩከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.textGeez: ያድኅኖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ምንዳቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፮ - ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ አንሰ ፡ በየዋሃትየ ፡ አሐውር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 26 - The Lord is My Light and My Salvation
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ አንሰ ፡ በየዋሃትየ ፡ አሐውር 
ወተወከልኩ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይድክም ።
verses.textEnglish: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.

verses.textGeez:
ፍትነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወአመክረኒ 
ፍትን ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወኵልያትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ውእቱ 
ወተፈሣሕኩ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢነበርኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐውደ ፡ ከንቱ 
ወኢቦእኩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዐማፂያን ።
verses.textEnglish: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.textGeez:
ጸላእኩ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ እኩያን 
ወኢይነብር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጽልሕዋን ።
verses.textEnglish: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ወአሐጽብ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ እደውየ 
ወአዐውድ ፡ ምሥዋዒከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ እስማዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስብሐቲከ 
ወከመ ፡ እንግር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መንክረከ ።
verses.textEnglish: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ፡ ሥነ ፡ ቤትከ 
ወመካነ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትግድፋ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወኢምስለ ፡ ዕድወ ፡ ደም ፡ ለሕይወትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ 
ወምልእት ፡ ሕልያነ ፡ የምኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ በየዋሃትየ ፡ አሐውር 
አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወተሣሀለኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በርቱዕ ፡ ቆማ ፡ እገሪየ 
በማኅበር ፡ እባርከከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፯ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያበርህ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወያድኅነኒ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ያፈርሀኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 27 - To You, O Lord, I Call
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይትቀባእ ።

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያበርህ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወያድኅነኒ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ያፈርሀኒ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምእመና ፡ ለሕይወትየ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ያደነግፀኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ ይቀርቡኒ ፡ እኩያን ፡ ይብልዑኒ ፡ ሥጋየ 4 ጸላእትየሰ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደክሙ ፡ ወወድቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.textGeez: እመኒ ፡ ፀብአኒ ፡ ተዓይን ፡ ኢይፈርሀኒ ፡ ልብየ 6 ወእመኒ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ ፀባኢት ፡ አንሰ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ተወከልኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.

verses.textGeez: አሐተ ፡ ሰአልክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኪያሃ ፡ አኀሥሥ ከመ ፡ እኅድር ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትየ
verses.textEnglish: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ያርእየኒ ፡ ዘያሠምሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ወከመ ፡ እፀመድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textAmharic: እንሆ ፥ አኹን፡በዙሪያ፡ባሉ፡በጠላቶቼ፡ላይ፡ራሴን፡ከፍ፡ከፍ፡አደረገ በድንኳኑም፡የእልልታ፡መሥዋዕትን፡ ሠዋኹ ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር፡እቀኛለኹ ፥ እዘምርለትማለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀብአኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽላሎቱ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ።
ወሰወረኒ ፡ በምኅባአ ፡ ጽላሎቱ
verses.textEnglish: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.textGeez: ወዲበ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ አልዐለኒ ።ናሁ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ አልዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ርእስየ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

verses.textGeez:
