ዖድኩ ፡ ወሦዕኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራሁ ፡ መሥዋዕተ 
ወየበብኩ ፡ ሎቱ ።
እሴብሕ ፡ ወእዜምር ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textAmharic: ፊትኽን፡ከእኔ፡አትሰውር ፥ ተቈጥተኽ፡ከባሪያኽ፡ፈቀቅ፡አትበል ረዳት፡ኹነኝ ፥ አትጣለኝም ፥ የመድኀኒቴም፡አ ምላክ፡ሆይ ፥ አትተወኝ።
verses.textEnglish: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ዘሰአልኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ፡
verses.textEnglish: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

verses.textGeez: ለከ ፡ ይብለከ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወኀሠሥኩ ፡ ገጸከ ገጸ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ አኀሥሥ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔየ ፡
ወኢትትገሐስ ፡ እምገብርከ ፡ ተምዒዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.textGeez:
ረዳኤ ፡ ኩነኒ ፡ ወኢትግድፈኒ ፡
ወኢትትሀየየኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእምየ ፡ ገደፉኒ 
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወክፈኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ምህረኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፍኖትከ 
ወምርሐኒ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ርትዕከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትመጥወኒ ፡ ለነፍስ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ 
እስመ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላእሌየ ፡ ሰምዕተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡
ወሐሰወት ፡ ርእሳ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.textGeez: እትአመን ፡ ከመ ፡ እርአይ ፡ ሠናይቶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ሕያዋን ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወተሰፈዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
ተዐገሥ ፡ ወአጽንዕ ፡ ልበከ ፡ ወተሰፈዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፰ - ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኢተጸመመኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 28 - Ascribe to the Lord, O Heavenly Beings
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኢተጸመመኒ 
ወእመሰ ፡ ተጸመመከኒ ፡ እከውን ፡ ከመ ፡ እለ ፡ የወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ።
verses.textAmharic: አቤቱ ፥ ወዳንተ፡እጠራለኹ ዝም፡ብትለኝ፡ወደ፡ጕድጓድ፡እንደሚወርዱት፡እንዳልመስል ፥ አንተ፡አምላኬ ፥ ዝም፡ አትበለኝ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ ዘጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡
ሶበ ፡ ኣንሥእ ፡ እደውየ ፡ በጽርሐ ፡ መቅደስከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትስሐባ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡
ወኢትግድፈኒ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይትናገሩ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ቢጾሙ 
ወእኩይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.textGeez:
ሀቦሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ፡
ወበከመ ፡ እከየ ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.textGeez:
ፍድዮሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እደዊሆሙ 
ፍድዮሙ ፡ ፍዳሆሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢሐለዩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ወኢውስተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እደዊሁ 
ንሥቶሙ ፡ ወኢትሕንጾሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.textGeez: ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ረዳእየ ፡ ወምእመንየ ፡
ቦቱ ፡ ተወከለ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወይረድአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.textGeez: ወሠረጸ ፡ ሥጋየ ወእምፈቃድየ ፡ አአምኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
ወምእመነ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ መሲሑ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅን ፡ ሕዝበከ ፡ ወባርክ ፡ ርስተከ 
ረዐዮሙ ፡ ወአልዕሎሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፳፱ - አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውሉደ ፡ አማልክት
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 29 - I Will Extol You, O Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘበፀአት ፡ ትዕይንት ።

verses.textGeez:
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውሉደ ፡ አማልክት 
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እጓለ ፡ ሐራጊት
verses.textEnglish: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.textGeez:
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወስብሐተ ።አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ለስሙ 
ስግዱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በዐጸደ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መየት ።
አምላከ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ አንጐድጐደ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ማያት ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በኀይል 
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በዐቢይ ፡ ስብሐት ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይቀጠቅጥ ፡ አርዘ 
ወይቀጠቅጦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአርዘ ፡ ሊባኖስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.textGeez:
ወያደገድጎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ለሊባኖስ 
ወፍቁርሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወልድ ፡ ዘአሐዱ ፡ ቀርኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይመትር ፡ ነደ ፡ እሳት ።
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያድለቀልቆ ፡ ለገዳም 
ወያድለቀልቆ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሐቅለ ፡ ቃዴስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያጸንዖሙ ፡ ለኀየላት 
ወይከሥት ፡ አዕዋመ 
ወበጽርሑ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ይብል ፡ ስብሐት ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያስተጋብኦ ፡ ለማየ ፡ አይኅ 
ወይነብር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይነግሥ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሁቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀይል ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይባርኮሙ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ በሰላም ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴ - ኣአኵተከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተወከፍክኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 30 - In You, O Lord, Do I Take Refuge
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ለተሐድሶ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ለዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ኣአኵተከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተወከፍክኒ 
ወስላተ ፡ ጸላኢየ ፡ ኢረሰይከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወተሣሀልከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አውፃእካ ፡ እምሲኦል ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወአድኀንከኒ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.textGeez:
ዘምሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ጻድቃኑ 
ወግነዩ ፡ ለዝክረ ፡ ቅድሳቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ እመዐቱ ፡ ወሐይው ፡ እምፈቅዱ
verses.textEnglish: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

verses.textGeez: በምሴት ፡ ይደምፅ ፡ ብካይ ፡ ወበጽባሕ ፡ ፍሥሓ ።
verses.textEnglish: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.textGeez: አንሰ ፡ እቤ ፡ በትድላየ ኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዓለም ።8 እግዚኦ ፡ በሥምረትከ ፡ ሀባ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ለሕይወትየ
verses.textEnglish: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

verses.textGeez: ሜጥከሰ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ወኮንኩ ፡ ድንጉፀ ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.

verses.textGeez: ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ እስእል ።11 ምንተ ፡ ያሰልጥ ፡ ደምየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ወረድኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሙስና
verses.textEnglish: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

verses.textGeez: መሬትኑ ፡ የአምነከ ፡ ወይነግር ፡ ጽድቀከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.

verses.textGeez: ሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተሠሀለኒ ወኮነኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ረዳኢየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.textGeez:
ሜትከ ፡ ላሕየ ፡ ወአስተፈሣሕከኒ 
ሰጠጥከ ፡ ሠቅየ ፡ ወሐሤተ ፡ አቅነትከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ከመዝ ፡ እዜምር ፡ ለከ ፡ ክብርየ ፡ ወኢይደንግፅ 
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፩ - ኪየከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ለዓለም
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፴፩ (31) - አቤቱ፡አንተን፡ታመንኹ ለዘለዓለም፡አልፈር በጽድቅኽም፡አድነኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 31 - Blessed is the One Whose Transgression is Forgiven
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘበተደሞ ፡ ከመዘ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በካልእ ።

verses.textGeez:
ኪየከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ለዓለም 
ወበጽድቅከ ፡ አንግፈኒ ፡ ወባልሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez: አፅምእ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወፍጡነ ፡ አድኅነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.textGeez:
ኩነኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀንየ 
ወቤተ ፡ ጸወንየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታድኅነኒ ፡
verses.textEnglish: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ኀይልየ ፡ ወጸወንየ ፡ አንተ ወበእንተ ፡ ስምከ ፡ ምርሐኒ ፡ ወሴስየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅእኒ ፡ እምዛቲ ፡ መሥገርት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀብኡ ፡ ሊተ 
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ረዳእየ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ኣምኀፅን ፡ ነፍስየ 
ቤዝወኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ ጽድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ጸላእከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘየዐቅብ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ለዝሉፉ
verses.textEnglish: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

verses.textGeez: ወአንሰ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ እወከልኩ ።እትፌሣሕ ፡ ወእትሐሠይ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ርኢከኒ ፡ በሕማምየ 
ወአድኀንካ ፡ እምንዳቤሃ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢዘጋሕከኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ፀርየ ።
ወአቀምኮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ መርሕብ ፡ ለእገርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሐመምኩ 
ወተሀውከት ፡ እመዐት ፡ ዐይንየ ፡
ነፍስየኒ ፡ ወከርሥየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ በሕማም ፡ ሕይወትየ 
ወዐመትየኒ ፡ በገዐር ።
verses.textEnglish: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.textGeez:
ደክመ ፡ በተጽናስ ፡ ኀይልየ 
ወአንቀልቀለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.textGeez:
ተጸአልኩ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ወፈድፋደሰ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ጎርየ ፡
ግሩም ፡ ኮንክዎሙ ፡ ለአዝማድየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.

verses.textGeez:
ወእለኒ ፡ ይሬእዩኒ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ይጐዩ ፡ እምኔየ ።
ቀብጹኒ ፡ እምልብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘሞተ
verses.textEnglish: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.textGeez: ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ዘተሐጕለ ።እስመ ፡ ሰማዕኩ ፡ ድምፀ ፡ ብዙኃን ፡ እለ ፡ ዐገቱኒ ፡ ዐውድየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወተማከሩ ፡ ይምስጥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ብከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእቤለከ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ ።
ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ርስትየ
verses.textEnglish: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.textGeez: አድኅነኒ ፡ እንእደ ፡ ፀርየ ፡ ወእምእለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

verses.textGeez:
አብርህ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገብርከ ወአድኅነኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምሕረትከ ።
ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ጸዋዕኩከ
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.textGeez: ለይትኀፈሩ ፡ ጽልሕዋን ፡ ወይረዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ።አሌሎን ፡ ለከናፍረ ፡ ጕሕሉት
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ ይነባ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡በትዕቢት ፡ ወበመንኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡
ሰወርኮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኀንኮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ ብከ 
በቅድመ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ወተኀብኦሙ ፡ በጽላሎትከ ፡ እምሀከከ ፡ ሰብእ
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ወትከድኖሙ ፡ በመንጦላዕትከ ፡ እምባህለ ፡ ልሳን ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘሰብሐ ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ።28 አንሰ ፡ እቤ ፡ ተገደፍኩኒ ፡ እንጋ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez: በእንተዝ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ ዘጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
አፍቅርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ።
እስመ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ የኀሥሥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይትቤቀሎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ የኀሥሡ ፡ ትዕቢተ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ተዐገሡ ፡ ወአጽንዑ ፡ ልበክሙ 
ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ተወከልክሙ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፪ - ብፁዓን ፡ እለ ፡ ተኀድገ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 32 - The Steadfast Love of the Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ።

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዓን ፡ እለ ፡ ተኀድገ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ 
ወለእለ ፡ ኢሐሰበ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ገጋዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኢኈለቈ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኃጢአቶ 
ወዘአልቦ ፡ ጽልሑተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አርመምኩ ፡ በልብየ ፡ አዕጽምትየ 
እምኀበ ፡ እጸርኅ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ ወሌሊተ ፡ ከብደት ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወተመየጥኩ ፡ ለሕርትምና ፡ ሶበ ፡ ወግዐኒ ፡ ሦክ ።
verses.textEnglish: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ኃጢአትየ ፡ ነገርኩ ፡ ወአበሳየ ፡ ኢኀባእኩ
verses.textEnglish: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወእቤ ፡ ኣስተዋዳ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትየ ወአንተ ፡ ኅድግ ፡ ጽልሑቶ ፡ ለልብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.textGeez: በእንተዝ ፡ ይጼሊ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ በጊዜ ፡ ርቱዕ
verses.textEnglish: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወባሕቱ ፡ ማየ ፡ አይኅ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ኢይቀርብ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.textGeez: አንተ ፡ ምስካይየ ፡ እምዛቲ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ እንተ ፡ ረከበትኒ ወትፍሥሕትየኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታድኅነኒ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ኣሌብወከ ፡ ወኣጸንዐከ ፡ በዛቲ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ሖርከ 
ወኣጸንዕ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ላዕሌከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.textGeez: ኢትኩኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፈረስ ፡ ወበቅል ፡ እለ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ልበ
verses.textEnglish: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ በሕሳል ፡ ወበልጓም ፡ ይመይጥዎሙ ፡ መላትሒሆሙ ፡ከመ ፡ ኢይቅረቡ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኅ ፡ መቅሠፍቶሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህል ፡ ይሜግቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

verses.textGeez:
ተፈሥሑ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተሐሠዩ ፡ ጻድቃኑ 
ወተመክሑ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፫ - ተፈሥሑ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ በእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፴፫ (33) - ጻድቃን፡ሆይ ፥ በእግዚአብሔር፡ደስ፡ይበላችኹ ለቅኖች፡ምስጋና፡ይገ፟ባ፟ል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 33 - Taste and See That the Lord is Good
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተፈሥሑ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወለራትዓን ፡ ይደልዎሙ ፡ ክብር ።
verses.textEnglish: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በመሰንቆ 
ወበመዝሙር ፡ ዘዐሠርቱ ፡ አውታሪሁ ፡ ዘምሩ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰብሐዎ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ 
ሠናየ ፡ ዘምሩ ፡ ወየብቡ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ቃሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ውኵሉ ፡ ግብሩ ፡ በሀይማኖት ።
verses.textEnglish: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.

verses.textGeez:
ያፈቅር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ወምጽዋተ 
ሣህሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ መልአ ፡ ምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወበቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸንዓ ፡ ሰማያት 
ወበእስትንፋሰ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.textGeez:
ዘያስተጋብኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዝቅ ፡ ለማየ ፡ ባሕር 
ወይሠይሞሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መዛግብተ ፡ ቀላያት ።
verses.textEnglish: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

verses.textGeez:
ትፍርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵላ ፡ ምድር 
ወእምኔሁ ፡ ይደንግፁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ወኮኑ 
ወውእቱ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ወተፈጥሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይመይጥ ፡ ምክሮሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ 
ወይመይጥ ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ 
ወያረስዖሙ ፡ ምክሮሙ ፡ ለመላእክት ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.textGeez:
ወምክሩሰ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሄሉ ፡ ለዓለም 
ወሕሊና ፡ ልቡኒ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ 
ሕዝብ ፡ ዘኀረየ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.textGeez:
እምሰማይ ፡ ሐወጸ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወርእየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምድልው ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅደሱ 
ወርእየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ኅዱራን ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ዘውእቱ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ፈጠረ ፡ ልኮሙ 
ዘያአምር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይድኅን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ሰራዊቱ 
ወያርብኅኒ ፡ ኢደኅነ ፡ በብዙኀ ፡ ኀይሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈረስኒ ፡ ሐሳዊ ፡ ኢያድኅን 
ወኢያመስጥ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ጽንዑ ።
verses.textEnglish: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ በምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.textGeez:
ያድኅና ፡ እሞት ፡ ለነፍሶሙ 
ወይሴስዮሙ ፡ አመ ፡ ረኃብ ።
verses.textEnglish: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.textGeez:
ነፍስነሰ ፡ ትሴፈዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እስመ ፡ ረዳኢነ ፡ ወምስካይነ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ልብነ 
ወተወከልነ ፡ በስሙ ፡ ቅዱስ ።
verses.textEnglish: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.textGeez:
ለትኩን ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ ላዕሌነ 
በከመ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ተወከልነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፬ - እባርኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 34 - Contend, O Lord, with Those Who Contend
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፤ ዘአመ ፡ በዐደ ፡ ገጾ ፡ እምቅድሜሁ ፡ ለአቢሜሌክ ።

verses.textGeez:
እባርኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ 
ወዘልፈ ፡ ስብሓቲሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.textGeez: በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ትከብር ፡ ነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.textGeez: ይስምዑ ፡ የዋሃን ፡ ወይትፈሥሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.textGeez: አዕብይዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌየ ወናልዕል ፡ ስሞ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.textGeez:
ኀሠሥክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተሠጥወኒ 
ወእምኵሉ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ አድኀነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.textGeez:
ቅረቡ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወያበርህ ፡ ለክሙ 
ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ገጽክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.textGeez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ጸርኀ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰምዖ 
ወእምኵሉ ፡ ምንዳቤሁ ፡ አድኀኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

verses.textGeez:
ይትዐየን ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ዐውዶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

verses.textGeez:
ጠዐሙ ፡ ወታእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘተወከለ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.textGeez:
ፍርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ቅዱሳኑ 
እስመ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ተፅናሰ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.

verses.textGeez:
ብዑላንሰ ፡ ነድዩ ፡ ወርኅቡ 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይኀሥዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢተጸነሱ ፡ እምኵሎ ፡ ሠናይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ንዑ ፡ ደቂቅየ ፡ ወስምዑኒ 
ፈሪሀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምህርክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፈቅዱ ፡ ሐይወ 
ወያፍቅር ፡ ይርእይ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሠናያተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.textGeez:
ክላእ ፡ ልሳነከ ፡ እምእኩይ 
ወከናፍሪከኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይንብባ ፡ ጕሕሉተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.textGeez:
ተገሐሥ ፡ እምእኩይ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ሠናየ 
ኅሥሣ ፡ ለሰላም ፡ ወዴግና ።
verses.textEnglish: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጻድቃኑ 
ወእዝኑሂ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ስእለቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ እኩየ 
ከመ ፡ ይሠረው ፡ እምድር ፡ ዝክሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

verses.textGeez:
ጸርኁ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰምዖሙ 
ወእምኵሉ ፡ ምንዳቤሆሙ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.textGeez:
ቅሩብ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለየዋሃነ ፡ ልብ 
ወያድኅኖሙ ፡ ለትሑታነ ፡ መንፈስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኅ ፡ ሕማሞሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን 
ወእምኵሉ ፡ ያድኅኖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ የዐቅብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አዕጽምቲሆሙ 
ወኢይትቀጠቀጥ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.textGeez:
ሞቱ ፡ ለኃጥእ ፡ ፀዋግ 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይጸልእዎ ፡ ለጻድቅ ፡ ይኔስሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

verses.textGeez:
ይቤዙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ አግብርቲሁ 
ወኢይኔስሑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፭ - ግፍዖሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይገፍዑኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፴፭ (35) - አቤቱ ፥ የሚበድሉኝን፡በድላቸው ፥ የሚዋጉኝንም፡ተዋጋቸው
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 35 - How Precious is Your Steadfast Love
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ግፍዖሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይገፍዑኒ 
ፅብኦሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፀብኡኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.textGeez: ንሥእ ፡ ወልታ ፡ ወኲናተ ወተንሥእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዲኦትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

verses.textGeez:
ምላኅ ፡ ሰይፈከ ፡ ወዕግቶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ሮዱኒ 
በላ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ረዳኢኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

verses.textGeez: ለይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.textGeez: ለይግብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡ እለ ፡ መከሩ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.

verses.textGeez: ለይኩኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጸበል ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ነፋስ ወመልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለይሣቅዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

verses.textGeez:
ለትኩን ፡ ፍኖቶሙ ፡ ዳኅፀ ፡ ወጽልመተ 
ወመልአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለይስድዶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በከንቱ ፡ ኀብኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ መሥገርተ ፡ ያጥፍኡኒ 
ወበከንቱ ፡ አምንዘዝዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.textGeez:
ለትምጽኦሙ ፡ መሥገርት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢያእመሩ ።
ወተአኅዞሙ ፡ መሥገርት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀብኡ 
ወይደቁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ መሥገርት ።
verses.textEnglish: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ወነፍስየሰ ፡ ትትፌሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወትትሐሠይ ፡ በአድኅኖቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡ ይብሉከ 
እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ከማከ ፡
verses.textEnglish: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.textGeez: ታድኅኖ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ዘይትዔገሎ ለነዳይ ፡ ወለምስኪን ፡ እምእደ ፡ ዘይመስጦ ።
verses.textEnglish: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥኡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ሰማዕተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወዘኢያአምር ፡ ነበቡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

verses.textGeez:
ፈደዩኒ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ሠናይት 
ወአኅጥእዋ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

verses.textGeez: ወአንሰ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አስርሑኒ ፡ ለበስኩ ፡ ሠቀ ፡
verses.textEnglish: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

verses.textGeez: ወአሕመምክዋ ፡ በጾም ፡ ለነፍስየ ወጸሎትየኒ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕፅንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ዘለአኀውየ ፡ ወለቢጽየ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ አድሎኩ 
ከመ ፡ ዘይላሑ ፡ ወይቴክዝ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ አትሐትኩ ፡ ርእስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.textGeez:
ተጋብኡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ 
ተማከሩ ፡ ይቅሥፉኒ ፡ ወኢያእመርኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

verses.textGeez:
ተሰብሩሂ ፡ ወኢደንገፁ ።
ፈተኑኒ ፡ ወተሳለቁ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወሠሐቁኒ 
ወሐቀዩ ፡ ስነኒሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ትፈትሕ ፡ ሊተ ።
አድኅና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምእከየ ፡ ምግባሮሙ 
ወእምአናብስት ፡ ለብሕቱትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማኅበር ፡ ዐቢይ 
ወእሴብሐከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ክቡድ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

verses.textGeez: ወኢይትፌሥሑ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልኡኒ ፡ በዐመፃ እለ ፡ ይፃረሩኒ ፡ በከንቱ ፡ ወይትቃጸቡኒ ፡ በአዕይንቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሊተሰ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ይትናገሩኒ 
ወይመክሩ ፡ በቍፅር ፡ ያመንስዉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.textGeez:
ወአብቀዉ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወይቤሉ ፡ እንቋዕ ፡ እንቋዕ ርኢናሁ ፡ በአዕይንቲነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.textGeez:
ርኢ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢታርምም 
እግዚኦ ፡ ኢትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አፅምእ ፡ ፍትሕየ 
አምላኪየ ፡ ወእግዚእየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅሥትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

verses.textGeez:
ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ በከመ ፡ ጽድቅከ 
ወኢይትፌሥሑ ፡ ላእሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይበሉ ፡ በልቦሙ ፡ እንቋዕ ፡ እንቋዕ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነፍስየ 
ወኢይበሉ ፡ ውኅጥናሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.textGeez: ለይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ በሕማምየ
verses.textEnglish: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.textGeez: ወይልበሱ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ወኀሳረ ፡ እለ ፡ ያዐብዩ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.textGeez:
ለይትፌሥሑ ፡ ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈቅድዋ ፡ ለጽድቅየ ወይበሉ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

verses.textGeez:
ልሳንየ ፡ ያነብብ ፡ ጽድቀከ 
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፮ - ይነብብ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ በዘ ፡ ያስሕት ፡ ርእሶ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 36 - He Will Not Forsake His Saints
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ይነብብ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ በዘ ፡ ያስሕት ፡ ርእሶ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጸልሐወ ፡ በልሳኑ 
ሶበ ፡ ትረክቦ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ይጸልኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ወጕሕሉት 
ወኢፈቀደ ፡ ይለቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያሠኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

verses.textGeez:
ወሐለየ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምስካቡ 
ወቆመ ፡ በፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ ሠናይተ ፡
ወኢተሀከያ ፡ ለእኪት ።
verses.textEnglish: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በሰማይ ፡ ሣህልከ 
ወጽድቅከኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደመናት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.textGeez:
ወርትዕከኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ አድባረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ኵነኔከ ፡ ዕሙቅ ፡ ጥቀ
verses.textEnglish: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.

verses.textGeez: ሰብአ ፡ ወእንስሳ ፡ ታድኅን ፡ እግዚኦ ።በከመ ፡ አብዛኅከ ፡ ምሕረተከ ፡ እግዚኦ
verses.textEnglish: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

verses.textGeez: ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ ክነፊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

verses.textGeez: ወይረውዩ ፡ እምጠለ ፡ ቤትከ ወትሰቅዮሙ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ትፍሥሕትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እምኀቤከ ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ሕይወት 
በብርሃንከ ፡ ንሬኢ ፡ ብርሃነ ።
verses.textEnglish: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.textGeez:
ስፋሕ ፡ ምሕረተከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እለ ፡ ያአምሩከ 
ወጽድቀከኒ ፡ ለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይምጽአኒ ፡ እግረ ፡ ትዕቢት 
ወእደ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ኢይሁከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.textGeez:
ህየ ፡ ወድቁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ይሰደዱ ፡ ወኢይክሉ ፡ ቀዊመ ።
verses.textEnglish: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፯ - ኢትቅናእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እኩያን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 37 - Do Not Forsake Me, O Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ኢትቅናእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እኩያን 
ወኢትቅናእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ይየብሱ 
ወከመ ፡ ኀመልማል ፡ ኀምል ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ይወድቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.textGeez:
ተወከል ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወግበር ፡ ሠናየ 
ወያኀድረከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይሬዕየከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ብዕላ ።
verses.textEnglish: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

verses.textGeez: ተፈሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይሁበከ ፡ ስእለተ ፡ ልብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

verses.textGeez:
ክሥት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ፍኖተከ 
ወተወከል ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.textGeez:
ወያመጽኣ ፡ ከመ ፡ ብርሃን ፡ ለጽድቅከ 
ወፍትሕከኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዐልት ።
ግነይ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተፀመዶ
verses.textEnglish: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

verses.textGeez: ወኢትቅናእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዘይዴሎ ፡ በሕይወቱ ላዕለ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

verses.textGeez:
ኅድጋ ፡ ለመዐት ፡ ወግድፋ ፡ ለቍጥዓ 
ወኢትቅናእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታሕሥም ።
verses.textEnglish: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እለ ፡ ያሕሥሙ ፡ ይሤረዉ 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይትዔገሥዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ይወርስዋ ፡ ለምድር
verses.textEnglish: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.textGeez: ወዓዲ ፡ ኅዳጠ ፡ ወኢይሄሉ ፡ እንከ ፡ ኃጥእ ተኀሥሥ ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ መካኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

verses.textGeez:
ወየዋሃንሰ ፡ ይወርስዋ ፡ ለምድር 
ወይትፌሥሑ ፡ በብዙኅ ፡ ሰላም ።
verses.textEnglish: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.textGeez:
ያስትሐይጾ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ለጻድቅ ፡
ወየሐቂ ፡ ስነኒሁ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.textGeez:
ወእግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ይስሕቆ ።
እስመ፡ ያቀድም ፡ አእምሮ ፡ ከመ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ዕለቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

verses.textGeez:
ሰይፎሙ ፡ መልኁ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡
ወወሰቁ ፡ ቀስቶሙ
verses.textEnglish: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ይቅትልዎ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ ወለምስኪን ፡ወከመ ፡ ይርግዝዎሙ ፡ ለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.textGeez:
ሰይፎሙ ፡ ይባእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ 
ወይትቀጥቀጥ ፡ አቅስቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ይኄይስ ፡ ኅዳጥ ፡ ዘበጽድቅ 
እምብዙኅ ፡ ብዕለ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ይትቀጠቀጥ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን 
ያጸንዖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ወያአምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ንጹሓን 
ወለዓለም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ርስቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይትኀፈሩ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ እኩያት 
ወይጸግቡ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ ረኃብ ።
ወኃጥኣንሰ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ ፡
verses.textEnglish: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.textGeez: ወጸላእቱሰ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ከብሩ ፡ ወተለዐሉ የኀልቁ ፡ ወይጠፍኡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጢስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

verses.textGeez:
ይትሌቃሕ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ወኢይፈዲ ፡
ወጻድቅሰ ፡ ይምሕር ፡ ወይሁብ ።
verses.textEnglish: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እለ ፡ ይባርክዎ ፡ ይወርስዋ ፡ ለምድር 
ወእለሰ ፡ ይረግምዎ ፡ ይሤረዉ ።
verses.textEnglish: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.

verses.textGeez:
እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይጸንዕ ፡ ሑረቱ ፡ ለሰብእ 
ለዘይፈቅድ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ወድቀ ፡ ኢይደነግፅ 
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሰውቆ ፡ እዴሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.textGeez:
ወርዘውኩሂ ፡ ወረሳእኩ 
ወጻድቅሰ ፡ ዘይትገደፍ ፡ ኢርኢኩ 
ወዘርዑኒ ፡ ኢይጼነስ ፡ እክለ ።
verses.textEnglish: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.textGeez:
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይምሕር ፡ ወይሌቅሕ 
ወዘርዑሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በረከት ፡ ይሄሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
ተገሕስ ፡ እምእኩይ ፡ ወግበር ፡ ሠናየ 
ወትነብር ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ወኢይገድፎሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን 
ወለዓለም ፡ የዐቅቦሙ
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.textGeez: ወይትቤቀሎሙ ፡ ለንጹሓን ወይሤሩ ፡ ዘርዖሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

verses.textGeez:
ወጻድቃንሰ ፡ ይወርስዋ ፡ ለምድር 
ወይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.textGeez:
አፉሁ ፡ ለጻድቅ ፡ ይትሜሀር ፡ ጥበበ 
ወልሳኑ ፡ ይነብብ ፡ ጽድቀ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

verses.textGeez:
ሕገ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡ 
ወኢይድኅፅ ፡ ሰኰናሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.textGeez:
ያስተሓይጾ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ለጻድቅ 
ወይፈቅድ ፡ ይቅትሎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢየኀድጎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ 
ወኢይመውኦ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይትዋቀሡ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.textGeez:
ተዐገሶ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዕቀብ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡
ወያዐብየከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትረሳ ፡ ለምድር 
ወትሬኢ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሠረዉ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.textGeez: ርኢክዎ ፡ ለኃጥእ ፡ ዐቢየ ወተለዐለ ፡ ከመ ፡ አርዘ ፡ ሊባኖስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.textGeez:
ወሶበ ፡ እገብእ ፡ ኀጣእክዎ 
ኀሠሥኩ ፡ ወኢረከብኩ ፡ መካኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.textGeez:
ዕቀብ ፡ የውሀተ ፡ ወትሬኢ ፡ ጽድቀ 
እስመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ተረፈ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ሰላም ።
verses.textEnglish: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐማፂያንሰ ፡ ይሤረዉ 
ወይሤረዉ ፡ ትራፋቲሆሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ይረዳቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋልም ፥ ከኀጢአተኛዎችም፡እጅ፡ያወጣቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋል ፥ በርሱ፡ታምነዋል ና።
verses.textEnglish: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.textGeez:
መድኀኒቶሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወቀዋሚሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በጊዜ ፡ መንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ይረዳቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋልም ፥ ከኀጢአተኛዎችም፡እጅ፡ያወጣቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋል ፥ በርሱ፡ታምነዋል ና።
verses.textEnglish: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.textGeez:
ይረድኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ 
ወያነግፎሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ 
እስመ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ይረዳቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋልም ፥ ከኀጢአተኛዎችም፡እጅ፡ያወጣቸዋል ፥ ያድናቸዋል ፥ በርሱ፡ታምነዋል ና።
verses.textEnglish: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፰ - እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ ፡ ኢትቅሥፈኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፴፰ (38) - አቤቱ ፥ በቍጣኽ፡አትቅሠፈኝ ፥ በመዓትኽም፡አትገሥጸኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 38 - What is the Measure of My Days?
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ለተዝካረ ሰንበት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በመዐትከ ፡ ኢትቅሥፈኒ 
ወበመቅሠፍትከ ፡ ኢትገሥጸኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አሕጻከ ፡ ደጐጻኒ 
ወአጽናዕከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.textGeez:
ወአልቦ ፡ ፈውሰ ፡ ለሥጋየ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ መዐትከ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ለአዕጽምትየ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ ኀጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኖኀ ፡ እምሥዕርትየ ፡ ጌጋይየ 
ከመ ፡ ጾር ፡ ክብድ ፡ ከብደ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.textGeez: ጼአ ፡ ወባኍብኈ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ እበድየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.textGeez:
ሐርተምኩ ፡ ወተቀጻዕኩ ፡ ለዝሉፉ 
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ትኩዝየ ፡ ኣንሶሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጸግበት ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ነፍስየ 
ወኀጣእኩ ፡ ፈውሰ ፡ ለሥጋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.textGeez:
ደወይኩ ፡ ወሐመምኩ ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወእጐሥዕ ፡ እምሐዘነ ፡ ልብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.textGeez:
በቅድሜከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍትወትየ 
ወገዓርየኒ ፡ ኢይትኀባእ ፡ እምኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.textGeez:
ልብየኒ ፡ ደንገፀኒ ፡ ወኀይልየኒ ፡ ኀደገኒ 
ወብርሃነ ፡ አዕይንትየኒ ፡ ለከወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.textGeez: አዕርክትየኒ ፡ ወቢጽየኒ ፡ ዕድወ ፡ ኮኑኒ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ ወደበዩኒ
verses.textEnglish: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.textGeez: ወአዝማድየኒ ፡ ቀብፁኒ ፡ ወተናከሩኒ ።ወተኀየሉኒ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሥሥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.textGeez: ወእለኒ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ሕማምየ ፡ ነበቡ ፡ ከንቶ ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይመክሩ ፡ በቍፅር ፡ ያመነስዉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽሙም ፡ ዘኢይሰምዕ 
ወከመ ፡ በሃም ፡ ዘኢይከሥት ፡ አፉሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኢይሰምዕ 
ወከመ ፡ ዘኢይክል ፡ ተናግሮ ፡ በአፉሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ 
አንተ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እቤ ፡ ኢትረስየኒ ፡ ስላተ ፡ ጸላእየ 
ወእመኒ ፡ ድኅፀ ፡ ሰኰናየ ፡ ያዐብዩ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሊተሰ ፡ አጽንሑኒ ፡ ይቅሥፉኒ 
ወቍስልየኒ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.textGeez:
ወእነግር ፡ ጌጋይየ 
ወእቴክዝ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.textGeez:
ጸላእትየሰ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ ወይኄይሉኒ 
ወበዝኁ ፡ እለ ፡ በዐመፃ ፡ ይጸልኡኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይፈድዩኒ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ሠናይት ፡
ወያስተዋድዩኒ ፡ በተሊወ ፡ ጽድቅ ።
ወገደፉ ፡ እኅዋሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ በድን ፡ ርኩስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ ኢትግድፈኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኢትርሕቅ ፡ እምኔየ ።
ወነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዱኦትየ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፴፱ - እቤ ፡ አዐቅብ ፡ አፉየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይስሐት ፡ በልሳንየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 39 - I Waited Patiently for the Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘኢዶቱም ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: እቤ ፡ አዐቅብ ፡ አፉየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይስሐት ፡ በልሳንየ
verses.textEnglish: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.textGeez: ወአንበርኩ ፡ ዐቃቤ ፡ ለአፉየ ሶበ ፡ ይትቃወሙኒ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ቅድሜየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.textGeez:
ተጸመምኩ ፡ ወአትሐትኩ ፡ ርእስየ ፡
ወአርመምኩ ፡ ለሠናይ 
ወተሕደሰኒ ፡ ቍስልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

verses.textGeez:
ወሞቀኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ በውስጤየ ፡
ወነደ ፡ እሳት ፡ እምአንብቦትየ ወእቤ ፡ በልሳንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

verses.textGeez: ንግረኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ደኃሪትየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ምንት ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ኈልቆን ፡ ለመዋዕልየ ፡ከመ ፡ ኣእምር ፡ ለምንት ፡ እዴኀር ፡ አነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ብሉያተ ፡ረሰይኮነ ፡ ለመዋዕልየ ፡
ወአካልየኒ ፡ ወኢከመ ፡ ምንት ፡ በቅድሜከ
verses.textEnglish: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

verses.textGeez: ወባሕቱ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.textGeez: ወከመ ፡ ጽላሎት ፡ ያንሶሱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ወባሕቱ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ይትሀወኩ
verses.textEnglish: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

verses.textGeez: ይዘግቡ ፡ ወኢያአምሩ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ያስተጋብኡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

verses.textGeez: ወይእዜኒ ፡ መኑ ፡ ተስፋየ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ወትዕግስትየኒ ፡ እምኅቤከ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምኵሉ ፡ ኀጢአትየ ፡ አድኅነኒ 
ወረሰይከኒ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ለአብዳን ።
verses.textAmharic: አቤቱ ፥ ጸሎቴን፡ስማ ፥ ጩኸቴንም፡አድምጥ ፥ ልቅሶዬንም፡ቸል፡አትበለኝ እኔ፡በምድር፡ላይ፡መጻተኛ፡ነኝና ፥ እንደ፡አባቶችም፡እንግዳ፡ነኝና።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.textGeez:
ተጸመምኩ ፡ ወኢከሠትኩ ፡ አፉየ 
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከኒ ።
አርሕቅ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ መቅሠፍተከ
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ እምጽንዐ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ኀለቁ ፡ አነ ።በተግሣጽከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ተዛለፍኮ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.textGeez: ወመሰውካ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሳሬት ፡ ለነፍሱ ወባሕቱ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ይትሀወኩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ወስእለትየ ፡
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ አንብዕየ ፡ ወኢትጸመመኒ 
እስመ ፡ ፈላሲ ፡ አነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር 
ወነግድ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አበውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.textGeez:
ሥኅተኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኣዕርፍ 
ዘእንበለ ፡ እሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢይገብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.textGeez: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።
verses.textEnglish: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵ - ጸኒሐ ፡ ጸናሕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 40 - Blessed is the One Who Considers the Poor
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ጸኒሐ ፡ ጸናሕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ሰምዐኒ ፡ ወተመይጠኒ ፡
verses.textEnglish: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰምዐኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።ወአውፅአኒ ፡ እምዐዘቅተ ፡ ሕርትምና ፡
ወእምጽብረ ፡ ዐምዓም
verses.textEnglish: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.textGeez: ወአቀሞኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ለእገርየ ፡ወአጽንዖኒ ፡ ለመካይድየ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወወደየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉየ ፡ ስብሓተ ፡ ሐዲሰ ፡
ስብሓቲሁ ፡ ለአምላክነ
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.textGeez: ይርአዩ ፡ ብዙኃን ፡ ወይፍርሁ ወይትወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ትውክልቱ 
ወዘኢነጸረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መዐት ፡ ወሐሰት ።
verses.textEnglish: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኀ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ መንክረከ ፡
ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይመስሎ ፡ ለሕሊናከ
verses.textEnglish: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

verses.textGeez: አይደዕኩ ፡ ወነገርኩ ፡ ወበዝኃ ፡ እምኈልቍ ።
verses.textEnglish: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

verses.textGeez: መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወቍርባነ ፡ ኢፈቀድከ ፡ሥጋሰ ፡ አንጽሕ ፡ ሊተ
verses.textEnglish: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.

verses.textGeez: መሥዋዕተ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኃጢአት ፡ ኢሠመርከ ።ውእቱ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ እቤ ፡ ነየ ፡ መጻእኩ
verses.textEnglish: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ተጽሕፈ ፡ በእንቲአየ ።ከመ ፡ እንግር ፡ ፈቃደከ ፡ መከርኩ ፡ አምላኪየ 
ወሕግከኒ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ከርሥየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.textGeez:
ዜነውኩ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ በማኅበር ፡ ዐቢይ ፡
ናሁ ፡ ኢከላእኩ ፡ ከናፍርየ 
እግዚኦ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ጽድቅየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

verses.textGeez:
ኢኀባእኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ርትዐከ 
ወነገርኩ ፡ አድኅኖተከ
verses.textEnglish: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.

verses.textGeez: ወኢሰወርኩ ፡ ሣህለከ ፡ ወምሕረትከ ፡ እማኅበር ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.textGeez: አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኢታርሕቅ ፡ ሣህለከ ፡ እምኔየ ምሕረትከ ፡ ወጽድቅከ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ይርከባኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ረከበተኒ ፡ እኪት ፡ እንተ ፡ አልባቲ ፡ ኈልቈ ፡
ወተራከባኒ ፡ ኃጣውእየ ፡ ወስእንኩ ፡ ነጽሮ
verses.textEnglish: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.

verses.textGeez: ወበዝኃ ፡ እምሥዕርተ ፡ ርእስየ ልብየኒ ፡ ኀደገኒ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez: ሥመር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታድኅነኒ እግዚኦ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዲኦትየ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez: ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ያእትትዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez: ለይግብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እኩየ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትፈደዩ ፡ በጊዜሃ ፡ ኀሳሮሙ እለ ፡ ይብሉኒ ፡ እንቋዕ ፡ እንቋዕ ።22 ለይትፈሥሑ ፡ ወይትሐሰዩ ፡ ብከ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሡከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
ወይበሉ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ አድኀኖተከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፡ እነ ፡
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሔሊ ፡ ሊተ
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

verses.textGeez: ረዳእየ ፡ ወመድኀንየ ፡ አንተ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኢትጐንዲ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ ፥ ጌታ፡ግን፡ያስብልኛል አንተ፡ረዳቴና፡መድኀኒቴ፡ነኽ አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አትዘ ግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፩ - ብፁዕ ፡ ዘይሌቡ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፤ እምዕለት ፡ እኪተ...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 41 - As a Deer Pants for Flowing Streams
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: ብፁዕ ፡ ዘይሌቡ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፤ እምዕለት ፡ እኪተ ፡ ያድኅኖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያዐቅቦ ፡ ወያሐይዎ ፡ ወያበጽዖ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር 
ወኢያገብኦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ጸላኢሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይረድኦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐራተ ፡ ሕማሙ 
ወይመይጥ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምስካቤሁ ፡ እምደዌሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ እቤ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ 
ወስረይ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እስመ ፡ አበስኩ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

verses.textGeez:
ጸላእትየሰ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ማእዜ ፡ ይመውት ፡ ወይሰዐር ፡ ስሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.textGeez:
ወይባእ ፡ ወይርአይ ፡ ዘከንቶ ፡ ይነብብ ፡
ልቡ ፡ አስተጋብአ ፡ ኃጢአተ ፡ ላዕሌሁ
verses.textEnglish: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

verses.textGeez: ይወፅእ ፡ አፍአ ፡ ወይትናገር ።
verses.textEnglish: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.textGeez: ወየኀብር ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወይትቃጸቡኒ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ ወይመክሩ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ላዕሌየ
verses.textEnglish: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

verses.textGeez: ነገረ ፡ ጌጋየ ፡ አውፅኡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ዘኖመሰ ፡ ኢይነቅህኑ ፡ እንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

verses.textGeez:
ብእሴ ፡ ሰላምየ ፡ ዘኪያሁ ፡ እትአመን ፡
ዘይሴስይ ፡ እክልየ አንሥአ ፡ ሰኰናሁ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.textGeez: እንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ ፡ ወአንሥአኒ ፡ እፍድዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእንተዝ ፡ አእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠመርከኒ 
ወኢተፈሥሑ ፡ ጸላእትየ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ወሊተሰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ የዋሀትየ ፡ ተወከፍከኒ 
ወአጽናዕከኒ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ለይኩን ፡ ለይኩን ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፪ - ከመ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ ኀየል ፡ ኀበ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ማያት
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 42 - Send Out Your Light and Your Truth
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘበአእምሮ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ።

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ ኀየል ፡ ኀበ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ማያት 
ከማሁ ፡ ታፈቅር ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

verses.textGeez:
ጸምአት ፡ ነፍስይ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ሕያው 
ማእዜ ፡ እበጽሕ ፡ ወእሬኢ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ለአምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.textGeez:
ሲሳየ ፡ ኮነኒ ፡ አንብዕየ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ ወሌሊተ 
እስመ ፡ ይብሉኒ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አይቴ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.textGeez:
ዘንተ ፡ ተዘኪርየ ፡ ተክዕወት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በላዕሌየ ፡
እስመ ፡ እበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካነ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.textGeez: በቃለ ፡ አሚን ፡ ወትፍሥሕት ፡ ደምፁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ በዓለ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.textGeez: ለምንት ፡ ትቴክዚ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ተሀውክኒ 7 እመኒ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ሎቱ መድኀኔ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.textGeez:
ተሀውከት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
በእንተዝ ፡ እዜከረከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡
በምድረ ፡ ዮርዳኖስ ፡ በአርሞንኤም ፡ በደብር ፡ ንኡስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

verses.textGeez: ቀላይ ፡ ለቀላይ ፡ ትጼውዓ ፡ በቃለ ፡ አስራቢከ
verses.textEnglish: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

verses.textGeez: ኵሉ ፡ ማዕበልከ ፡ ወሞገድከ ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ኀለፈ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.textGeez: መዐልተ ፡ ይኤዝዝ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ ወሌሊተ ፡ ይነብር 12 እምኀቤየ ፡ ብፅአተ ፡ ሕይወትየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።እብሎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትረስዐኒ
verses.textEnglish: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

verses.textGeez: ለምንት ፡ ተኀድገኒ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ትኩዝየ ፡ አንሶሱ ፡ሶበ ፡ ያመነድቡኒ ፡ ፀርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.textGeez:
ወያጸንጵዉኒ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡
ወይጼእሉኒ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ይብሉኒ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አይቴ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክከ ።ለምንት ፡ ትቴክዚ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ተሀውክኒ
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.textGeez: እመኒ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ሎቱ መድኀኔ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፫ - ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወተበቀል ፡ በቀልየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፵፫ (43) - አቤቱ ፥ ፍረድልኝ ፥ ከጽድቅ፡ከራቁ፡ሕዝብም፡ክርክሬን፡ተከራከር...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 43 - Come to Our Help
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወተበቀል ፡ በቀልየ ፡
እምሕዝብ ፡ ውፁኣን ፡ እምጽድቅ 
እምብእሲ ፡ ዐማፂ ፡ ወጽልሕው ፡ ባልሐኒ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኀይልየ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ተኀድገኒ ወለምንት ፡ ትኩዝየ ፡ ኣንሶሱ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ያመነድቡኒ ፡ ፀርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.textGeez:
ፈኑ ፡ ብርሃነከ ፡ ወጽድቀከ ፡
እማንቱ ፡ ይምርሓኒ ወይስዳኒ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅደስከ ፡
ወውስተ ፡ አብያቲከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

verses.textGeez:
ወእበውእ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምሥዋዒሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
ኀበ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ዘአስተፈሥሓ ፡ ለውርዙትየ
verses.textEnglish: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

verses.textGeez: እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ በመሰንቆ ።ለምንት ፡ ትቴክዚ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ወለምንት ፡ ተሀውክኒ
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.textGeez: እመኒ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ወድኀኔ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፬ - እግዚኦ ፡ ሰማዕነ ፡ በእዘኒነ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 44 - Your Throne, O God, is Forever
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ መዝሙር ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ሰማዕነ ፡ በእዘኒነ ፡
ወአበዊነሂ ፡ ዜነዉነ ።
verses.textEnglish: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

verses.textGeez: ግብረ ፡ ዘገበርከ ፡ በመዋዕሊሆሙ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ ትካት ።
verses.textEnglish: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.textGeez:
እዴከ ፡ ሠረወቶሙ ፡ ለፀር ፡ ወተከልከ ፡ ኪያሆሙ 
ሣቀይኮሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ወሰደድኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአኮ ፡ በኲናቶሙ ፡ ወረስዋ ፡ ለምድር ፡
ወመዝራዕቶሙ ፡ ኢያድኀኖሙ
verses.textEnglish: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.textGeez: ዘእንበለ ፡ የማንከ ፡ ወመዝራዕትከ ፡ ወብርሃነ ፡ ገጽከ ፡እስመ ፡ ተሣሀልኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ንጉሥየ ፡ ወአምላኪየ 
ዘአዘዝከ ፡ መድኀኒቶ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.textGeez:
ብከ ፡ ንወግኦሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ፀርነ 
ወበስምከ ፡ ናኀስሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌነ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአኮ ፡ በቀስትየ ፡ እትአመን 
ወኲናትየኒ ፡ ኢይድኀነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኀንከነ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ሮዱነ 
ወአስተኀፈርኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትነ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ንከብር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ 
ወለስምከ ፡ ንገኒ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.textGeez:
ይእዜሰ ፡ ገደፍከነ ፡ ወአስተኀፈርከነ 
ወኢትወፅእ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይልነ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

verses.textGeez: ወአግባእከነ ፡ ድኅሬነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፀርነ ወተማሰጡነ ፡ ጸላእትነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀብከነ ፡ ይብልዑነ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዕ 
ወዘረውከነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.textGeez:
መጦከ ፡ ሕዝበከ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሤጥ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ለይባቤነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.textGeez:
ረሰይከነ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ለጎርነ 
ሠሓቀ ፡ ወሥላቀ ፡ ለአድያሚነ ።
verses.textEnglish: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰይከነ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ለአሕዛብ 
ወሑስተ ፡ ርእስ ፡ ለሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኀፍረትየ 
ወከደነኒ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ገጽየ ።
verses.textEnglish: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

verses.textGeez:
እምቃለ ፡ ዘይጽእል ፡ ወይዘረኪ 
እምገጸ ፡ ፀራዊ ፡ ዘይረውድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

verses.textGeez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወኢረሳዕናከ ፡
ወኢዐመፅነ ፡ ኪዳነከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢገብአ ፡ ድኀሬሁ ፡ ልብነ 
ወኢተግሕሠ ፡ አሰርነ ፡ እምፍኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አሕመምከነ ፡ በብሔር ፡ እኩይ 
ወደፈነነ ፡ ጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበሁ ፡ ረሳዕነ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ለአምላክነ 
ወሶበሁ ፡ አንሣእነ ፡ እደዊነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ነኪር ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.textGeez:
አኮኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምተኃሠሦ ፡ ለዝንቱ 
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ኀቡኣተ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በእንቲአከ ፡ ይቀትሉነ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡
ወኮነ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ዘይጠብሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.textGeez:
ንቃህ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትነውም ፡
ተንሥእ ፡ ወኢትግድፈነ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወለምንት ፡ ትመይጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔነ 
ወትረስዐነ ፡ ሕማመነ ፡ ወተጽናሰነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀስረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ነፍስነ 
ወጠግዐት ፡ በምድር ፡ ከርሥነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ርድአነ 
ወአድኅነነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፭ - ጐሥዐ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሠናየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 45 - God is Our Refuge and Strength
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እለ ፡ ተበዐዱ ፡ ዘውሉደ ፡ ቆሬ ፤ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ።

verses.textGeez:
ጐሥዐ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ሠናየ ፡
አነ ፡ ኣየድዕ ፡ ግብርየ ፡ ለንጉሥ
verses.textEnglish: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ቀለመ ፡ ጸሓፊ ፡ ዘጠበጠበ ፡ ይጽሕፍ ፡ ልሳንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ይሤኒ ፡ ላሕዩ ፡ እምውሉደ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ተክዕወ ፡ ሞገስ ፡ እምከናፍሪከ 
በእንተዝ ፡ ባረከከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.textGeez: ቅንት ፡ ሰይፈከ ፡ ኀይል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቌከ
verses.textEnglish: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

verses.textGeez: በሥንከ ፡ ወበላሕይከ ።አርትዕ ፡ ተሠራሕ ፡ ወንገሥ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

verses.textGeez: በእንተ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ወርትዕ ፡ ወየዋሃት ወይመርሐከ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ የማንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

verses.textGeez:
አሕጻከ ፡ ስሑል ፡ ኀያል ፡
አሕዛብ ፡ ይወድቁ ፡ ታሕቴከ 
ውስተ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ለጸላእተ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.textGeez:
ወንበርከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
በትረ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ በትረ ፡ መንግሥትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

verses.textGeez:
አፍቀርከ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ወዐመፃ ፡ ጸላእከ ፡
በእንተዝ ፡ ቀብአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ 
ቅብአ ፡ ትፍሥሕት ፡ እምእለ ፡ ከማከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.textGeez:
ከርቤ ፡ ወቀንአተ ፡ ወሰሊኆት ፡ እምነ ፡ አልባሲከ 
እምክቡዳነ ፡ አቅርንት ፡ ዘእምኔሆሙ ፡ አስተፈሥሓከ ፡
አዋልደ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ለክብርከ
verses.textEnglish: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

verses.textGeez: ወትቀውም ፡ ንግሥት ፡ በየማንከ ፡በአልባሰ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ዑጽፍት ፡ ወሑብርት ።
verses.textEnglish: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዒ ፡ ወለትየ ፡ ወርእዪ ፡ ወአፅምዒ ፡ እዝነኪ 
ወርስዒ ፡ ሕዝበኪ ፡ ወቤተ ፡ አቡኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ፈተወ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሥነኪ 
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚእኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሰግዳ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ጠሮስ ፡ በአምኃ ፡
ወለገጽኪ ፡ ይትመሀለሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ብዑላነ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ክብራ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሐሴቦን 
በዘአዝፋረ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ዑጽፍት ፡ ወሑብርት ።
verses.textEnglish: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወስዱ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ደናግለ ፡ ድኅሬሃ 
ወቢጻሂ ፡ ይወስዱ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወስድዎን ፡ በትፍሥሕት ፡ ወበሐሤት 
ወያበውእዎን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ህየንተ ፡ አበዊኪ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ ለኪ ፡ ደቂቅ 
ወትሠይምዮሙ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez: ወይዘከሩ ፡ ስመኪ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ
verses.textEnglish: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez: በእንተዝ ፡ ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፮ - አምላክነሰ ፡ ኀይልነ ፡ ወጸወንነ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 46 - God is King Over All the Earth
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኅቡኣት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አምላክነሰ ፡ ኀይልነ ፡ ወጸወንነ 
ወረዳኢነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በምንዳቤነ ፡ ዘረከበነ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተዝ ፡ ኢንፈርህ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር 
ወእመኒ ፡ ፈለሱ ፡ አድባር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.textGeez:
ደምፁ ፡ ወተሐመጉ ፡ ማያቲሆሙ 
ወአድለቅለቁ ፡ አድባር ፡ እምኀይሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ፈለግ ፡ ዘይውሕዝ ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ቀደሰ ፡ ማኅድሮ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማእከላ ፡ ኢትትሀወክ 
ወይረድኣ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፍጹመ ።
verses.textEnglish: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

verses.textGeez:
ደንገፁ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወተመይጡ ፡ ነገሥት 
ወሀበ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ወአድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ምስሌነ 
ወምስካይነ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ንዑ ፡ ወትርአዩ ፡ ገብሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ዘገብረ ፡ መንክረ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
ይስዕር ፡ ፀብአ ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር
verses.textEnglish: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

verses.textGeez: ይሰብር ፡ ቀስተ ፡ ወይቀጠቅጥ ፡ ወልታ ፡ወያውዒ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ሐቅል ።
verses.textEnglish: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

verses.textGeez:
አስተርክቡ ፡ ወአእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ተለዐልኩ ፡ እምአሕዛብ ፡ ወተለዐልኩ ፡ እምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ምስሌነ 
ወምስካይነ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፯ - ኵልክሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ጥፍሑ ፡ እደዊክሙ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 47 - Great is the Lord in the City of God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ።

verses.textGeez:
ኵልክሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ጥፍሑ ፡ እደዊክሙ 
ወየብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በቃለ ፡ ትፍሥሕት ።
verses.textEnglish: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ወግሩም ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወንጉሥ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.textGeez: አግረረ ፡ ለነ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወሕዘበ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ እገሪነ ፡
verses.textEnglish: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.textGeez: ወኀረየነ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለርስቱ ሥኖ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ዘአፍቀረ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዐርገ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በይባቤ 
ወእግዚእነ ፡ በቃለ ፡ ቀርን ።
verses.textEnglish: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.textGeez: ዘምሩ ፡ ለአምላክነ ፡ ዘምሩ ዘምሩ ፡ ለንጉሥነ ፡ ዘምሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡
ዘምሩ ፡ ልብወ ።
verses.textEnglish: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

verses.textGeez:
ነግሠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ 
እግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበሩ ፡ ቅዱስ ።
verses.textEnglish: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.textGeez:
መላእክተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አምላከ ፡ አብርሃም 
እስመ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ጽኑዓነ ፡ ምድር ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ተለዐሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፰ - ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብዙኅ ፡ አኰቴቱ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 48 - Why Should I Fear in Times of Trouble?
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ በሳኒታ ፡ ሰንበት ።

verses.textGeez:
ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብዙኅ ፡ አኰቴቱ 
በሀገረ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ በደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይዔዝዝ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ፡ ለኰሉ ፡ ምድር 
አድባረ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ በገቦ ፡ መስዕ ፡
ሀገሩ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያአምር ፡ ክበዲሃ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመጠውዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ተጋብኡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.textGeez:
