እሙንቱሰ ፡ ዝንተ ፡ ርእዮሙ ፡ አንከሩ 
ደንገፁ ፡ ወፈርሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.textGeez:
ወአኀዞሙ ፡ ረዐድ ፡
ወሐሙ ፡ በህየ ፡ ከመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትወልድ ።
በነፋስ ፡ ኀያል ፡ ትቀጠቅጦን ፡ ለአሕማረ ፡ ተርሴስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.textGeez:
በከመ ፡ ሰማዕነ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ርኢነ ፡
በሀገረ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ በሀገረ ፡ አምላክነ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሳረራ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.textGeez: ተወከፍነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ሣህለከ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ሕዝብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ስምከ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር 
ጽድቅ ፡ ምሉእ ፡ የማንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሓ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወይትሐሠያ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ይሁዳ 
በእንተ ፡ ፍትሕከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ዕግትዋ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወሕቀፍዋ 
ወተናገሩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መኃፍዲሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ደዩ ፡ ልበክሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኀይላ 
ወትትካፈልዎ ፡ ለክበዲሃ 
ከመ ፡ ትንግሩ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክነ ፡
ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም
verses.textEnglish: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.textGeez: ወውእቱ ፡ ይሬዕየነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፵፱ - በበ ፡ በሐውርቲክሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፵፱ (49) - አሕዛብ፡ዅላችኹ ፥ ይህን፡ስሙ በዓለም፡የምትኖሩትም፡ዅላችኹ ፥ አድምጡ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 49 - The Mighty One, God the Lord, Speaks
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።1  ስምዑ ፡ ዝንተ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፤ ወአፅምኡ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዓለም ።

verses.textGeez:
በበ ፡ በሐውርቲክሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው 
አብዕልትኒ ፡ ወነዳይኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

verses.textGeez: አፉየ ፡ ይነግር ፡ ጥበበ ወሕሊና ፡ ልብየ ፡ ምክረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.textGeez:
ኣፀምእ ፡ ምሳሌ ፡ በእዘንየ 
ወእከሥት ፡ በመዝሙር ፡ ነገርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ እፈርህ ፡ እምዕለት ፡ እኪት 
ኃጢአተ ፡ ሰኰናየ ፡ ዐገተኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይትአመኑ ፡ በኀይሎሙ 
ወይዜሀሩ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ብዕሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.textGeez:
እኍኒ ፡ ኢያድኅን ፡ እኅዋሁ ፡ ወኢያድኅን ፡ ሰብእ 
ወኢይሁብ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ቤዛሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.textGeez:
ወኢተውላጠ ፡ ሤጠ ፡ ነፍሱ ፡
ዘጻመወ ፡ ለዓለም ፡
verses.textEnglish: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.textGeez: የሐዩ ፡ ለዝሉፉ እስመ ፡ ኢይሬኢ ፡ መስና ።ሶበ ፡ ትሬእዮሙ ፡ ለጠቢባን ፡ ይመውቱ ፡
verses.textEnglish: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

verses.textGeez: መከማሁ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ ፡ አብዳን ፡ እለ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ልበ ወየኀድጉ ፡ ለባዕድ ፡ ብዕሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.textGeez:
ወመቃብሪሆሙ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡
ወማኅደሪሆሙ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ 
ወይሰምዩ ፡ አስማቲሆሙ ፡ በበ ፡ በሐውርቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰብእሰ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኢያእመረ 
ወኮነ ፡ ከመ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ልበ ፡ ወተመሰሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.textGeez:
ለሊሃ ፡ ፍኖቶሙ ፡ ዕቅፍቶሙ ፡
ወእንዘ ፡ ይሠምሩ ፡ በአፉሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ሞት ፡ ይሬዕዮሙ ፡ በሲኦል 15 ወይቀንይዎሙ ፡ ራትዓን ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ወትበሊ ፡ ረድኤቶሙ ፡ በሲኦል ፡ እምክብሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወባሕቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያድኅና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ሲኦል ሶበ ይነሥኡኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትፍርሆ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብዕል 
ወሶበ ፡ ይበዝኅ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ቤቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢይነሥእ ፡ መስሌሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ እመ ፡ ይመውት 
ወኢይወርድ ፡ መስሌሁ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ቤቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ፈግዐት ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ በሕይወቱ 
የአምነከ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ታሤኒ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወርድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዓለመ ፡ አበዊሁ 
ወኢይሬኢ ፡ እንከ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

verses.textGeez:
ወእጓለ ፡ እመሕያውሰ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኢያእምረ 
ወኮነ ፡ ከመ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ልበ ፡ ወተመሰሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶ - አምላከ ፡ አማልክት ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነበበ ፡ ወጸውዓ ፡ ለምድር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 50 - Create in Me a Clean Heart, O God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez: አምላከ ፡ አማልክት ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነበበ ፡ ወጸውዓ ፡ ለምድር
verses.textEnglish: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.textGeez: እምሥራቀ ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ እስከነ ፡ ዐረብ ።ወእምጽዮን ፡ ሥነ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ገሀደ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡ወአምላክነሂ ፡ ኢያረምም
verses.textEnglish: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.textGeez: እሳት ፡ ይነድድ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ወዐውድዶሂ ፡ ዐውሎ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.textGeez:
ይጼውዓ ፡ ለሰማይ ፡ በላዕሉ 
ወለምድርኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኰንን ፡ ሕዝቦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.textGeez:
አስተጋብኡ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ጻድቃኑ 
እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ዘበሕጉ ።
verses.textEnglish: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ይነግራ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ዚአሁ 
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መኰንን ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textAmharic: ሕዝቤ ፥ ስማኝ ፥ ልንገርኽ እስራኤልም ፥ ስማኝ ፥ ልመስክርብኽ አምላክስ፡እኔ፡አምላክኽ፡ነኝ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ወእንግርከ ፡
እስራኤል ፡ ወኣሰምዕ ፡ ለከ 
አምላክከሰ ፡ አምላክ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

verses.textGeez:
አኮ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መሥዋዕትከ ፡ ዘእዛለፈከ 
ወቍርባንከኒ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይነሥእ ፡ አልህምተ ፡ እምቤትከ 
ወኢሐራጊት ፡ እመርዔትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አራዊት ፡ ዘገዳም 
እንስሳ ፡ ገዳምኒ ፡ ወአልህምት ።
verses.textEnglish: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.textGeez:
ወኣአምር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ 
ወሥነ ፡ ገዳምኒ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ሀሎ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ርኀብኩ ፡ ኢይስእለከ 
እስመ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ፡ በምልኡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.textGeez: ኢይበልዕ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ላህም ወኢይሰቲ ፡ ደመ ፡ ጠሊ ።
verses.textEnglish: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

verses.textGeez:
ሡዕ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ስብሐት 
ወሀቦ ፡ ለልዑል ፡ ጸሎተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.textGeez: ትጼውዐኒ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ መንዳቤከ ፡ ኣድኅነከ ፡ ወታአኵተኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.textGeez:
ወለኃጥእሰ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ለምንት ፡ ለከ ፡ ትነግር ፡ ሕግየ 
ወትነሥእ ፡ በአፉከ ፡ ሥርዕትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ ጸላእከ ፡ ተግሣጽየ 
ወአግባእከ ፡ ድኅሬከ ፡ ቃልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ርኢከ ፡ ሰራቄ ፡ ትረውጽ ፡ ምስሌሁ 
ወረሰይከ ፡ መክፈልተከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዘማውያን ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

verses.textGeez:
አፉከ ፡ አብዝኃ ፡ ለእኪት 
ወልሳንከ ፡ ፀፈራ ፡ ለሕብል ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

verses.textGeez:
ትነብር ፡ ወተሐምዮ ፡ ለእኁከ 
ወአንበርከ ፡ ዕቅፍተ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ እምከ ።
ዝንተ ፡ ገቢረክ ፡ አርመምኩ ፡ ለከ ፡
verses.textEnglish: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

verses.textGeez: አደመተከኒ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ሐዘብከኑ ፡ እኩን ፡ ከማከ እዛለፍከኑ ፡ ወእቁም ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.textGeez:
ለብዉ ፡ ዘንተ ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትረስዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወእመአኮሰ ፡ ይመስጥ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያድኅን ።
verses.textEnglish: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

verses.textGeez:
መሥዋዕት ፡ ክብርት ፡ ትሴብሐኒ 
ህየ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ አርአየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አድኅኖቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፩ - ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ሣህልከ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 51 - The Steadfast Love of God Endures
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ። አመ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ናታን ፡ ነቢይ   ዘአመ ፡ ቦአ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ለአበሳቢ ።

verses.textGeez: ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ሣህልከ
verses.textEnglish: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.textGeez: ወበከመ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ መሕረትከ ፡ ደምስስ ፡ ኃጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.textGeez: ኅፅበኒ ፡ ወአንጽሐኒ ፡ እምኀጢአትየ ወእምአበሳየኒ ፡ አንጽሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ለልየ ፡ ኣአምር ፡ ጌጋይየ 
ወኀጢአትየኒ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

verses.textGeez:
ለከ ፡ ለባሕቲትከ ፡ አበስኩ ፡ ወእኩየኒ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ገበርኩ 
ከመ ፡ ትጽደቅ ፡ በነቢብከ ፡ ወትማእ ፡ በኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ በኀጢአት ፡ ተፀነስኩ 
ወበዐመፃ ፡ ወለደተኒ ፡ እምየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ አፍቀርከ 
ዘኢይትነበብ ፡ ኅቡአ ፡ ጥበብከ ፡ አይዳዕከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.textGeez:
ትነዝኀኒ ፡ በአዛብ ፡ ወእነጽሕ 
ተኀፅበኒ ፡ እምበረድ ፡ እጸዐዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
ታሰምዐኒ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ፡ ወሐሤተ 
ወይትፌሥሑ ፡ አዕጽምተ ፡ ጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

verses.textGeez:
ሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኀጢአትየ 
ወደምስስ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አበሳየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.textGeez:
ልበ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ፍጥር ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወመንፈሰ ፡ ርቱዐ ፡ ሐድስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሥየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትግድፈኒ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ 
ወመንፈሰከ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ኢታውፅእ ፡ እምላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

verses.textGeez:
ዕስየኒ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ 
ወበመንፈስ ፡ ዐዚዝ ፡ አጽንዐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ እምሀሮሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ ፈኖተከ 
ወረሲዓን ፡ ይትመየጡ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምደም ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ 
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ልሳንየ ፡ በጽድቀ ፡ ዚአከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ ትከሥት ፡ ከናፍርየ ወአፉየ ፡ ያየድዕ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበሰ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፡ መሥዋዕተኒ ፡ እምወሀብኩ 
ወጽንሓሕኒ ፡ ኢትሠምር ።
verses.textEnglish: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

verses.textGeez:
መሥዋዕቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ መንፈስ ፡ የዋህ 
ልበ ፡ ትሑተ ፡ ወየዋሀ ፡ ኢይሜንን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.textGeez:
አሠንያ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በሥምረትከ ፡ ለጽዮን 
ወይትሐንጻ ፡ አረፋቲሃ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

verses.textGeez:
አመ ፡ ትሠምር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡
መባአኒ ፡ ወቍርባነኒ 
አሜሃ ፡ ያዐርጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምሥዋዒከ ፡ አልህምተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፪ - ለምንት ፡ ይዜሀር ፡ ኀያል ፡ በእከዩ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 52 - There is None Who Does Good
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበአእምሮ ፡ ዘዳዊት ። ዘአመ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ዶይቅ ፡ ኤዶማዊ ፡ ወነገሮ ፡ ለሳኦል   ወይቤሎ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ለአቤሜሌክ ።

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ ይዜሀር ፡ ኀያል ፡ በእከዩ 
ወይዔምፅ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

verses.textGeez:
ኀጢአተ ፡ ሐለየ ፡ ልብከ 
ከመ ፡ መላፄ ፡ በሊኅ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ሕብለ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.textGeez:
አብደርከ ፡ እኪተ ፡ እምሠናይት 
ወትዔምፅ ፡ እምትንብብ ፡ ጽድቀ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወአፍቀርከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ልሳን ፡ መስጥም ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተዝ ፡ ይነሥተከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዝሉፉ 
ይመልሐከ ፡ ወያፈልሰከ ፡ እምቤትከ ፡
ወሥርወከኒ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ሕያዋን ።
verses.textAmharic: ስለዚህ ፥ እግዚአብሔር፡ለዘለዓለም፡ያፈርስኻል ከቤትኽም፡ይነቅልኻል ፥ ያፈልስኻልም ፥ ሥርኽንም፡ከሕያዋን፡ ምድር።
verses.textEnglish: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ይርአዩ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ወይፍርሁ ፡
ወይስሐቁ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወይበሉ ።
ነዋ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኢረሰዮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ረዳኢሁ
verses.textEnglish: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.textGeez: ወተአመነ ፡ በብዝኀ ፡ ብዑሉ ወተኀየለ ፡ በከንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ዘይት ፡ ስሙር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወተወከልኩ ፡ በምሕረቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ እስመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ሊተ 
ወእሴፈዋ ፡ ለምሕረትከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናያቲከ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጻድቃኒከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፫ - ይብል ፡ አብድ ፡ በልቡ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 53 - Save Me, O God, by Your Name
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘአመ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: ይብል ፡ አብድ ፡ በልቡ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

verses.textGeez: ኀስሩ ፡ ወረኵሱ ፡ በጌጋዮሙአልቦ ፡ ዘይገብራ ፡ ለሠናይት ።
verses.textEnglish: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሐወጸ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ዲበ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው 
ከመ ፡ ይርአይ ፡ እመቦ ፡ ጠቢበ ዘየኀሦ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ዐረየ ፡ ወኅቡረ ፡ ዐለወ 
አልቦ ፡ ዘይገብራ ፡ ለሠናይት አልቦ ፡ ወኢአሐዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢያአምሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
እለ ፡ ይውኅጥዎሙ ፡ ለሕዝብየ ፡ ከመ ፡ በሊዐ ፡ እክል
verses.textEnglish: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

verses.textGeez: ወለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢጸውዕዎ ።ወበህየ ፡ ፈርሁ ፡ ወገረሞሙ ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ግሩመ
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘረወ ፡ አዕጽምቲሆሙ ፡ ለመዳልዋን ፡ወተኀፍሩ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አኅሰሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ እምጽዮን ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ልእስራኤል 
አመ ፡ ሜጠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፄዋ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

verses.textGeez: ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወይትሐሠይ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፬ - እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፬ (54) - አቤቱ ፥ በስምኽ፡አድነኝ ፥ በኀይልኽም፡ፍረድልኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 54 - Cast Your Burden on the Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘአመ ፡ መጽኡ ፡ ዜፌዊያን ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለሳኦል ፤ ናሁ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ይትኀባእ ፡ ኀቤነ ።1  እግዚኦ ፡ በስምከ ፡ አድኅነኒ ፤ ወበኀይልከ ፡ ፍታሕ ፡ ሊተ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወአፅምእ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ነኪራን ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡
ወኀያላን ፡ ኀሠሥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወኢረሰይዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይረድአኒ 
ወእግዚእየ ፡ ያድኅና ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወይመይጣ ፡ ለእኪት ፡ ዲበ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ወበጽድቅከ ፡ ሠርዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.textGeez:
ዘእምፈቃድየ ፡ እሠውዕ ፡ ለከ 
እገኒ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እምኵሎ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ አድኀንከኒ 
ወርእየት ፡ ዐይንየ ፡ በጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፭ - አፅምአኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፭ (55) - አቤቱ ፥ ጸሎቴን፡አድምጥ ፥ ልመናዬንም፡ቸል፡አትበል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 55 - In God I Trust, I Shall Not Be Afraid
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አፅምአኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወኢትትሀየየኒ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
ነጽረኒ ፡ ወስምዐኒ
verses.textEnglish: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.textGeez: ተከዝኩ ፡ ወደንገፅኩ ፡ ወተዛዋዕኩ ።እምቃለ ፡ ጸላኢ ፡ ወእምሥቃየ ፡ ኃጥእ
verses.textEnglish: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ሜጥዋ ፡ ለዐመፃ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ወቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ያመንስዉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.textGeez:
ወደንገፀኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
ወመጽአኒ ፡ ድንጋፄ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.textGeez: ፍርሀት ፡ ወረዐድ ፡ አኀዘኒ ወደፈነኒ ፡ ጽልመት ።
verses.textEnglish: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤ ፡ መኑ ፡ ይሁበኒ ፡ ክንፈ ፡ ከመ ፡ ርጌብ 
እሥርር ፡ ወኣዕርፍ ።
verses.textEnglish: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ አርሐቁ ፡ ተኀጥኦ ወቤትኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በድው ።
verses.textEnglish: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
እሴፈዎ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ያድኅነኒ 
እምዕንባዜ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐውሎ ።
verses.textEnglish: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.textGeez:
አስጥሞሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወምትር ፡ ልሳናቲሆሙ 
እስመ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ወቅሥተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገር ።
verses.textEnglish: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ ወሌሊተ ፡ ዕጉት ፡ ውስተ ፡ አረፋቲሃ 
ዐመፃ ፡ ወስራሕ ፡ ወኀጢአት ፡ ማእከላ ።
verses.textEnglish: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.textGeez: ወኢይርሕቅ ፡ እመርሕባ ፡ ጕሕሉት ።
verses.textEnglish: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.textGeez: ሶበሰ ፡ ጸላኢ ፡ ጸአለኒ ፡ እምተዐገሥኩ
verses.textEnglish: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.textGeez: ውሶበሂ ፡ ጸላኢ ፡ አዕበየ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ እምተኀባእክዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

verses.textGeez: ወአንተሰ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ነፍስየ ማእምርየ ፡ ወዐውቅየ ።
verses.textEnglish: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

verses.textGeez:
ዘኅቡረ ፡ አስተጠዐምከ ፡ ሊተ ፡ መባልዕተ 
ወነሐውር ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በአሐዱ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.textGeez: ይምጽኦሙ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወይረዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ፡ ሕያዋኒሆሙ
verses.textEnglish: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ማእከሎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ወአምላኪየ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ።19 ሰርከ ፡ ወነግሀ ፡ ወመዐልተ ፡ እነግር ፡ ወኣየድዕ 
ወይሰምዐኒ ፡ ቃልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅና ፡ በሰላም ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ይትቃረቡኒ 
እስመ ፡ ይበዝኁ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ምስሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

verses.textGeez:
ይስማዕ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወያኅስሮሙ 
ዘሀሎ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ይትፈጠር ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ቤዛ ፡ ወኢፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
ወሰፍሐ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለፍድይ ።
verses.textEnglish: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርኰሱ ፡ ሥርዐቶ ።
ወተናፈቁ ፡ እምዐተ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ወቀርበ ፡ ልቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.textGeez:
ወጽሕደ ፡ እምቅብእ ፡ ነገሩ ፡
እሙንቱሰ ፡ ማዕበል ፡ ያስጥሙ ።
verses.textAmharic: አንተ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ወደሞት፡ጕድጓድ፡ታወርዳቸዋለኽ የደም፡ሰዎችና፡ሸንጋዮች፡ዘመናቸው፡ግማሽ፡አይሞላ ም እኔ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ እታመንኻለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.textGeez:
ግድፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሕሊናከ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ይሴስየከ 
ወኢይሁቦ ፡ ሁከተ ፡ ለጻድቅ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textAmharic: አንተ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ወደሞት፡ጕድጓድ፡ታወርዳቸዋለኽ የደም፡ሰዎችና፡ሸንጋዮች፡ዘመናቸው፡ግማሽ፡አይሞላ ም እኔ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ እታመንኻለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.textGeez: አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አጽድፎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐዘቅተ ፡ ሞት ፡
verses.textAmharic: አንተ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ወደሞት፡ጕድጓድ፡ታወርዳቸዋለኽ የደም፡ሰዎችና፡ሸንጋዮች፡ዘመናቸው፡ግማሽ፡አይሞላ ም እኔ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ እታመንኻለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

verses.textGeez: ዕድው ፡ ደም ፡ ወጽልሕዋን ፡ ኢይነፍቁ ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ ወአንሰ ፡ ተወከልኩከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textAmharic: አንተ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ወደሞት፡ጕድጓድ፡ታወርዳቸዋለኽ የደም፡ሰዎችና፡ሸንጋዮች፡ዘመናቸው፡ግማሽ፡አይሞላ ም እኔ፡ግን ፥ አቤቱ ፥ እታመንኻለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፮ - ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኬደኒ ፡ ሰብእ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፮ (56) - አቤቱ ፥ ሰው፡ረግጦኛልና ፥ ማረኝ ዅልጊዜም፡በሰልፍ፡አስጨንቆኛል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 56 - My Heart is Steadfast, O God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ እምቅዱሳን ፡ ርሕቁ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ አርአያ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፤ ዘአመ ፡ አኀዝዎ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ በጌት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኬደኒ ፡ ሰብእ 
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አስርሐኒ ፡ ቀትል ።
verses.textEnglish: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኬዱኒ ፡ ፀርየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ በኑኀ ፡ ዕለት 
እስመ ፡ ብዙኃን ፡ እለ ፡ ፀብኡኒ ፡ ወፈራህኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

verses.textGeez: ወአንሰ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ ቃልየ 
ወበእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ኢይፈርህ ምንተ ፡ ይሬስየኒ ፡ ዘሥጋ ።
verses.textEnglish: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ያስቆርሩኒ ፡ ዘነበብኩ ።
ወላዕሌየ ፡ ይመክሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ እኩየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.textGeez:
ይጸንሑኒ ፡ ወይትኀብኡኒ ።
ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ሰኰናየ ፡ ያስተሓይጹኒ
verses.textEnglish: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.textGeez:
ወዘልፈ ፡ ይጸንሕዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።ወኢታድኅኖሙ ፡ ወኢበምንትኒ 
ወታጸድፎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ በመዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ እነግረከ ፡ ሕይወትየ 
ወአንበርኩ ፡ አንብዕየ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

verses.textGeez: ለይግብኡ ፡ ፀርየ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

verses.textGeez: አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እጼውዐከ ናሁ ፡ ኣእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ ።
verses.textEnglish: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ ቃልየ 
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይከብር ፡ ዘነበብኩ ።
ወበእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ኢይፈርህ ምንተ ፡ ይሬስየኒ ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.textGeez: እምኀቤይ ፡ እሁብ ፡ ብፅአትየ ፡ ለስብሓቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አድኀንካ ፡ እሞት ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡
ወለአዕይንትየኒ ፡ እምአንብዕ 
ወለእገርየኒ ፡ እምዳኅፅ ።
ከመ ፡ ኣሥምሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ሕያዋን ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፯ - ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፯ (57) - ማረኝ ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ማረኝ ፥ ነፍሴ፡አንተን፡ታምናለችና...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 57 - God Who Judges the Earth
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ኢታማስን ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ አርአያ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፤ ዘአመ ፡ ጐየ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ሳኦል ፡ ውስተ ፡ በአት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ ።
እስመ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከለት ፡ ነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

verses.textGeez: ወተወከልኩ ፡ በጽላሎተ ፡ ክንፊከ እስከ ፡ ተኀልፍ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.textEnglish: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

verses.textGeez:
እጸርኅ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ልዑል 
ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘረድአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወአድኀነኒ ፡
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ኀሳረ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ኬዱኒ
verses.textEnglish: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.textGeez:
ገነወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ ወጽድቆ ።ወአድኀና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምእከለ ፡ አናብስት ፡
ወኖምኩ ፡ ድንጉፅየ
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.textGeez: ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ፡ ስነኒሆሙ ፡ ሐጽ ፡ ወኲናት ፡ወልሳኖሙኒ ፡ በሊኅ ፡ መጥባሕት ።
verses.textEnglish: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት 
ወበኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.textGeez:
መሥገርተ ፡ አስተዳለዉ ፡ ለእገርየ ፡
ወቀጽዕዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.textGeez: ከሩዩ ፡ ግበ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ወወድቁ ፡ ውስቴቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

verses.textGeez: ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ እሴብሕ ፡ ወእዜምር ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትንሣእ ፡ ክብርየ ወይትንሣእ ፡ በመዝሙር ፡ ወበመሰንቆ 
ወእትንሣእ ፡ በጽባሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐብየት ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወእስከ ፡ ደመናት ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት 
ወበኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ስብሓቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፰ - እመሰ ፡ አማን ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ትነቡ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፰ (58) - በእውነት፡ጽድቅን፡ብትናገሩስ ፥ የሰው፡ልጆች፡ሆይ ፥ በቅን፡ትፈርዳላችኹ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 58 - Deliver Me from My Enemies, O God
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ኢታማስን ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ አርአያ ፡ መጽሐፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
እመሰ ፡ አማን ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ትነቡ 
ወርትዐ ፡ ትኴንኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እምሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በልብክሙ ፡ ኃጢአተ ፡ ትገብሩ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር 
ወጽልሑተ ፡ ይፀፍራ ፡ እደዊክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ተነክሩ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እማሕፀን 
እምከርሥ ፡ ስሕቱ ፡ ወነበቡ ፡ ሐሰተ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.textGeez:
ወመዐቶሙኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሕምዘ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር 
ከመ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ጽምምት ፡ እዘኒሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

verses.textGeez:
እንት ፡ ኢትሰምዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘይሬቅያ 
እንዘ ፡ ይሠርያ ፡ መሠርይ ፡ ጠቢብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሰብር ፡ ስነኒሆሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አፉሆሙ 
ወይሰብር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጥረሲሆሙ ፡ ለአናብስት ።
verses.textEnglish: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወየኀስሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዘይትከዐው 
ወይዌስቅ ፡ ቀስቶ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያደክዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.textGeez:
ወየኀልቁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰምዕ ፡ ዘይትመሰው 
ወድቀት ፡ እሳት ፡ ወኢርኢክዋ ፡ ለፀሐይ ።
verses.textEnglish: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

verses.textGeez:
ዘእንበለ ፡ ይትዐወቅ ፡ ሦክክሙ ፡ ሕለተ ፡ ኮነ ፡
ከመ ፡ ሕያዋን ፡ በመዐቱ ፡ ይውኅጠክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይሬኢ ፡ በቀለ 
ወይትኀፀብ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ በደመ ፡ ኃጥእ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ወይብል ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ እንጋ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ለጻድቅ 
ወቦኑ ፡ እንጋ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይፈትሕ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፶፱ - አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምፀርየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፶፱ (59) - አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ ከጠላቶቼ፡አድነኝ በላዬም፡ከቆሙት፡አስጥለኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 59 - With God We Shall Do Valiantly
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ኢታማስን ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ አርአየ ፡ ምስሐፍ ፤ አመ ፡ ፈነወ ፡ ሳኦል ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቅትሎ ።

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምፀርየ 
ወአንግፈኒ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.textGeez:
ወባልሐኒ ፡ እምገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ እምዕድወ ፡ ደም ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ናዐውዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ኀያላን
verses.textAmharic: እንሆ ፥ ነፍሴን፡ሸምቀውባታልና ፥ ብርቱዎችም፡በላዬ፡ተሰበሰቡ።አቤቱ ፥ በበደሌም፡አይደለም ፥ በኀጢአቴም፡አይ ደለም።
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.

verses.textGeez: አኮ ፡ በአበሳየ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ በጌጋይየ ፡ እግዚኦ ።ዘእንበለ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ሮጽኩ ፡ ወአርታዕኩ
verses.textEnglish: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.textGeez: ተንሥእ ፡ ተቀበለኒ ፡ ወርኢ ።አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
verses.textAmharic: አንተም፡አቤቱ ፥ የኀያላን፡አምላክ ፥ የእስራኤል፡አምላክ ፥ አሕዛብን፡ዅሉ፡ትጐበኛቸው፡ዘንድ፡ተነሥ ዐመፅ፡ የሚያደርጉትን፡ዅሉ፡አትማራቸው።
verses.textEnglish: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ሐውጾሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወተሣሀሎሙ ወኢትሣሀሎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.textGeez: ይትመየጡ ፡ ሰርከ ፡ ወይርኀቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ከልብ ወይዑዱ ፡ ሀገር ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ይነቡ ፡ በአፉሆሙ ፡ ወሰይፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ 
ወዘሂ ፡ ይሰምዖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትስሕቆሙ 
ወነንኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

verses.textGeez:
ኣምኀፅን ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ኀይልየ 
እስመ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወምስካይየ ፡ አንተ ።
ይብጽሐኒ ፡ ሣህሉ ፡ ለአምላኪየ
verses.textEnglish: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

verses.textGeez: አምላኪየ ፡ አርእየኒ ፡ በጸላእትየ ።ኢትቅትሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርስዑ ፡ ሕገከ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.textGeez: ዘርዎሙ ፡ በኀይልከ ፡ወአጽድፎሙ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወረዳእየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.textGeez:
ኀጢአተ ፡ አፉሆሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ 
ወይሠገሩ ፡ በትዕቢቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወበመርገሞሙ ፡ ወእምሐሰቶሙ ፡ ይትዐወቅ ፡ ደኃሪቶሙ ።
ወየኀልቁ ፡ በደኃሪ ፡ መቅሠፍት
verses.textEnglish: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.textGeez: ወያእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ይኴንን ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.textGeez:
ይትመየጡ ፡ ሰርከ ፡ ወይርኀቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ከልብ ፡ ወይዑዱ ፡ ሀገረ ።17 እሙንቱሰ ፡ ይዘረዉ ፡ ለበሊዕ 
ወእስመ ፡ ኢጸግቡ ፡ ወአንጐርጐሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ ለኀይልከ ፡
ወእትፌሣሕ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ በምሕረትከ
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ኮንከኒ ፡ ምስካይየ ፡ወጸወንየ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

verses.textGeez:
ረዳእየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወለከ ፡ እዜምር ፡ አምላኪየ 
እስመ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወምስካይየ ፡ አንተ ፡
አምላኪየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሣህልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷ - እግዚኦ ፡ ገደፍከነ ፡ ወነሠትከነ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷ (60) - አቤቱ ፥ ጣልኸን፡አፈረስኸንም ተቈጣኸን፡ይቅርም፡አልኸን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 60 - Lead Me to the Rock Higher Than I
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘእለ ፡ ተበዐዱ ፡ ዓዲ ፤ አርአየ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ለትምህርት ። ዘአመ ፡ አውዐየ ፡ መስጴጦምየ ፡ ዘሶርያ ፡ ወሶርያ ፡ ዘሶበል ፡ ወተመይጠ ፡ ዮአብ ፡ ወቀተለ ፡ በቈላቲሆም ፡ ካልኣን ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ወ ፪ ፻ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ገደፍከነ ፡ ወነሠትከነ 
ቀሠፍከነሂ ፡ ወተሣሀልከነ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.textGeez:
አድለቅለቃ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወሆካ 
ወፈወስከ ፡ ቍስላ ፡ እስመ ፡ ምንቀልቀለት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርአይኮሙ ፡ ዕፁባተ ፡ ለሕዝብከ 
ወአስተይከነ ፡ ወይነ ፡ መደንግፀ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀብኮሙ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ 
ከመ ፡ ያምስጡ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ ቀስት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወይድኀኑ ፡ ፍቁራኒከ 
አድኅን ፡ በየማንከ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነበበ ፡ በመቅደሱ ፡
እትፌሣሕ ፡ ወእትካፈል ፡ ምህርካ 
ወእሳፈር ፡ አዕጻደተ ፡ ቈላት ።
verses.textEnglish: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.textGeez:
ዚአየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ገላዐድ ፡ ወዚአየ ፡ ምናሴ 
ወኤፍሬም ፡ ምስማከ ፡ ርእስየ
verses.textEnglish: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.textGeez: ወይሁዳ ፡ ንጉሥየ ።ወሞአብ ፡ ካህን ፡ ተስፋየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

verses.textGeez: ዲበ ፡ አደምያስ ፡ እሰፍሕ ፡ መካይድየ ሊተ ፡ ይገንዩ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይወስደኒ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ጥቅም 
ወመኑ ፡ ይመርሐኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኢዶምያስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

verses.textGeez:
አኮኑ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዘገደፍከነ 
ወኢትወፅእ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይልን ።
verses.textEnglish: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.textGeez:
ሀበነ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ በምንዳቤነ 
ወከንቱ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ንገብር ፡ ኀይለ 
ወውእቱ ፡ ያኀስሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሣቅዩነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፩ - ስምዐኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ስእለትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷፩ (61) - አምላክ፡ሆይ ፥ ልመናዬን፡ስማ ፥ ጸሎቴንም፡አድምጥ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 61 - My Soul Waits for God Alone
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ስእለትየ 
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

verses.textGeez:
እምአጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ቀብጸኒ ፡ ልብየ 
ወእምእብን ፡ አልዐልከኒ ፡ ወመራሕከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተስፋየ ፡ ኮንከኒ 
ማኅፈድ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ ጸላኢ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.textGeez:
እነብር ፡ ቤተከ ፡ ለዓለም 
ወእትከደን ፡ በጽላሎተ ፡ ክነፊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወወሀብኮሙ ፡ ርስተ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

verses.textGeez:
እምዕለት ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ይዌስክ ፡ ንጉሥ 
ዐመቲሁ ፡ እስከ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ትውለደ ፡ ትውለድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

verses.textGeez:
ወይነብር ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
መኑ ፡ የኀሥሥ ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ ወጽድቆ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.textGeez:
ከመዝ ፡ እዜምር ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ለዓለም 
ከመ ፡ ተሀበኒ ፡ ተምኔትየ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፪ - አኮኑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ትገኒ ፡ ነፍስየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 62 - Your Steadfast Love is Better Than Life
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዝበእንተ ፡ ኢዶቱም ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አኮኑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ትገኒ ፡ ነፍስየ 
እስመ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ መድኀነትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ 
ወውእቱ ፡ ርዳእየ ፡ ወኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ትቀውሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡
ወትቀትልዎ ፡ ኵልክሙ 
ከመ ፡ አረፍት ፡ ጽንንት ፡ ወከመ ፡ ጥቅም ፡ ንሑል ።
verses.textEnglish: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ መከሩ ፡ ይስዐሩ ፡ ክብርየ ፡
ወሮጽኩ ፡ በጽምእየ 
በአፉሆሙ ፡ ይድሕሩ ፡ ወበልቦሙ ፡ ይረግሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ትገኒ ፡ ነፍስየ 
እስመ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ተስፋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ 
ወርዳእየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኢይትሀወክ ።
verses.textEnglish: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ መድኀነትየ ፡ ወበእግዚአብሔር ፡ ክብርየ 
አምላከ ፡ ረድኤትየ ፡ ወተስፋየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.textGeez:
ተወከሉ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ ማኅበሩ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡
ወከዐዉ ፡ ልበክሙ ፡ ቅድሜሁ 
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ርዳኢነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው፡
ሐሳውያን ፡ ደቂቀ ፡እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወይዔምፁ ፡ መዳልወ 
እሙንቱሰ ፡ እምከንቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ክመ ።
ከመ ፡ ኢትሰፈዉዋ ፡ ለዓመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትትአመንዎ ፡ ለሀይድ 
ብዕል ፡ ለእመ ፡ በዝኀ ፡ ኢታዕብዮ ፡ ልበክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

verses.textGeez:
ምዕረ ፡ ነበበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዘንተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰማዕኩ 
እስመ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህል ።
ወዚአከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኀይል 
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትፈድዮ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምግባሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፫ - አምላኪየ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ እገይስ ፡ ኀቤከ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷፫ (63) - አምላኬ ፥ አምላኬ ፥ ወዳንተ፡እገሠግሣለኹ ነፍሴ፡አንተን፡ተጠማች ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 63 - Hide Me from the Secret Plots
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፤ አመ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳመ ፡ ኢዶምያስ ።

verses.textGeez: አምላኪየ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ እገይስ ፡ ኀቤከ
verses.textAmharic: አምላኬ ፥ አምላኬ ፥ ወዳንተ፡እገሠግሣለኹ ነፍሴ፡አንተን፡ተጠማች ፥ ሥጋዬ፡አንተን፡እንዴት፡ናፈቀች፡ዕንጨት ና፡ውሃ፡በሌለበት፡በምድረ፡በዳ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.textGeez: ጸምአት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለከ እፎ ፡ እስፋሕ ፡ ለከ ፡ ሥጋየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

verses.textGeez:
በምደረ ፡ በድው ፡ ኀበ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ወማየ ።ከመዝ ፡ በመቅደስከ ፡ አስተርአይኩከ 
ከመ ፡ ኣእምር ፡ ኀይለከ ፡ ወስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ይኄይስ ፡ እምሐይው ፡ ሣህልከ 
ከናፍሪየ ፡ ይሴብሓከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ከመዝ ፡ እባርከከ ፡ በሕይወትየ 
ወበስመ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ ኣነሥእ ፡ እደውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ዘእምሥቡሕ ፡ ወእምአንጕዕ ፡ ጸግበት ፡ ነፍስይ 
ከናፍርየ ፡ ፍሡሓት ፡ ይሴብሓ ፡ ለስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

verses.textGeez:
ወበምስካብየኒ ፡ እዜክረከ 
ወጽባሕ ፡ ኣነብብ ፡ ለከ ።
እስመ ፡ ኮንከኒ ፡ ረዳእየ
verses.textEnglish: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
ወእትዌከል ፡ በጽላሎተ ፡ ክነፊከ ።ተለወት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ድኅሬከ 
ሊተሰ ፡ ተወክፈተኒ ፡ የማንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

verses.textGeez:
እሙንቱሰ ፡ ለከንተ ፡ ኀሠሥዌ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ለይባኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መዓምቅቲሃ ፡ ለምድር ።
ወይግብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ሰይፍ 
ክፍለ ፡ ቈናጽል ፡ ለይኩኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወንጉሥሰ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወይከብር ፡ ኵሉ ዘይምሕል ፡ ኪያሁ ።
እስመ ፡ ይትፈፀም ፡ አፍ ፡ ዘይነብብ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፬ - ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ዘሰአልኩ ፡ ኀቤከ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 64 - Praise is Due to You, O God, in Zion
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ዘሰአልኩ ፡ ኀቤከ 
እምትሕዝብተ ፡ ጽላኢ ፡ አድኅና ፡ ለነፍስይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰውረኒ ፡ እምዕሌቶሙ ፡ ለእኩያን 
ወእምብዝኆሙ ፡ ለገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ አብልኁ ፡ ልሳኖሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር 
ወወሰቁ ፡ ቀስቶሙ ፡ ለገቢረ ፡ መሪር ።
ከመ ፡ ይቅትልዎ ፡ ለንጹሕ ፡ በጽሚት
verses.textEnglish: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

verses.textGeez: ግብተ ፡ ይነድፍዎሙ ፡ ወኢይፈርሁ ።ወአጽንዑ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ነገረ ፡ እኩየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.textGeez: ወተማከሩ ፡ ይኅብኡ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ መሥገርተ ወይቤሉ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘይሬእየነ ።
verses.textEnglish: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.textGeez: ወኀሠሥዋ ፡ ለዐመፃ ፡ ወኀልቁ ፡ እዝነ ፡ ይፈትኑ ፡ ወይወጥኑ
verses.textEnglish: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

verses.textGeez: ወይበውእ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ በልብ ፡ ዕሙቅ ወይትሌዐል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ሐጸ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ኮነ ፡ መቅሠፍቶሙ ።
ወደክመ ፡ ለሳኖሙ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.textGeez: ወደንገፁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ርእይዎሙ ።ወፈርሁ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡
verses.textEnglish: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.textGeez: ወነገሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ወአእመሩ ፡ ምግባሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይትዌከል ፡ ቦቱ 
ወይከብሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፭ - ለከ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ በጽዮን
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷፭ (65) - አቤቱ ፥ በጽዮን፡ለአንተ፡ምስጋና፡ይገ፟ባ፟ል ፥ ለአንተም፡ጸሎት፡ይቀርባል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 65 - How Awesome are Your Deeds
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ለከ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ በጽዮን 
ወለከ ፡ ይትፌነው ፡ ጸሎት ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.textGeez: ስማዕ ፡ ጸሎተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ዘመጽአ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

verses.textGeez:
ነገረ ፡ ዐማፂያን ፡ ኀየለነ ፡
ወኀጢአትነሰ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትሰሪ ፡ ለነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ዘኀረይኮ ፡ ወዘተወከፍኮ ፡
ወዘኣኅደርኮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጻዲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

verses.textGeez:
ጸገብነ ፡ እምበረከተ ፡ ቤትከ ፡
ቅዱስ ፡ ጽርሕከ ፡ ወመንክር ፡ በጽዱቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐነ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወመድኀኒነ 
ተስፋሆሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡
ወለእለሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ርሑቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.textGeez:
አጽናዕኮሙ ፡ ለአድባር ፡ በኀይልከ 
ወቅኑታን ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ በኀይል ።
ዘየሀውኮ ፡ ለዐንበረ ፡ ባሕር 
ወመኑ ፡ ይትቃወሞ ፡ ለድምፀ ፡ ማዕበላ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.textGeez:
ይደነግፁ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወይፈርሁ ፡
እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አጽናፍ ፡ እምተአምሪከ 
ይወፅኡ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወሰርከ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
ሐወጽካ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወአርወይካ ፡
ወአብዛኅኮ ፡ ለብዕላ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

verses.textGeez: ፈለገ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምሉእ ፡ ማያት አስተዳሎከ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ታስተዴሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

verses.textGeez:
አርውዮ ፡ ለትሌሚሃ ፡ ወአስምር ፡ ለማእረራ 
ወበነጠብጣብከ ፡ ትበቍል ፡ ትፈሢሓ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

verses.textGeez:
ወትባርክ ፡ አክሊለ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወይጸግቡ ፡ ጠላተ ፡ ገዳማት ።
verses.textEnglish: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.textGeez:
ወይረውዩ ፡ አድባረ ፡ በድው 
ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ አውግር ፡ ወይቀንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.textGeez:
ወይለብሱ ፡ አብሐኰ ፡ አባግዕ ፡
ወቈላትኒ ፡ ይመልኡ ፡ ስርናየ 
ይጸርኁ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሴብሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፮ - የብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 66 - May God Be Gracious to Us and Bless Us
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘትንሣኤ ።

verses.textGeez:
የብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
ወዘምሩ ፡ ለስሙ ሀቡ ፡ አኰቴተ ፡ ለስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

verses.textGeez:
በልዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ግሩም ፡ ግብርከ ፡
እንዘ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ኀይልከ ፡ ሐሰዉክ ፡ ጸላእቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.textGeez:
ኵላ ፡ ምድር ፡ ትሰግድ ፡ ወትገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡
ወትዜምር ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ንዑ ፡ ወትርአዩ ፡ ግብሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ግሩም ፡ ምክሩ ፡ እምእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሬስያ ፡ ለባሕር ፡ የብሰ ፡
ወበተከዚ ፡ የኀልፉ ፡ በእግር 
ወበህየ ፡ ንትፌሣሕ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይኴንን ፡ በኀይሉ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡
ወአዕይንቲሁኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ይኔጽራ 
እለ ፡ ታአምሩ ፡ ኢታዕብዩ ፡ ርእሰክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.textGeez:
ባርክዎ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ለአምላክነ 
ወአፅምኡ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአንበራ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕይወት 
ወኢይሁቦን ፡ ሁከተ ፡ ለእግርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አምከርከነ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወፈተንከነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይፈትንዎ ፡ ለብሩር ።
verses.textEnglish: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

verses.textGeez:
ወአባእከነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥገርት 
ወአምጻእከ ፡ ሕማመ ፡ ቅድሜነ ።
ወአጽአንከ ፡ ስብአ ፡ ዲበ ፡ አርእስቲነ
verses.textEnglish: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.textGeez: አኅለፍከነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ እሳት ፡ ወማይ ፡ወአውፃእከነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዕረፍት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.textGeez:
እበውእ ፡ ቤተከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መባእየ 
ወእሁብ ፡ ብፅአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

verses.textGeez: ዘነበብኩ ፡ በአፉየ ዘእቤ ፡ በከናፍርየ ፡ አመ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

verses.textGeez:
መሥዋዕተ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ነውረ ፡
ኣበውእ ፡ ለከ ፡ ዕጣነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕራጊት 
እሠውዕ ፡ ለከ ፡ አልህምተ ፡ ወአጣሌ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ንዑ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ወእንግርክሙ ፡
ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
መጠነ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዘጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ በአፉየ 
ወከላሕኩ ፡ በልሳንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ይሬኢ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልብየ 
ኢይሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእንተዝ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘኢከልአኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡
ወኢያርሐቀ ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፯ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይባርከነ ፡ ወይሣሀለነ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 67 - God Shall Arise, His Enemies Scattered
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይባርከነ ፡ ወይሣሀለነ 
ወያርኡ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወንሕዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ናእምር ፡ በምድር ፡ ፍኖተከ 
ወበኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ አድኅኖተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

verses.textGeez:
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኵሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ አሕዛብ 
እስመ ፡ ትኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ በርትዕ ፡
ወትመርሖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ በምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኵሎሙ ።
ምድርኒ ፡ ወሀበት ፡ ፍሬሃ
verses.textEnglish: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወይባርከነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ።ወይባርከነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይፍርህዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፰ - ይትነሣእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይዘረዉ ፡ ፀሩ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷፰ (68) - እግዚአብሔር፡ይነሣ ፥ ጠላቶቹም፡ይበተኑ ፥ የሚጠሉትም፡ከፊቱ፡ይሽሹ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 68 - Save Me, O God, for Waters Threaten
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ማኅሌት ።

verses.textGeez:
ይትነሣእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይዘረዉ ፡ ፀሩ 
ወይጕየዩ ፡ ጸላእቱ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ የኀልቅ ፡ ጢስ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ የኀልቁ 
ወከመ ፡ ይትመሰው ፡ ሰምዕ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እሳት ፡
ከማሁ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.textGeez:
ወጻድቃንሰ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይትፌሥሑ ፡ በሐሤት ።
verses.textEnglish: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዘምሩ ፡ ለስሙ 
ፍኖተ ፡ ግብሩ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ዐርገ ፡ እንተ ፡ ዐረብ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ስሙ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፡ በቅድሜሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

verses.textGeez:
ወይደነግፁ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ።
አብ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፡ ወመኰንኖን ፡ ለአቤራት
verses.textEnglish: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደሱ ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያኀድሮሙ ፡ ለባሕታዊያን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቱ ፡
verses.textEnglish: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

verses.textGeez: ወያወፅኦሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን ፡ በኀይሉ ከማሁ ፡ ለምሩራን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብር ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አመሰ ፡ ወፃእከ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ሕዝብከ 
ወአመኒ ፡ እንተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ኀለፍከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ምድርኒ ፡ አድለቅለቀት ፡ ወሰማይኒ ፡ አንጠብጠበ ፡
እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ሲና 
እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.textGeez:
ዝናመ ፡ ፈቃዱ ፡ ዘፈለጠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለርስትከ 
እመኒ ፡ ደክመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ታጸንዖ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

verses.textGeez:
እንስሳከ ፡ የኀድር ፡ ውስቴቱ 
አስተዳሎከ ፡ ለነዳያን ፡ በኂሩትከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሁቦሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይዜንዉ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ብዙኀ ።
verses.textEnglish: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.textGeez:
ንጉሠ ፡ ኀያለን ፡ ለፍቁሩ ፡
ለፍቁሩ ፡ ወለሥነ ፡ ቤትከ ፡ ተካፈልነ ፡ ምህርካ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ቤትክሙ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ መዋርስት 
ክነፈ ፡ ርግብ ፡ በብሩር ፡ ዘግቡር ፡
ወገበዋቲሃኒ ፡ በኀመልማለ ፡ ወርቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

verses.textGeez:
አመ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ሰማያዊ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ላዕሌሃ 
በረድ ፡ ይዘንም ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሰልሞን ።
ደብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ደብር ፡ ጥሉል
verses.textEnglish: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

verses.textGeez: ደብር ፡ ርጉዕ ፡ ወደብረ ፡ ጥሉል ።ለምንት ፡ ይትነሥኡ ፡ አድባር ፡ ርጉዓን
verses.textEnglish: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

verses.textGeez: ደብረ ፡ ዘሠምሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይኀድር ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡እስመ ፡ ይኀድሮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.textGeez:
ሰረገላቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምእልፊተ ፡ አእላፍ ፡ ፍሡሓን 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ በሲና ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.

verses.textGeez:
ዐረገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም ፡ ፄዊወከ ፡ ፄዋ ፡
ወወሀብከ ፡ ጸጋከ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እምሕያው
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ይክሕዱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኅድሩ ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክ ፡ ቡሩክ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል 
ይረድአነ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወመድኀኒነ ።
verses.textEnglish: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

verses.textGeez:
አምላክነሰ ፡ አምላከ ፡ አድኅኖ 
ወፍናዊሁኒ ፡ ለሞት ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሰብር ፡ አርእስተ ፡ ጸላእቱ 
ወበከተማ ፡ ሥዕርቶሙ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ጌጋዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

verses.textGeez:
ይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወፂእየ ፡ እገብእ 
ወእትመየጥ ፡ እንተ ፡ ቀላየ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.textEnglish: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይሠረያ ፡ እገሪከ ፡ በደም ፡
ልሳነ ፡ ከለባቲከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.textGeez:
አስተርአየ ፡ ፍናዊከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ፍናዊሁ ፡ ለአምላኪየ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ መቅደስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
በጽሑ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወቦሙ ፡ መዘምራነ 
ማእከለ ፡ ደናግል ፡ ዘባጥያተ ፡ ከበሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.textGeez:
በማኅበር ፡ ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወለአማላክነ ፡ በአንቅዕተ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

verses.textGeez: ህየ ፡ ብንያም ፡ ወሬዛ ፡ በኀይሉ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

verses.textGeez: መላእክተ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወመሳፍንቲሆሙ መላእክተ ፡ ዛብሉን ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ንፍታሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

verses.textGeez:
አዝዝ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኀይልከ 
ወአጽንዖ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ዘሠራዕከ ፡ ለነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ ጽርሕከ ፡ ዘኢየሩሳሌም 
ለከ ፡ ያምጽኡ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ አምኃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

verses.textGeez:
ገሥጾሙ ፡ ለአራዊተ ፡ ሕለት ፡
ማኅበረ ፡ አልህምት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እጓላተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡
ከመ ፡ ኢይትዐጸዉ ፡ እለ ፡ ፍቱናን ፡ ከመ ፡ ብሩር
verses.textEnglish: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

verses.textGeez:
ዝርዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ቀትለ ።ይመጽኡ ፡ ተናብልት ፡ እምግብጽ 
ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ታበጽሕ ፡ እደዊሃ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.textGeez:
ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወዘምሩ ፡ ለአምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.textGeez:
ዘምሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘዐርገ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ 
ሰማይ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ጽባሕ
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ኀይል ።ሀቡ ፡ አኰቴተ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.textGeez: ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ወኀይሉሂ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደመናት ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

verses.textGeez:
መንክር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በላዕለ ፡ ቅዱሳኒሁ ።
አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ወጽንዐ ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
ወይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፷፱ - አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ እስመ ፡ በጽሐኒ ፡ ማይ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነፍስየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፷፱ (69) - አቤቱ ፥ ውሃ፡እስከ፡ነፍሴ፡ደርሶብኛልና ፥ አድነኝ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 69 - Make Haste, O God, to Deliver Me
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እለ ፡ ተበዐዱ ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ እስመ ፡ በጽሐኒ ፡ ማይ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.textGeez: ወጠጋዕኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዕሙቅ ፡ ቀላይ ፡ ወኀይል ፡ አልብየ
verses.textEnglish: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.textGeez: በጻሕኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማዕምቀ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወዐውሎ ፡ አስጠመኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.textGeez: ሰራሕኩ ፡ በከልሖ ፡ ወስሕከኒ ፡ ጕርዔየ ደክማ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ እንዘ ፡ እሴፈዎ ፡ ለአምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

verses.textGeez: በዝኁ ፡ እምስዕርተ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልኡኒ ፡ በከንቱ
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

verses.textGeez: ጸንዑ ፡ ፀርየ ፡ እለ ፡ ይረውዱኒ ፡ በዐመፃ ፡ወዘኢነሣእኩ ፡ ይትፈደዩኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ለሊከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ታአምር ፡ እበድየ 
ወኢይትኀባእ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ ኃጢአትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

verses.textGeez: ወኢይትኀፈሩ ፡ ብየ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሡከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን
verses.textEnglish: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

verses.textGeez: ወኢይኀሰሩ ፡ ብየ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሴፈዉከ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ በእንቲአከ ፡ ተዐገሥኩ ፡ ፅእለተ ወከደነኒ ፡ ኀፍረት ፡ ገጽየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ነኪር ፡ ኮንክዎሙ ፡ ለአኀውየ 
ወነግድ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእምየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ቅንአተ ፡ ኬትከ ፡ በልዐኒ 
ተዕይርቶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትዔየሩከ ፡ ወድቀ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀጻእክዋ ፡ በጾም ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
ወኮነኒ ፡ ፅእለተ ።
verses.textEnglish: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

verses.textGeez: ወለበስኩ ፡ ሠቀ ፡ ወኮንክዎሙ ፡ ነገረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.textGeez:
ላዕሌየ ፡ ይዛውዑ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አናቅጽ 
ወኪያየ ፡ የኀልዩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሰትዩ ፡ ወይነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ በጸሎትየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ሣህሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በጊዜሁ
verses.textEnglish: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

verses.textGeez: እንዘ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ስምዐኒ ፡ ዘበአማን ፡ መድኀንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ እምዐምዓም ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢየኀጠኒ 
ወአንግፈኒ ፡ እምጸላእትየ ፡ ወእምቀላየ ፡ ማይ ።
ወኢያስጥመኒ ፡ ዐውሎ ፡ ማይ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

verses.textGeez: ወኢየኀጠኒ ፡ ቀላይ ወኢያብቁ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ዐዘቅት ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወበከመ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምገብርከ 
እስመ ፡ ተመንደብኩ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ስምዐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.textGeez:
ነጽራ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ወአድኅና 
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

verses.textGeez:
ለሊከ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ኀፍረትየ ፡ ወኀሳርየ
verses.textEnglish: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.textGeez: በቅድመ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ ።ተዐገሠት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ወኀሳረ
verses.textEnglish: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.textGeez: ወነበርኩ ፡ ትኩዝየ ፡ ወኀጣእኩ ፡ ዘይናዝዘኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

verses.textGeez: ወወደዩ ፡ ሐሞተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መብልዕየ ወአስተዩኒ ፡ ብሒአ ፡ ለጽምእየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

verses.textGeez:
ለትኩኖሙ ፡ ማእዶሙ ፡ መሥገርተ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ 
ወማዕገተ ፡ ዕቅፍት ፡ ለፍዳሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ይጽለማ ፡ አዕይንቲሆሙ ፡ ወኢይርአያ 
ወይትቀጻዕ ፡ ዘባናቲሆሙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.textGeez:
ከዐው ፡ መዐተከ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ 
ወይርከቦሙ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ መዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

verses.textGeez:
ለትኩን ፡ ሀገሮሙ ፡ በድወ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይንበር ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዘአንተ ፡ ቀሠፍከ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ተለዉ 
ወወሰኩኒ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ጸልዕየ ፡ ቍስለ ።
verses.textEnglish: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

verses.textGeez:
ወስኮሙ ፡ ጌጋየ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ጌጋዮሙ 
ወኢይባኡ ፡ በጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

verses.textGeez:
ወይደምሰሱ ፡ እመጽሐፈ ፡ ሕያዋን 
ወኢይጸሐፉ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

verses.textGeez:
ነዳይ ፡ ወቍሱል ፡ አነ 
መድኀኔ ፡ ገጽየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወክፈኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

verses.textGeez:
እሴብሕ ፡ ለስመ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ በማኅሌት 
ወኣዐብዮ ፡ በስብሓት ።
verses.textEnglish: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.textGeez:
ወአሠምሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምላህም ፡ ጣዕዋ 
ዘአብቈለ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ወጽፍረ ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
ይርአዩ ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ወይትፌሥሑ 
ኅሥዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተሐዩ ፡ ነፍስክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሰምዖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለነዳያን 
ወኢመነኖሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወምድር 
ወባሕርኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘይትሐወሥ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አድኀና ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለጽዮን ፡
ወይትሐነጻ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ይሁዳ
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez: ወይነብሩ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወይወርስዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.textGeez: ወዘርዐ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ ይነብርዋ ወእለ ፡ ያፍቅሩ ፡ ስመከ ፡ የኀድሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸ - እግዚኦ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዲኦትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፸ (70) - አቤቱ ፥ እኔን፡ለማዳን፡ተመልከት አቤቱ ፥ እኔን፡ለመርዳት፡ፍጠን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 70 - Forsake Me Not When My Strength is Spent
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ተዝካረ ፡ አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዲኦትየ 
እግዚኦ፡ አፍጥን ፡ ረዳኦትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.

verses.textGeez: ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሥዎ ፡ ለነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.textGeez: ወይግብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡ እለ ፡ መከሩ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.textGeez:
ለይግብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ ፡ በጊዜሃ ፡ ተኀፊሮሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይብሉኒ ፡ አንቋዕ ፡ አንቋዕ ።5 ለይትፌሥሑ ፡ ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሡከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወይበሉ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ አድኅኖተከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፡ አነ ፡
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይረድአኒ ።
ረዳእየ ፡ ወምስካይየ ፡ አንተ ፡
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወኢትጐንዲ ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ፡ችግረኛና፡ምስኪን፡ነኝ አቤቱ ፥ ርዳኝ ረዳቴ፡ታዳጊዬም፡አንተ፡ነኽ አቤቱ ፥ አትዘግይ።
verses.textEnglish: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፩ - ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ለዓለም
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፸፩ (71) - አቤቱ ፥ አንተን፡ታመንኹ ለዘለዓለም፡አልፈር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 71 - Give the King Your Justice, O God
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘወልደ ፡ አሚናዳብ ፡ ለእለ ፡ አቅደሙ ፡ ተፄውዎ ።

verses.textGeez:
ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ለዓለም ።
ወበጽድቅከ ፡ አንግፈኒ ፡ ወባልሐኒ
verses.textEnglish: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.textGeez: አፅምእ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወፍጡነ ፡ አድኅነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

verses.textGeez: ኩነኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ወመድኀንየ ፡ውስተ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታድኅነኒ
verses.textEnglish: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ኀይልየ ፡ ወጸወንየ ፡ አንተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.textGeez: አምላኪየ ፡ አድኅነኒ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኃጥኣን ወእምእደ ፡ ዐመፂ ፡ ወገፋዒ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ተስፋየ ፡ እግዚኦ 
እግዚእየ ፡ ተሰፈውኩከ ፡ እምንእስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወብከ ፡ ጸናዕኩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ከርሠ ፡ እምየ ።
ወበውስተ ፡ ማኅፀን ፡ እንተ ፡ ከደንከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተ ፡ ዝክርየ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
ከመ ፡ ኳሄላ ፡ ኮንክዎሙ ፡ ለብዙኃን ።
ወአንተ ፡ ረዳእየ ፡ ወኀይልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

verses.textGeez:
ምላእ ፡ አፉየ ፡ ስብሐቲከ 
ከመ ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ አኰቴተከ ፡
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትግድገኒ ፡ በመዋዕለ ፡ ርሥእየ 
ወአመሂ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ኀይልየ ፡ ኢትኅድገኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ነበቡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ወእለሂ ፡ የኀሥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ ተማከሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ ኀደጎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ዴግንዎ ፡ ወትእኅዝዎ 
እስመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘያድኅኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ ኢትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔየ 
አምላኪየ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ረዲኦትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.textGeez:
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይኅሰሩ ፡ እለ ፡ ያስተዋድይዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወይልበሱ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ወኀሳረ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈቅዱ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ሕማመ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ እሴፈወከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእዌስክ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

verses.textGeez: አፉየ ፡ ይነግር ፡ ጽድቀከ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ አድኅኖተከ
verses.textEnglish: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢያአምር ፡ ተግባረ ።እበውእ ፡ በኀይለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እግዚኦ ፡ እዜከር ፡ ጽድቀከ ፡ ባሕቲቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
ወመሀርከኒ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ እምንእስየ 
እስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ እነግር ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

verses.textGeez: ወእስከ ፡ እልህቅ ፡ ወእረሥእ ፡ ኢትኅድገኒ ፡ አምላኪየ
verses.textEnglish: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

verses.textGeez: እስከ ፡ እነግረ ፡ መዝራዕተከ ፡ ለትውልድ ፡ ዘይመጽእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ኀይለከኒ ፡ ወጽድቀከኒ ።እግዚኦ ፡ እስከ ፡ አርያም ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ዐቢያተ ።
እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ከማከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አርአይከኒ ፡ ሕማመ ፡ ወምንዳቤ ፡ ብዙኀ 
ወተመየጥከኒ ፡ ወአሕየውከኒ 
ወእምቀላየ ፡ ምድር ፡ ካዕበ ፡ አውፃእከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ወአብዛኅኮ ፡ ለጽድቅከ ፡
ወገባእከ ፡ ታስተፌሥሐኒ 
ወእምቀላየ ፡ ምድር ፡ ካዕበ ፡ አውፃእከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

verses.textGeez:
ወአነሂ ፡ እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ በንዋየ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ለጽድቅከ 
እዜምር ፡ ለከ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ በመሰንቆ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ።
