verses.textEnglish: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሓኒ ፡ ከናፍርየ ፡ ሶበ ፡ እዜምር ፡ ለከ 
ወለነፍስየኒ ፡ አንተ ፡ አድኀንካ ።
verses.textEnglish: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.textGeez:
ወዓዲ ፡ ልሳንየ ፡ ያነብብ ፡ ጽድቀከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ 
ሶበ ፡ ተኀፍሩ ፡ ወኀስሩ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀሡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እኩየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፪ - እግዚኦ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ሀቦ ፡ ለንጉሥ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፸፪ (72) - አቤቱ ፥ ፍርድኽን፡ለንጉሥ፡ስጥ ፥ ጽድቅኽንም፡ለንጉሥ፡ልጅ ፥
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 72 - God is the Strength of My Heart
psalms.heading: በአንተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ሀቦ ፡ ለንጉሥ 
ወጽድቅከኒ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይኰንኖሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ በጽድቅ 
ወለነዳያኒከ ፡ በፍትሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

verses.textGeez: ይትወከፉ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወአውግር ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ሕዝብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ኰንን ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ነዳያነ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡
ወአድኅኖሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ምስኪናኒከ 
ወአኅስሮ ፡ ለዕቡይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.textGeez:
ወይጽናሕ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ፀሐይ 
እምቅድመ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወርድ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጠል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፀምር 
ወከመ ፡ ነጠብጣብ ፡ ዘያንጠበጥብ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሠርጽ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ 
ወብዙኅ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይኀልፍ ፡ ወርኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኴንን ፡ እምባሕር ፡ እስከ ፡ ባሕር 
ወእምአፍላግ ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ይገንዩ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ 
ወጸላእቲሁ ፡ ሐመደ ፡ ይቀምሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.textGeez:
ነገሥተ ፡ ተርሴስ ፡ ወደሰያት ፡ አምኃ ፡ ያበውኡ 
ነገሥተ ፡ ሳባ ፡ ወዐረብ ፡ ጋዳ ፡ ያመጽኡ ።
verses.textEnglish: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሰግዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር 
ወይትቀነዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አድኀኖ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ዘይትዔገሎ 
ለምስኪን ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ረዳኤ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

verses.textGeez:
ወይምሕክ ፡ ነዳየ ፡ ወምስኪነ 
ወያድኅን ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ነዳያን ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.textGeez:
እምርዴ ፡ ወእምትዕግልት ፡ ያድኅና ፡ ለነፍሶሙ 
ወክቡር ፡ ስሙ ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.textGeez:
ወየሐዩ ፡ ወይሁብዎ ፡ እምወርቀ ፡ ዐረብ 
ወዘልፈ ፡ ይጼልዩ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡
ወኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይድሕርዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

verses.textGeez:
ወይከውን ፡ ምስማከ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡
ውስተ ፡ አርእስተ ፡ አድባር 
ወኡነውኅ ፡ እምአርህ ፡ ፍሬሁ ፡
ወይበቍል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወይከውን ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡
እምቅድመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ስሙ
verses.textEnglish: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

verses.textGeez: ወይትባረኩ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ወያስተበፅእዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል 
ዘገብረ ፡ መንክረ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትባረክ ፡ ስመ ፡ ስብሓቲሁ ፡
ልዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወይምላእ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድር ለይኩን ፡ ለይኩን ።
ኀልቀ ፡ መኅልይ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘወልደ ፡ ኤሳይ ።
verses.textEnglish: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፫ - ጥቀ ፡ ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 73 - Arise, O God, Defend Your Cause
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez: ጥቀ ፡ ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.textGeez:
ሊተሰ ፡ ሕቀ ፡ ክመ ፡ ዘእምተንተና ፡ እገርየ 
ወሕቀ ፡ ክመ ፡ ዘእምድኅፀ ፡ ሰኰናየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ቀናእኩ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
ሰላሞሙ ፡ ርእይየ ፡ ለዐማፅያን ።
verses.textEnglish: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ ሣኅተ ፡ ለሞቶሙ 
ወኢኀይለ ፡ ለመቅሠፍቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

verses.textGeez:
ወበጻማሂ ፡ ኢኮኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰብእ 
ወኢተቀሥፉ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእንተዝ ፡ አኀዞሙ ፡ ትዕቢት 
ወተዐጸፍዋ ፡ ለኀጢአቶሙ ፡ ወለዐመፃሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወፅእ ፡ ከመ ፡ እምአንጕዕ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ 
ወኀለፈ ፡ እምትዕቢተ ፡ ልቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.textGeez:
ወሐለዩ ፡ ወነበቡ ፡ ከንቶ 
ወነበቡ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም ።
verses.textEnglish: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ አፉሆሙ 
ወአንሶሰው ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ልሳኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእንተዝ ፡ ይትመየጡ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ እምዝየ 
ወይትረከብ ፡ ፍጹም ፡ መዋዕል ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

verses.textGeez:
ወይብሉ ፡ እፎ ፡ ያአምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወቦኑ ፡ ዘያአምር ፡ በአርያም ።
verses.textEnglish: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ እሉ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ይትፈግዑ ፡
ወለዓለም ፡ ያጸንዕዋ ፡ ለብዕሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤ ፡ ከንቶሁ ፡ እንጋ ፡ አጽደቅዋ ፡ ለልብየ 
ወኀፀብኩ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ እደውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮንኩ ፡ ቅሡፈ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ 
ወዘለፋየኒ ፡ በጽባሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ እቤሁ ፡ ነበብኩ ፡ ከመዝ 
ናሁ ፡ ሠራዕኩ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ደቂቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

verses.textGeez:
ወተወከፍኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኣእምር 
ወዝንቱሰ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በቅድሜየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ እበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ከመ ፡ ኣእምር ፡ ደኃሪቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽልሑቶሙ ፡ አጽናሕኮሙ 
ወነፃኅኮሙ ፡ በተንሥኦቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

verses.textGeez:
እፎ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ለሙስና ፡
ግብተ ፡ ኀልቁ ፡ ወተሐጕሉ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ዘንቃህ ፡ እምንዋም ፡
እግዚኦ ፡ በሀገርከ ፡ አኅስር ፡ ራእዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውዕየ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወተመስወ ፡ ኵልያትየ ።
ወአንሰ ፡ ምኑን ፡ ወኢያእምርኩ
verses.textEnglish: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

verses.textGeez: ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ በኀቤከ ።ወአንሰ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ምስሌከ
verses.textEnglish: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee. before Heb. with

verses.textGeez:
አኀዝከኒ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ዘየማን ።ወበምክረ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ መራሕከኒ 
ወምስለ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ተወከፍከኒ
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

verses.textGeez: ምንተ ፡ ብየ ፡ ተሀሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ወምንተ ፡ እፈቅድ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

verses.textGeez:
ኀልቀ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወሥጋየ ፡ በአምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ ፡
እግዚአብሔር ፡ መክፈልትየ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይርሕቁ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ 
ወሠረውኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይዜምዉ ፡ እምኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ሊተሰ ፡ ተሊወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይኄይሰኒ 
ወትውክልትየኒ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ እንግር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።በአናቅጺሃ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፬ - ለምንት ፡ ገደፍከኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዝሉፉ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 74 - We Give Thanks to You, O God
psalms.heading: ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ ገደፍከኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዝሉፉ 
ወተመዓዕከ ፡ መዐተከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አባግዐ ፡ መርዔትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

verses.textGeez: ተዘከር ፡ ማኅበረከ ፡ ዘአቅደምከ ፡ ፈጢረ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

verses.textGeez: ወአድኀንከ ፡ በትረ ፡ ርስትከ ደብረ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ዘኀደርከ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.textGeez:
አንሥእ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ትዕቢቶሙ ፡ ለዝሉፉ 
መጠነከ ፡ አሕሠመ ፡ ፀራዊ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቅዱሳኒከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

verses.textGeez: ወተዘሀሩ ፡ ጸላእትከ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ በዓልከ
verses.textEnglish: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

verses.textGeez: ወረሰዩ ፡ ትእምርቶሙ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ዘኢያአምሩ ።ከመ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ላዕላይ ፡ ፍኖት
verses.textEnglish: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

verses.textGeez: ወከመ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ገዳም ፡ በጕድብ ፡ ሰበሩ ፡ ኆኃቲሃ ።ከማሁ ፡ በማሕፄ ፡ ወበመፍጽሕ ፡ ሰበርዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውዐዩ ፡ በእሳት ፡ መቅደሰከ 
ወአርኰሱ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስምከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ በልቦሙ ፡ ኀቢሮሙ ፡ በበሕዘቢሆሙ 
ንዑ ፡ ንስዐር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በዓላቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

verses.textGeez:
ወትእምርቶሂ ፡ ኢናአምር 
ወአልቦ ፡ እንከ ፡ ነቢየ ወንሕነሂ ፡ ኢናአምር ፡ እንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ እንከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ይጼእል ፡ ፀራዊ 
ወዘልፈ ፡ ያምዕዖ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ጸላኢ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትመይጥ ፡ እዴከ 
ወየማንከ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ሕፅንከ ፡ ለግሙራ ።
verses.textEnglish: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወገብረ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ አጽናዕካ ፡ ለባሕር ፡ በኀይልከ 
አንተ ፡ ሰበርከ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ከይሲ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተ ፡ ቀጥቀጥከ ፡ አርእስቲሁ ፡ ለከይሲ 
ወወሀብኮሙ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ ሰጠቀ ፡ አፍላገ ፡ ወአንቅዕት 
[አንተ ፡ ኢይበስኮሙ ፡ ለአፍላገ ፡ ኤታም ።
] 17 ለከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መዐልት ፡ ወዚአከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሌሊት 
አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ወወርኀ ።
verses.textEnglish: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ኵሎ 
ክረምተ ፡ ወሐጋየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከር ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ተግባረከ 
ፀራዊ ፡ ተዐየሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወሕዝብ ፡ አብድ ፡ አምዕዖ ፡ ለስሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትመጥዋ ፡ ለአራዊት ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትገኒ ፡ ለከ 
ወኢትርሳዕ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ነዳያኒከ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ወነጽር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሥርዐትከ 
እስመ ፡ በዝኁ ፡ ጽሉማነ ፡ ምድር ፡ አብያተ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይግባእ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ተኀፊሮ 
ንዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፡ ይሴብሑ ፡ ለስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወተበቀል ፡ በቀልየ 
ወተዘከር ፡ ዘተዐየሩከ ፡ አብዳን ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትርሳዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አግብርቲከ 
ትዝህርቶሙ ፡ ለጸላእትከ ፡ ይዕረግ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፭ - እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 75 - God is Renowned in Judah
psalms.heading: ፍጹሜ ፡ ኢታማስን ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ፡ ማኅሌት ።

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወእጼውዕ ፡ ስመከ
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

verses.textGeez: ወእነግር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ።ሶበ ፡ ረከብኩ ፡ ጊዜሁ ወአንሰ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ እኴንን ።
verses.textEnglish: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

verses.textGeez:
ተመስወት ፡ ምድር ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ 
ወአነ ፡ አጽናዕኩ ፡ አዕማዲሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤሎሙ ፡ ላኃጥኣን ፡ ኢየአብሱ 
ወእለሂ ፡ ይኤብሱ ፡ ኢያንሥኡ ፡ ቀርኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.textGeez:
ወኢያንሥኡ ቀርኖሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም 
ወኢይንብቡ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢእምጽባሕ ፡ ወኢእምዐረብ ፡ ወኢእምአድባረ ፡ ገዳም ፡
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መኰንን ፡ ውእቱ
verses.textEnglish: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.textGeez:
ዘንተ ፡ ያኀስር ፡ ወዘንተ ፡ ያከብር ።እስመ ፡ ጽዋዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ወይን ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ቱሱሐ ፡ ዘምሉእ ፡ ቅድሐቱ
verses.textEnglish: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

verses.textGeez:
ወሶጦ ፡ እምዝንቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ወባሕቱ ፡ ጣሕሉኒ ፡ ኢይትከዐው ፡
ወይሰትይዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ኃጥኣነ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textAmharic: ጽዋ፡በእግዚአብሔር፡እጅ፡ነውና ያልተቀላቀለ፡የወይን፡ጠጅ፡ሞላበት ከዚህ፡ወደዚያ፡አገላበጠው ፥ ነገር፡ ግን ፥ አተላው፡አልፈሰሰም የምድር፡ኀጢአተኛዎች፡ዅሉ፡ይጠጡታል።
verses.textEnglish: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

verses.textGeez: ወአንሰ ፡ እትፌሣሕ ፡ ለዓለም ወእዜምር ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ወእሰብር ፡ አቅርንተ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
ወይትሌዐል ፡ አቅርንተ ፡ ጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፮ - ተዐውቀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በይሁዳ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 76 - In the Day of Trouble I Seek the Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘስብሐት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ አሶርዮን ።

verses.textGeez:
ተዐውቀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በይሁዳ 
ወዐቢይ ፡ ስሙ ፡ በእስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

verses.textGeez: ወነበረ ፡ በሰላም ፡ ብሔሩ ወማኅደሩሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.textGeez:
ወበህየ ፡ ሰበረ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ቀስት 
ወልታ ፡ ወኲናተ ፡ ወፀባኢተ ።
[ወብህየ ፡ ሰበረ ፡ አቅርንተ ።
] 4 አንተ ፡ ታበርህ ፡ ምንክረ እምአድባር ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
ደንገፁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ አብዳነ ፡ ልብ ፡
verses.textEnglish: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ሐለሙ ፡ ሕልመ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘረከቡ ፡ኵሉ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ለብዕለ ፡ እደዊሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.textGeez:
እምተግሣጽከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ 
ደቀሱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼአኑ ፡ አፍራሰ ።
verses.textEnglish: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ ግሩም ፡ አንተ 
ወመኑ ፡ ይትቃወሞ ፡ ለመዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.textGeez:
እምሰማይ ፡ ታፀምእ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡
ምድርኒ ፡ ፈርሀት ፡ ወአርመመት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኰንኖ 
ከመ ፡ ያድኅኖሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ የዋሀነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እምፈቃዱ ፡ የአምነከ ፡ ሰብእ 
ወእምተረፈ ፡ ሕሊናሁ ፡ ይገብር ፡ በዓለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ብፅኡ ፡ ወሀቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡
ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ፀውዱ ፡ ያበውኡ ፡ አምኃ ፡ ለግሩም ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

verses.textGeez:
ዘያወፅእ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ ለመላእክት 
ወይገርም ፡ እምነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፯ - ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸራኅኩ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 77 - Tell to the Coming Generation
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኢዶቱም ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸራኅኩ 
ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአፅምአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

verses.textGeez:
በዕለተ ፡ ምንደቤየ ፡ ኀሠሥክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እደውየ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ወኢኬዱኒ
verses.textEnglish: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.textGeez:
ቀብጸት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ።ተዘከርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወተፈሣሕኩ 
ተዛዋዕኩሂ ፡ ወዐንበዘት ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተራከብክዎን ፡ ለሰዓታተ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ደንገፅኩሂ ፡ ወኢነበብኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.textGeez:
ወሐለይኩ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ትካት 
ወተዘከርኩ ፡ ዐመተ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወአንበብኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.textGeez: ሌሊተ ፡ ተዛዋዕኩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ወአንቃክህዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.textGeez:
ቦኑ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይገድፍ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወኢይደግምኑ ፡ እንከ ፡ ተሣህሎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.textGeez: ቦኑ ፡ ለግሙራ ፡ ይመትር ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

verses.textGeez:
ወይረስዕኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተሣህሎ 
ወይደፍንኑ ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ በመዐቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤ ፡ እምይእዜ ፡ ወጠንኩ 
ከመዝ ፡ ያስተባሪ ፡ የማኖ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከርኩ ፡ ግብሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እስመ ፡ እዜከር ፡ ዘትካት ፡ ምሕረትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

verses.textGeez:
ወኣነብብ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምግባሪከ 
ወእዛዋዕ ፡ በግብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ ፍኖትከ 
መኑ ፡ አምላክ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ከመ ፡ አምላክነ ።
አንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ዘትገብር ፡ መንክረ
verses.textEnglish: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

verses.textGeez:
አርአይኮሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ ኀያለከ ።ወአድኀንኮሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ ፡ በመዝራዕትከ 
ለደቂቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወዮሴፍ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

verses.textGeez: ርእዩከ ፡ ማያት ፡ እግዚኦ ርእዩከ ፡ ማያት ፡ ወፈርሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ደንገፁ ፡ ቀላያት ፡ ማያት ፡ ወደምፁ ፡ ማያቲሆሙ ።
ቃለ ፡ ወሀቡ ፡ ደመናት ፡ ወአሕፃከ ፡ ያወፅኡ ።
verses.textEnglish: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.textGeez: ቃለ ፡ ነጐድጓድከ ፡ በሰረገላት
verses.textEnglish: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

verses.textGeez: አስተርአየ ፡ መባርቅቲሁ ፡ ለዓለም ርዕደት ፡ ወአድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ፍኖትከ ፡ ወአሰርከኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማይ ፡ ብዙኅ 
ወኢይትዐወቅ ፡ አሰርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

verses.textGeez:
ወመራሕኮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ለሕዝብከ 
በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፰ - አፅምኡ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ሕግየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፸፰ (78) - ሕዝቤ፡ሆይ ፥ ሕጌን፡አድምጡ ዦሯችኹንም፡ወደአፌ፡ቃል፡አዘንብሉ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 78 - How Long, O Lord? Will You Be Angry Forever?
psalms.heading: ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
አፅምኡ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ሕግየ 
ወጽልዉ ፡ እዝነክሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.textGeez:
እከሥት ፡ በምሳሌ ፡ አፉየ 
ወእነግር ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ዘእምትካት ።
verses.textEnglish: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎ ፡ ዘሰማዕነ ፡ ወዘርኢነ 
ወዘነገሩነ ፡ አበዊነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.textGeez: ወኢኀብኡ ፡ እምደቂቆሙ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ትውልድ ፡
verses.textEnglish: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

verses.textGeez: ወነገሩ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ኀይሎሂ ፡ ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ዘገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.textGeez:
ዘአቀመ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡
ወሠርዐ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ለእስራኤል
verses.textEnglish: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

verses.textGeez:
ዘአዘዞሙ ፡ ለአበዊነ ፡ከመ ፡ ይንግሩ ፡ ለደቂቆሙ ።
ከመ ፡ ያእምር ፡ ካልእ ፡ ትውልድ
verses.textEnglish: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.textGeez: ደቂቅ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትወለዱ ፡ ወይትነሥኡ ፡ወይዜንዉ ፡ ለደቂቆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይረስዩ ፡ ትውክልቶሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወከመ ፡ ኢይርስዑ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
ወይኅሥሡ ፡ ትእዛዞ ።
verses.textEnglish: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይኩኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ 
ትውልድ ፡ ዕሉት ፡ ወመራር ።
verses.textEnglish: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.textGeez:
ትውልድ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢያርትዐት ፡ ልባ 
ወኢተአምነት ፡ መንፈሳ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.textGeez:
ደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ይወስቁ ፡ ወይነድፉ 
ወተገፍትኡ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ቀትል ።
verses.textEnglish: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢዐቀቡ ፡ ኪዳኖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወአበዩ ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ በሕጉ ።
verses.textEnglish: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.textGeez:
ወረስዑ ፡ ረድኤቶ ።
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ዘአርአዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.textGeez:
ዘገብረ ፡ መንክረ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ አባዊሆሙ 
በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወበሐቀለ ፡ ጣኔዎስ ።
verses.textEnglish: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

verses.textGeez:
ሰጠቀ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ወአኅለፎሙ 
ወአቀመ ፡ ማየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዝቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.textGeez:
ወመርሖሙ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ በደመና 
ወኵሎ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ በብርሃነ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንቅዐ ፡ ኰኵሐ ፡ በበድው 
ወአስተዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘእምቀላይ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅአ ፡ ማየ ፡ እምእብን 
ወአውሐዘ ፡ ማየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘአፍላግ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.textGeez:
ወደገሙ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ወአበሱ ፡ ሎቱ 
ወአምረርዎ ፡ ለልዑል ፡ በበድው ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.textGeez:
ወአመከርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በልቦሙ 
ከመ ፡ ይስአሉ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለነፍሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

verses.textGeez:
ሐመይዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይቤሉ 
ይክልኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሠሪዐ ፡ ማእድ ፡ በገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.textGeez: ይዝብጥ ፡ ኰኵሐ ፡ ወያውሕዝ ፡ ማየ
verses.textEnglish: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.textGeez: ወይክልኑ ፡ ውሂበ ፡ ኅብስት ፡ወይሥራዕ ፡ ማዕደ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአናሕሰየ 
ወነደ ፡ እሳት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡
ወመጽአ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢተአመንዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወኢተወከሉ ፡ በአድኅኖቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

verses.textGeez: ወአዘዘ ፡ ደመና ፡ በላዕሉ ወአርኀወ ፡ ኆኃተ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

verses.textGeez:
ወአዝነመ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ መና ፡ ይብልዑ 
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.textGeez:
ወኅብስተ ፡ መላእክቲሁ ፡ በልዑ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው 
ወፈነወ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ሥንቆሙ ፡ ዘየአክሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሥአ ፡ አዜበ ፡ እምሰማይ 
ወአምጽአ ፡ መስዐ ፡ በኀይሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

verses.textGeez:
ወአዝነመ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሬት 
ወከመ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ባሕር ፡ አዕዋፈ ፡ ዘይሠርር ።
verses.textEnglish: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ወወድቀ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ 
ወዐውደ ፡ ደባትሪሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
በልዑ ፡ ወጸግቡ ፡ ጥቀ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ለፍትወቶሙ ።
ወኢያኅጥኦሙ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ፈቀዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ወእንዘ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ መብልዖሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሆሙ 
ወመጽአ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

verses.textGeez: ወቀተሎሙ ፡ መብዝኅቶሙ ወአዕቀጾሙ ፡ ለኅሩያነ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.textGeez:
ወምስለ ፡ ዝኒ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ አበሱ ፡ ሎቱ 
ወኢተአመንዎ ፡ በተአምሪሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀልቀ ፡ በከንቱ ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ 
ወኀለፈ ፡ በጕጕኣ ፡ ዐመቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.textGeez:
ወአመ ፡ ይቀትሎሙ ፡ ውእተ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይኀሥዎ 
ወይትመየጡ ፡ ወይገይሱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textAmharic: ርሱ፡ግን፡መሓሪ፡ነው ፥ ኀጢአታቸውንም፡ይቅር፡አላቸው ፥ አላጠፋቸውምም ቍጣውንም፡መመለስ፡አበዛ ፥ መዓቱን ም፡ዅሉ፡አላቃጠለም።
verses.textEnglish: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ረዳኢሆሙ 
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ልዑል ፡ መድኀኒሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

verses.textGeez:
ወአፍቀረዎ ፡ በአፉሆሙ 
ወሐሰውዎ ፡ በልሳኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.textGeez:
ወኢኮነ ፡ ርቱዐ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ 
ወኢተአመንዎ ፡ በኪዳኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ወውእቱሰ ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ውእቱ ፡
ወይሰሪ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ ፡ ወኢያጠፍኦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.textGeez:
ወያበዝኅ ፡ መዪጠ ፡ መዐቱ ፡
ወኢያነድድ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መቅሠፍቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ እሙንቱ 
መንፈስ ፡ እምከመ ፡ ወፅአ ፡ ኢይገብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.textGeez:
ሚመጠነ ፡ አምዕዕዎ ፡ በገዳም ፡
ወወሐክዎ ፡ በበድው ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.textGeez:
ወተመይጡ ፡ ወአመከርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወወሐክዎ ፡ ለቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢተዘከሩ ፡ እዴሁ 
ዘአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

verses.textGeez:
ዘገብረ ፡ ተአምረ ፡ በግብጽ 
ወመንክረ ፡ በሐቅለ ፡ ጣኔዎስ ።
verses.textEnglish: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰየ ፡ ደመ ፡ ለአፍላጊሆሙ 
ወለአንቅዕቲሆሙኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይስተዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ አኮተ ፡ ወበልዖሙ 
ወቈርነነዓተ ፡ ወአርኰሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ለአናኵዕ ፡ ፍሬሆሙ 
ወተግባሮሙኒ ፡ ለአንበጣ ።
verses.textEnglish: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ወይኖሙ ፡ በበረድ 
ወበለሶሙኒ ፡ በአስሐትያ ።
verses.textEnglish: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ለበረድ ፡ እንስሳሆሙ 
ወንዋዮሙኒ ፡ ለእሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ መዐቱ 
መቅሠፍተ ፡ ወመንሱተ ፡ ወሕማመ 
ወፈነወ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መላእክት ፡ እኩያን ።
verses.textEnglish: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

verses.textGeez:
ወጼሐ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ለመዐቱ 
ወኢመሐካ ፡ እሞት ፡ ለነፍሶሙ 
ወዐጸወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሞት ፡ እንስሳሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በኵሮሙ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ግብጽ 
ወቀዳሜ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጻማሆሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፈሮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ ገዳመ ፡ ከመ ፡ መርዔት ።
verses.textEnglish: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.textGeez:
ወመርሖሙ ፡ በተስፋሁ ፡ ወኢፈርሁ 
ወደፈኖሙ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ለፀሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሰዶሙ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ 
ደብረ ፡ ዘፈጠረት ፡ የማኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

verses.textGeez:
ወሰደደ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡
ወአውረሶሙ ፡ በሐብለ ፡ ርስቱ
verses.textEnglish: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

verses.textGeez: ወአንበረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

verses.textGeez: ወአመከርዎ ፡ ወአምዕዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ልዑል ወኢዐቀቡ ፡ ስምዖ ።
verses.textEnglish: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.textGeez:
ወተመይጡ ፡ ወዐለዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ አበዊሆሙ 
ወኮኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ቀስት ፡ ጠዋይ ።
verses.textEnglish: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.textGeez:
ወአምዕዕዎ ፡ በአውገሪሆሙ 
ወኣቅንእዎ ፡ በግልፎሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአናሕሰየ 
ወመነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀደጋ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ሴሎም 
ደብተራሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ ለተፄውዎ 
ወሥኖሙኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ፀሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.textGeez:
ወዐጸዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኲናት ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
ወተሀየዮሙ ፡ ለርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.textGeez:
ወበልዐቶሙ ፡ እሳት ፡ ለወራዙቶሙ 
ወኢላሐዋ ፡ ደናግሊሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ወካህናቲሆሙኒ ፡ ወድቁ ፡ በኲናት 
ወኢበከያ ፡ አቤራቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.textGeez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘንቃህ ፡ እምንዋም 
ወከመ ፡ ኀያል ፡ ወኅዳገ ፡ ወይን ።
verses.textEnglish: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፡ በዳኅሬሆሙ 
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ኀሳረ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀደጋ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ዮሴፍ 
ወኢኀረዮሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀረየ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ይሁዳ 
ደብረ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ዘአፍቀረ ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez:
ሐነጸ ፡ መቅደሶ ፡ በአርያም 
ወሳረራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀረዮ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ገብሩ 
ወነሥኦ ፡ እመርዔተ ፡ አባግዒሁ ።
ወተመጠዎ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሐራሣት
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ይርዐዮ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ገብሩ ወለእስራኤል ፡ ርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.textGeez: ወርዕዮሙ ፡ በየዋሃተ ፡ ልቡ ወመርሖሙ ፡ በጥበበ ፡ እደዊሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፸፱ - እግዚኦ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርስትከ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፸፱ (79) - አቤቱ ፥ አሕዛብ፡ወደ፡ርስትኽ፡ገቡ የቅድስናኽንም፡መቅደስ፡አረከሱ ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 79 - Restore Us, O God of Hosts
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርስትከ ፡
ወአርኰሱ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅደስከ 
ወረሰይዋ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ከመ ፡ ልገተ ፡ ዐቃቤ ፡ ቀምሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰዩ ፡ አብድንቲሆሙ ፡ ለአግብርቲከ ፡ መብልዖሙ ፡ ለአዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ 
ወሥጋሆሙኒ ፡ ለጻድቃኒከ ፡ ለአረዊተ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ከዐዉ ፡ ደሞሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዐውዳ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም 
ወኀጥኡ ፡ ዘይቀብሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮነ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ለጎርነ 
ሣሕቀ ፡ ወስላቀ ፡ ለአድያሚነ ።
verses.textEnglish: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትትመዓዕ ፡ ለዝሉፉ 
ወይነድድ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሳት ፡ ቅንአትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.textGeez:
ከዐው ፡ መዐተከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢያአምሩከ 
ወላዕለ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢጸውዐት ፡ ስመከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ በልዕዎ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ወአማሰኑ ፡ ብሔሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትዝክር ፡ ለነ ፡ አበሳነ ፡ ዘትካት 
ፍጡነ ፡ ይርከበነ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
እስመ ፡ ተመንደብነ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

verses.textGeez:
ርድአነ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወመድኀኒነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ስምከ 
እግዚኦ ፡ ባልሐነ ፡ ወስረይ ፡ ኀጢአተነ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስምከ ።
verses.textAmharic: አምላካችንና፡መድኀኒታችን፡ሆይ ፥ ርዳን ስለስምኽ፡ክብር ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ታደገን ፥ ስለ፡ስምኽም፡ኀጢአታችንን፡አስ ተሰርይልን።
verses.textEnglish: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይበሉነ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ አይቴ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላኮሙ ።
ወይርአዩ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲነ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

verses.textGeez: በቀለ ፡ ደሞሙ ፡ ለአግብርቲከ ፡ ዘተክዕወ ።ይባእ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ገዐሮሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን
verses.textEnglish: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

verses.textGeez: ወበከመ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ መዝራዕትከ ፡ ተሣሀሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቅቱላን ።
verses.textEnglish: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

verses.textGeez: ፍድዮሙ ፡ ለጎርነ ፡ ምስብዒተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕፅኖሙ ትዕይርቶሙ ፡ ዘተዐየሩከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

verses.textGeez: ወንሕነሰ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ ወአባግዐ ፡ መርዔትከ ፡ ንገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

verses.textGeez: ወንነግር ፡ ስብሐቲከ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹ - ኖላዊሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ አፅምእ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፹ (80) - ዮሴፍን፡እንደ፡መንጋ፡የምትመራ ፥ የእስራኤል፡ጠባቂ፡ሆይ ፥ አድምጥ...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 80 - Sing Aloud to God Our Strength
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ እለ ፡ ተበዐዱ ፤ ስምዕ ፡ ዘአሳፍ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ አሶርዮን ።

verses.textGeez:
ኖላዊሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ አፅምእ 
ዘይርዕዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይነብር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኪሩቤል ፡ አስተርአየ ።
በቅድመ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወብንያም ፡ ወምናሴ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

verses.textGeez: አንሥእ ፡ ኀይለከ ወነዐ ፡ አድኅነነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.textGeez: አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ሚጠነ አብርህ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወንድኀን ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ትትመዓዕ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ጸሎተ ፡ ገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.textGeez:
ወትሴስየነ ፡ እክለ ፡ እንብዕነ 
ወታሰትየነ ፡ አንብዐነ ፡ በመስፈርት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰይከነ ፡ ነገሩ ፡ ለጎርነ 
ወተሳለቁ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ጸላእትነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ሚጠነ 
አብርህ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወንድኀን ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.textGeez:
ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ፡ አፍለስከ ፡ እምግብጽ 
ሰደድከ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወተከልከ ፡ ኪያሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.textGeez:
ወጼሕከ ፡ ግኖተ ፡ ቅድሜሃ 
ወተከልከ፡ ሥረዊሃ ፡ ወመልአት ፡ ምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

verses.textGeez:
ወከደነ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ጽላሎታ 
ወአዕጹቂሃኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ አርዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰፍሐ ፡ አዕጹቂሃ ፡ እስከ ፡ ባሕር 
ወእስከ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ሠርፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ ትነሥት ፡ ፀቈና 
ወይበልዓ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀላፌ ፡ ፍኖት ።
verses.textEnglish: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርኰሳ ፡ ሐራውያ ፡ ሐቅል 
ወተርዕያ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.textGeez:
አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ተመየጥሶ 
ሐውጽ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወርኢ ፡
ወተሣሀላ ፡ ለዛ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ።
verses.textEnglish: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.textGeez:
ወአስተናሥኣ ፡ ወአጽንዓ ፡ ዘተከለት ፡ የማንከ 
በወልደ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ዘአጽናዕከ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.textGeez:
ለውዒት ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወምልኅት 
ወእምተግሣጸ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.textGeez:
ለይኩን ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ የማንከ 
በወልደ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ዘአጽናዕከ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢንርሐቅ ፡ እምኔከ 
ኣሕይወነ ፡ ወንጼውዕ ፡ ስመከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ሚጠነ 
አብርህ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወንድኀን ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፩ - ተፈሥሑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘረድአነ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 81 - Rescue the Weak and Needy
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ማኅበብት ፡ ዘአሳፍ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘኃምስቱ ፡ ሰንበት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተፈሥሑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘረድአነ 
ወየብቡ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ንሥኡ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ወሀቡ ፡ ከበሮ 
መዝሙር፡ ሐዋዝ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መሰንቆ ።
verses.textEnglish: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.textGeez:
ንፍኁ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሠርቅ 
በእምርት ፡ ዕለት ፡ በዓልነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሥርዐቱ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ውእቱ 
ወፍትሑ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ወአቀመ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፡ አመ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ 
ወሰምዐ ፡ ልሳነ ፡ ዘኢያአምር ።
verses.textEnglish: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

verses.textGeez:
ወሜጠ ፡ ዘባኖ ፡ እምሕራማቲሆሙ 
ወተቀንያ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አክፋር ።
verses.textEnglish: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

verses.textGeez:
ወምንዳቤከ ፡ ጸዋዕከኒ ፡ ወአድኀንኩከ 
ወተሰጠውኩከ ፡ በዐውሎ ፡ ኅቡእ ፡
ወአመከርኩከ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ ቅሥት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ወእንግርከ 
እስራኤል ፡ ወኣስምዕ ፡ ለከ ።
እመሰ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ ፡ ኢይከውነከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ግብት 
ወኢትስግድ ፡ ለአምላክ ፡ ነኪር ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡
ዘአውፃእኩከ ፡ እምድረ ፡ ግብጽ 
አርሕብ ፡ አፉከ ፡ ወእነልኦ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢሰምዑኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ቃልየ 
ወእስራኤልኒ ፡ ኢያፅምኡኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈነውኩ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምግባሮሙ 
ወሖሩ ፡ በሕሊና ፡ ልቦመ ።
verses.textEnglish: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበሰ ፡ ሰምዑኒ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ቃልየ 
ወእስራኤልኒ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ሖሩ ፡ በፍኖትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

verses.textGeez:
እምአኅሰርክዎሙ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ለጸላእቶሙ 
ወእምወደይኩ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ዲበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሣቅይዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

verses.textGeez:
ጸላእቱሰ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሐሰውዎ 
ወይከውን ፡ ጊዜሆሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

verses.textGeez:
ወሴሰዮሙ ፡ ሥብሐ ፡ ስርናይ 
ወአጽገቦሙ ፡ መዓረ ፡ እምኰኵሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፪ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቆመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ አማልክት
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 82 - O God, Do Not Keep Silence
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቆመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅበረ ፡ አማልክት 
ወይኴንን ፡ በማእከለ ፡ አማልክት ።
verses.textEnglish: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ትኴንኑ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወታደልዉ ፡ ለገጸ ፡ ኃጥአን ።
verses.textEnglish: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ፍትሑ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ ወለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ 
ወአጽድቁ ፡ ግፉዐ ፡ ወምስኪነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኅኑ ፡ ባሕታዌ ፡ ወጽኑሰ 
ወአንግፍዎሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኃጥአን ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ኢያእመሩ ፡ ወኢለበዉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ የሐውሩ 
ወያድለቀልቁ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መሰረታተ ፡ አድባር ።
verses.textEnglish: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

verses.textGeez:
አንሰ ፡ እቤ ፡ አማልክት ፡ አንትሙ 
ወደቂቀ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

verses.textGeez: አንትሙሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ትመውቱ ወከመ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እመላእክት ፡ ትወድቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወኰንና ፡ ለምድር 
እስመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትወርስ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፫ - እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ከማከ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፹፫ (83) - አቤቱ ፥ እንደ፡አንተ፡ማን፡ነው፧አቤቱ ፥ ዝም፡አትበል ፥ ቸልም፡አትበል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 83 - How Lovely is Your Dwelling Place
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘአሳፍ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ከማከ 
ኢታርምም ፡ ወኢትጸመም ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ወውዑ ፡ ፀርከ 
ወአንሥኡ ፡ ርእሶሙ ፡ ጸላእትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

verses.textGeez:
ወተጓሕለውዎሙ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ለሕዝብከ 
ወተማከሩ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቅዱሳኒከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ ንዑ ፡ ንሥርዎሙ ፡ እምአሕዛብ 
ወኢይዝክሩ ፡ እንከ ፡ ስመ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተማከሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ወዐረዩ 
ላዕሌከ ፡ ተሰካተዩ ፡ ወተካየዱ ።
ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ለኢዶምያስ ፡ ወለእስማኤላውያን
verses.textEnglish: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

verses.textGeez:
ሞአብ ፡ ወአጋራውያን ።ጌባል ፡ ወአሞን ፡ ወአማሌቅ 
ወአሎፍሊ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ጢሮስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.textGeez:
ወአሶርሂ ፡ ኀበረ ፡ ምስሌሆሙ 
ወኮንዎሙ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሎጥ ።
verses.textEnglish: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.textGeez:
ረስዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ምድያም ፡ ወሲሳራ 
ወከመ ፡ ኢያቤስ ፡ በፈለገ ፡ ቂሶን ።
verses.textEnglish: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሠረዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ እለ ፡ እንዶር 
ወይኩኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሬተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.textGeez: ረስዮሙ ፡ ለመላእክቲሆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሆሬብ ፡ ወዜብ
verses.textEnglish: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

verses.textGeez: ወዜብሄል ፡ ወሰልማና ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ መላእክቲሆሙ ።እለ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ንወርስ ፡ ምስዋዒሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ ረስዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ መንኰራኵር 
ወከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ ዘቅድመ ፡ ገጸ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

verses.textGeez:
ወከመ ፡ እሳት ፡ ዘያውዒ ፡ ገዳመ 
ወከመ ፡ ነበልባል ፡ ዘያነድድ ፡ አድባረ ።
verses.textEnglish: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.textGeez:
ከማሁ ፡ ስድዶሙ ፡ በዐውሎከ 
ወሁኮሙ ፡ በመቅሠፍትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

verses.textGeez:
ምላእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ኀሳረ 
ወያእምሩ ፡ ስመከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

verses.textGeez:
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይትሀወኩ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወይኅሰሩ ፡ ወይትሐጐሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወያእምሩ ፡ ስመከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ከመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፬ - ጥቅ ፡ ፍቁር ፡ አብያቲከ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 84 - Show Us Your Steadfast Love, O Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ማኅበብት ፤ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ።

verses.textGeez:
ጥቅ ፡ ፍቁር ፡ አብያቲከ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ።
ተፈሥሐት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በአፍቅሮ ፡ አዕጻዲከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

verses.textGeez: ልብየኒ ፡ ወሥጋየኒ ፡ ተፈሥሐ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

verses.textGeez:
ዖፍኒ ፡ ረከበት ፡ ላቲ ፡ ቤተ ፡
ወማዕነቅኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ታነብር ፡ እጐሊሃ
verses.textEnglish: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.

verses.textGeez: ምሥዋዒከ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ንጉሥየኒ ፡ ወአምላኪየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ብፁዓን ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤትከ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ይሴብሑከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘእምኀቤከ ፡ ረድኤቱ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወዘይሔሊ ፡ በልቡ ፡ ዘበላዕሉ ።
ውስተ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ብካይ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሠራዕኮሙ
verses.textEnglish: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ መምህረ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ በረከተ ።ወይሐውር ፡ እምኀይል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኀይል 
ወያስተርኢ ፡ አምላከ ፡ አማልክት ፡ በጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያላን ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወርእየኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተአምኖትየ 
ወነጽር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ገጸ ፡ መሲሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ትኄይስ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጻዲከ ፡ እምአእላፍ
verses.textEnglish: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.textGeez: አብደርኩ ፡ እትገደፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡እምእንበር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ወምጽዋተ ፡ ያበድር ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወሞገሰ
verses.textEnglish: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢያስተጼንሶሙ ፡ እምበረከቱ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሐውሩ ፡ በየዋሃት ።እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያለን 
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘተወከለ ፡ ኪያከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፭ - ተሣሀልከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ምድረከ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፹፭ (85) - አቤቱ ፥ ለምድርኽ፡ሞገስን፡አደረግኽ ፥ የያዕቆብንም፡ምርኮ፡መለስኽ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 85 - Teach Me Your Way, O Lord
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ጸሎት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀልከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ምድረከ 
ወሜጥከ ፡ ፄዋሁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀደገ ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ ፡ ለሕዝብከ 
ወከደንከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አበሳሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀደገ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መዐትከ ።
ወሜጥከ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ መዐተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

verses.textGeez:
ሚጠነ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወመድኀኒነ 
ወሚጥ ፡ መዐተከ ፡ እምኔነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

verses.textGeez:
ወለዓለምሰ ፡ ኢትትመዐዐነ ።
ወኢታኑኅ ፡ መዐተከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ተመየጠነ ፡ ወኣሕይወነ 
ወሕዝብከኒ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

verses.textGeez:
አርእየነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ሣህለከ 
ወሀበነ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ አድኅኖተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ኣፀምእ ፡ ዘይነበኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ 
እስመ ፡ ይነብብ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡
verses.textEnglish: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.textGeez: ላዕለ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይመይጡ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ኀቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.textGeez: ወባሕቱ ፡ ቅሩብ ፡ አድኅኖቱ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ከመ ፡ ይኅድር ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድርነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.textGeez:
ሣህል ፡ ወርትዕ ፡ ተራከባ 
ጽድቅ ፡ ወሰላም ፡ ተሳዐማ ።
verses.textEnglish: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.textGeez:
ርትዕሰ ፡ እምድር ፡ ሠረጸት 
ወጽድቅኒ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ሐወጸ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.textGeez:
ወእግዚአብሔርኒ ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ምሕረቶ 
ወምድርኒ ፡ ትሁብ ፡ ፍሬሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

verses.textGeez:
ጽድቅ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ቅድሜሁ 
ወየኀድግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ አሰሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፮ - አፅምእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወስምዐኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 86 - Glorious Things of You are Spoken, O Zion
psalms.heading: ጸሎት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አፅምእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወስምዐኒ 
እስመ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፡ አነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

verses.textGeez:
ዕቀባ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እስመ ፡ የዋህ ፡ አን 
አድኅኖ ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ዘተወከለ ፡ ኪያከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ እጸርኅ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ።
ወአስተፈሥሓ ፡ ለነፍሰ ፡ ገብርከ 
እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ አንቃዕደውኩ ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ መሓሪ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወመስተሣህል 
ወብዙኅ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼውዑከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.textGeez:
አፅምእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወነጽር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

verses.textGeez: በዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤየ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.textGeez:
አልቦ ፡ ዘይመስለከ ፡ እምነ ፡ አማልክት ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ምግባሪከ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ገበርከ ፡
ይምጽኡ ፡ ወይስግዱ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወይሰብሑ ፡ ለስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወትገብር ፡ መንክረ 
አንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ዐቢይ ።
verses.textEnglish: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ምርሐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፍኖተከ ፡ ወእሖር ፡ በጽድቅከ 
ይትፌሣሕኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ለፈሪሀ ፡ ስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ፡ አምላኪየ 
ወእሴብሕ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐብየት ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወአድኀንካ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምሲኦል ፡ ታሕቲት ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ ዐማፅያን ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡
ወማኅበረ ፡ እኩያን ፡ ኀሠሥዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ 
ወኢረሰዩከ ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል 
ርሑቀ ፡ መዐት ፡ ወብዙኀ ፡ ምሕረት ፡ ወጻድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

verses.textGeez:
ነጽር ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወተሣሀለኒ 
ሀቦ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ ወአድኅኖ ፡ ለወልደ ፡ አመትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.textGeez:
ግበር ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ለሠናይ 
ወይርአዩ ፡ ጸላእትነ ፡ ወይትኀፈሩ ፡
ከመ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ረዳእከነ ፡ ወአስተፈሣሕከነ ።
verses.textEnglish: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፯ - መሰረታቲሃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ቅዱሳን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 87 - O Lord, God of My Salvation
psalms.heading: ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ማኅሌት ።

verses.textGeez:
መሰረታቲሃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ቅዱሳን ።
ያበድሮን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአንቅጸ ፡ ጽዮን 
እምኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኒሁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.textGeez: ነኪር ፡ ነገሩ ፡ በእንቲአኪ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.textGeez: እዜክሮን ፡ ለራአብ ፡ ወለባቢሎን ፡ እለ ፡ ያአምራኒ
verses.textEnglish: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወናሁ ፡ አሎፍሊ ፡ ወጢሮስ ፡ ወሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ በህየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

verses.textGeez:
እምነ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ይብል ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወብእሲ ፡ ተወልደ ፡ በውስቴታ 
ወወእቱ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ሳረራ ።
verses.textEnglish: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይነግሮሙ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ በመጽሐፍ 
ወለመላእክቲሁኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ተወልዱ ፡ በውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ፍሡሓን ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴትኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፰ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፹፰ (88) - አቤቱ ፥ የመድኀኒቴ፡አምላክ ፥ በቀንና፡በሌሊት፡በፊትኽ፡ጮኽኹ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 88 - I Will Sing of the Steadfast Love of the Lord
psalms.heading: ምኅሌት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘደቂቀ ፡ ቆሬ ፡ ፍጻሜ ፡ ዘአመ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ኤማን ፡ እስራኤላዊ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ መድኀኒትየ 
ዕለትየ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ወሌሊትየኒ ፡ ቅድሜከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

verses.textGeez:
ለትባእ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ቅድሜከ 
አፅምእ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጸግበት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ሕማመ 
ወአልጸቀት ፡ ለሞት ፡ ሕይወትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

verses.textGeez:
ወተኈለቁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐዘቅት 
ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ረዳኤ ።
ግዑዘ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምዉታን
verses.textEnglish: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ቅቱላን ፡ ወግዱፋን ፡ እለ ፡ ይሰክቡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብር ፡እለ ፡ ኢዘከርኮሙ ፡ ለግሙራ 
እስመ ፡ እሙንቱሂ ፡ ርሕቁ ፡ እምእዴከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንበሩኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐዘቅት ፡ ታሕተ 
ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.textGeez:
ላዕሌየ ፡ ጸንዐ ፡ መዐትከ 
ወኵሎ ፡ መቅሠፍተከ ፡ አምጻእከ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
አርሐቀ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ እለ ፡ ያአምሩኒ 
ወረሰይከኒ ፡ ርኩሰ ፡ በኀቤሆሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.textGeez: አኀዙኒ ፡ ወአልብየ ፡ ሙፃአ ።አዕይንትየኒ ፡ ደክማ ፡ በተጽናስ
verses.textEnglish: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

verses.textGeez: ወጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ኣንሥእ ፡ እደውየ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ቦኑ ፡ ለምዉታን ፡ ትገብር ፡ መንክረከ 
ወዐቀብተ ፡ ሥራይኑ ፡ ያነሥኡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

verses.textGeez:
ወይነግሩኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቃብር ፡ ሣህለከ 
ወጽድቀከኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሞትኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.textGeez:
ወይትዐወቅኑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ መንክርከ 
ወርትዕከኒ ፡ በምድርኑ ፡ ተረስዐ ።
verses.textEnglish: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወአነሂ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ጸራኅኩ 
በጽባሕ ፡ ትብጻሕ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ቅድሜከ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

verses.textGeez:
ለምንት ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትገድፍ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወትመይጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

verses.textGeez:
ነዳይ ፡ አነ ፡ ወሰራሕኩ ፡ እምንእስየ 
ተልዒልየ ፡ ተተሐትኩ ፡ ወተመነንኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.textGeez:
ላዕሌየ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ መቅሠፍትከ 
ወግርማከ ፡ አደንገፀኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

verses.textGeez:
ዐገቱኒ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ 
ወአኀዙኒ ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

verses.textGeez:
አርሐቀ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ አዕርክትየ ፡ ወቢጽየ 
ወአዝማድየ ፡ እምተጽናስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፹፱ - ምሕረተከ ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለም
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 89 - Lord, You Have Been Our Dwelling Place
psalms.heading: ዘበኣእምሮ ፡ ኤታን ፡ እስራኤላዊ ።

verses.textGeez: ምሕረተከ ፡ እሴብሕ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለም
verses.textEnglish: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

verses.textGeez: ወእዜኑ ፡ ጽድቀከ ፡ በአፉየ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ትቤ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ አሐንጽ ፡ ምሕረተ በሰማይ ፡ ጸንዐ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.textGeez:
ኪዳነ ፡ ተካየድኩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኅሩያንየ 
ወመሐልኩ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ገብርየ ።
ለዓለም ፡ አስተዴሉ ፡ ዘርዐከ
verses.textEnglish: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወአሐንጽ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ መንበረከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.textGeez: ይገንያ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ለስብሐቲከ ፡ እግዚኦ ወጽድቅከኒ ፡ በማኅበረ ፡ ቅዱሳን ።
verses.textEnglish: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይትዔረዮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በደመናት 
ወመኑ ፡ ይመስሎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምደቂቀ ፡ አማልክት ።
verses.textEnglish: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ስቡሕ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ቅዱሳን 
ዐቢይ ፡ ወግሩም ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ዐውዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላከ ፡ ኀያለን ፡ መኑ ፡ ከማከ 
ኀያል ፡ እንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወጽድቅ ፡ የዐውደከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ ትኴንን ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ባሕር 
ወአንተ ፡ ታረሞ ፡ ለድምፀ ፡ ማዕበላ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ አኅሰርኮ ፡ ለዕቡይ ፡ ከመ ፡ ቅቱል 
ወበመዝራዕተ ፡ ኀይልከ ፡ ዘረውኮሙ ፡ ለፀርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

verses.textGeez:
ዚአከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወእንቲአከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር 
ወዓለመኒ ፡ በምልኡ ፡ አንተ ፡ ሳረርከ ።
ባሕረ ፡ ወመስዐ ፡ አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

verses.textGeez:
ታቦር ፡ ወአርሞንኤም ፡ በስመ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡
ወይሴብሑ ፡ ለስምከ ።
መዝራዕትከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይል
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

verses.textGeez: ጸንዐት ፡ እዴከ ፡ ወተለዐለት ፡ የማንከ ።ፍትሕ ፡ ወርትዕ ፡ ተድላ ፡ መንበርከ
verses.textEnglish: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

verses.textGeez: ሣህል ፡ ወጽድቅ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።ብፁዕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘያአምር ፡ የብቦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በብርሃበ ፡ ገጽከ ፡ የሐውሩ 
ወበስምከ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ 
ወበጽድቅከ ፡ ይትሌዐሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ምክሐ ፡ ኀይሎሙ ፡ እንተ 
ወበሣህልከ ፡ ይትሌዐል ፡ ቀርንነ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ ረድኤትነ 
ወቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ንጉሥነ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ተናገርኮሙ ፡ በራእይ ፡ ለደቂቅከ 
ወትቤ ፡ እሬሲ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ በላዕለ ፡ ኀይል ፡
ወአልዐልኩ ፡ ኅሩየ ፡ እምሕዝብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.textGeez:
ወረከብክዎ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ገብርየ 
ወቀባእክዎ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ቅዱሰ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ትረድኦ 
ወመዝራዕትየ ፡ ታጸንዖ ።
verses.textEnglish: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይብቍዕ ፡ ጸላኢ ፡ በላዕሌሁ 
ወውሉድ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ኢይደግም ፡ አሕምሞቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምትሮሙ ፡ ለፀሩ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ 
ወኣኅስሮሙ ፡ ለጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.textGeez:
ወሣህልየሰ ፡ ወጽድቅየ ፡ ምስሌሁ 
ወበስምየ ፡ ይትሌዐል ፡ ቀርኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.textGeez:
ወእሠይም ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ እዴሁ 
ወውስተ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ የማኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ ይብለኒ ፡ አቡየ ፡ አንተ 
አምላኪየ ፡ ወረዳእየ ፡ ወመድኀንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ወአነሂ ፡ በኵርየ ፡ እሬስዮ 
ወልዑል ፡ እምነገሥተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወለዓለም ፡ አዐቅብ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ሣህልየ 
ወምእመን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለኪዳንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.textGeez:
ወእሬሲ ፡ ዘርዖ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወመንበሮሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.textGeez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ኀደጉ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ሕግየ 
ወኢሖሩ ፡ በኵነኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.textGeez:
ወእመሂ ፡ አርኰሱ ፡ ሥርዐትየ 
ወኢዐቀቡ ፡ ትእዛዝየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.textGeez:
እዋሕያ ፡ በበትር ፡ ለኀጢአቶሙ 
ወበመቅሠፍት ፡ ለአበሳሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.textGeez:
ወሣህልየሰ ፡ ኢይበልእ ፡ እምኔሆሙ 
ወኢይዔምፅ ፡ በጸድቅየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢያረኵስ ፡ ኪዳንየ 
ወኢይሔሱ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምአፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.textGeez:
ምዕረ ፡ መሐልኩ ፡ በቅዱስየ 
ከመ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ኢይሔስዎ ።
ወዘርዑሂ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይሄሉ
verses.textEnglish: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

verses.textGeez:
ወመንበሩሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ በቅድሜየ ።ወሥሩዕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ለዓለም 
ወስምዑሂ ፡ ምእመን ፡ በሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ መነንኮ ፡ ወገደፍኮ 
ወአናሕሰይኮ ፡ ለመሲሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ወሜጥከ ፡ ሥርዐቶ ፡ ለገብርከ 
ወአርኰስከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ መቅደሶ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

verses.textGeez:
ወነሠትከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጥቅሞ 
ወረሰይከ ፡ አጽዋኒሁ ፡ መፍርሀ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

verses.textGeez:
ወተማሰጦ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀላፌ ፡ ፍኖት 
ወኮነ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ለጎሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.textGeez:
ወአልዐልከ ፡ የማነ ፡ ፀሩ 
ወአስተፈሣሕከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.textGeez:
ወሜጥከ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ ኲናቱ 
ወኢተወከፍኮ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፀብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰዐርኮ ፡ እምንጽሑ 
ወነፃሕከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ መንበሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውኀድከ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ መንበሩ 
ወሶጥከ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ኀፍረተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትትመየጥ ፡ ለግሙራ 
ወይነድድ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሳት ፡ መዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘከር ፡ ምንት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኀይልየ 
ቦኑ ፡ ለከንቱ ፡ ፈጠርኮ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ዘየሐዩ ፡ ወኢይሬእዮ ፡ ለሞት 
ወመኑ ፡ ዘያድኅና ፡ ለነፍሱ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ሲኦል ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

verses.textGeez:
አይቴ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘትካት ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ዘመሐልከ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ገብርከ ፡ በጽድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘከር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዘጸአልዎሙ ፡ ለአግብርቲከ 
ዘተወከፍኩ ፡ በሕፅንየ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

verses.textGeez:
ዘጸአሉ ፡ ጸላእትከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወጸአሉ ፡ እብሬተ ፡ መሲሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

verses.textGeez: ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዓለም ለይኩን ፡ ለይኩን ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺ - እግዚኦ ፡ ጸወነ ፡ ኮንከነ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 90 - He Who Dwells in the Shelter of the Most High
psalms.heading: ጸሎት ፡ ዘሙሴ ፡ ዘብእሴ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ ጸወነ ፡ ኮንከነ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ዘእንበለ ፡ ይቁም ፡ አድባር ፡ ወይትፈጠር ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወምድር 
እምቅድመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ አንተ ፡ ክመ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትሚጦ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ለኀሳር 
ወትቤ ፡ ተመየጡ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ምእት ፡ ዐመት ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡
ከመ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ትማልም ፡ ኀለፈት
verses.textEnglish: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

verses.textGeez: ወሰዓተ ፡ ሌሊት ።ምኑን ፡ ዐመታት ፡ በቅድሜሆሙ
verses.textEnglish: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

verses.textGeez:
በጽባሕ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ የኀልፍ ።በጽባሕ ፡ ይሠርጽ ፡ ወየኀልፍ 
ወሰርከሰ ፡ ይወድቅ ፡ የቢሶ ፡ ወአንፂዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀለቅነ ፡ በመዐትከ 
ወደንገፅነ ፡ በመቅሠፍትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

verses.textGeez:
ወሤምከ ፡ ኀጢአተነ ፡ ቅድሜከ 
ወዓለምነሂ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀልቃ ፡ ኵሎን ፡ መዋዕሊነ ፡
ወኀለቅነ ፡ በመቅሠፍትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐመቲነኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሳሬት ፡ ይከውና ።
ወመዋዕለ ፡ ዐመቲነ ፡ ሰብዓ ፡ ክራማት ፡
verses.textAmharic: የዘመኖቻችንም፡ዕድሜ፡ሰባ፡ዓመት ፥ ቢበረታም፡ሰማንያ፡ዓመት፡ነው ቢበዛ፡ግን፡ድካምና፡መከራ፡ነው ከእ ኛ፡ቶሎ፡ያልፋልና ፥ እኛም፡እንገሠጻለንና።
verses.textEnglish: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.textGeez: ወእመሰ ፡ በዝኃ ፡ ሰማንያ ፡ ዓም ወፈድፋድንሰ ፡ እምእላ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ወሕማም ።
verses.textEnglish: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ኀለፈት ፡ የዋሃት ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወተገሠጽነ ።
verses.textEnglish: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ኀይለ ፡ መቅሠፍትከ 
ወእምግርማ ፡ መዐትከ ፡ ኀልቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

verses.textGeez:
ከመዝ ፡ አርኢ ፡ የማነከ 
ለምሁራን ፡ ልብ ፡ በጥበብ ።
verses.textEnglish: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.textGeez:
ተመየጥ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ 
ወተናበብ ፡ በእንተ ፡ አግብርቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጸገብነ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ምሕረተከ 
ወተፈሣሕነ ፡ ወተሐሠይነ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕሊነ
verses.textEnglish: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

verses.textGeez: ወተፈሣሕነ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ዘኣሕመምከነ ወህየንተ ፡ ዐመት ፡ እንተ ፡ ርኢናሃ ፡ ለእኪት ።
verses.textEnglish: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

verses.textGeez:
ርኢ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ተግባርከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወምርሖሙ ፡ ለደቂቆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

verses.textGeez:
ለይኩን ፡ ብርሃኑ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ላዕሌነ 
[ወይሠርሕ ፡ ለነ ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊነ ፡]
ወይሠርሕ ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊነ ።
verses.textEnglish: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፩ - ዘየኀድር ፡ በረድኤተ ፡ ልዑል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 91 - How Great are Your Works, O Lord
psalms.heading: ስብሐት ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ዘየኀድር ፡ በረድኤተ ፡ ልዑል 
ወይነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽላሎቱ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.textGeez:
ይብሎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስካይየ ፡ ወጸወንየ ፡ አንተ 
አምላኪየ ፡ ወረዳእየ ፡ ወእትዌከል ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይባልሐኒ ፡ እመሥገርት ፡ ነዓዊት 
ወእምነገር ፡ መደንግፅ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.textGeez: ይጼልለከ ፡ በገበዋቲሁ ፡ ወትትዌከል ፡ በታሕተ ፡ ክነፊሁ
verses.textEnglish: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

verses.textGeez: ጽድቅ ፡ በወልታ ፡ የዐውደከ ።ወኢትፈርህ ፡ እምግርማ ፡ ሌሊት
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.textGeez:
እምሐጽ ፡ ዘይሠርር ፡ በመዐልት ።እምግብር ፡ ዘየሐውር ፡ በጽልመት 
እምጽድቅ ፡ ወእምጋኔነ ፡ ቀትር ።
verses.textEnglish: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
