verses.textGeez:
ይወድቁ ፡ በገቦከ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ምእት ፡ ወኣእላፍ ፡ በየማንከ 
ወኀቤከሰ ፡ ኢይቀርቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ትሬኢ ፡ በኣዕይንቲከ 
ወትሬኢ ፡ ፍዳሆሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተስፋየ 
ልዑል ፡ ረሰይከ ፡ ጸወነከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

verses.textGeez:
ኢይቀርብ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ኀቤከ 
ወኢይበውእ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ቤተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ለመላእክቲሁ ፡ ይኤዝዞሙ ፡ በእንቲአከ 
ከመ ፡ ይዕቀቡከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.textGeez:
ወበእደው ፡ ያነሥኡከ 
ከመ ፡ ኢትትዐቀፍ ፡ በእብን ፡ እግረከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.textGeez:
ላዕለ ፡ ተኵላ ፡ ወከይሲ ፡ ትጼዐን 
ወትከይድ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ወከይሴ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ብየ ፡ ተወከለ ፡ ወኣድኅኖ 
ወእከድኖ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኣእመረ ፡ ስምየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

verses.textGeez:
ይጼውዐኒ ፡ ወእሰጠዎ ፡
ሀሎኩ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ አመ ፡ ምንዳቤሁ 
ኣድኅኖ ፡ ወእሰብሖ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.textGeez:
ለነዋኅ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ኣጸግቦ 
ወኣርእዮ ፡ አድኅኖትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፪ - ይኄይስ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 92 - The Lord Reigns, Robed in Majesty
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ በዓለተ ፡ ሰንበት ።

verses.textGeez:
ይኄይስ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወዘምሮ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

verses.textGeez:
ወነጊረ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወጽድቅከኒ ፡ በሌሊት ።
verses.textEnglish: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

verses.textGeez: በዘዐሠርቱ ፡ አውታሪሁ ፡ መዝሙረ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ወመሰንቆ ።
verses.textEnglish: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አስተፈሣሕከኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በምግባሪከ 
ወእትሐሠይ ፡ በግብረ ፡ እደዊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

verses.textGeez:
ጥቀ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ግብርከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወፈድፋደ ፡ ዕሙቅ ፡ ሕሊናከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.textGeez:
ብእሲ ፡ አብድ ፡ ኢያአምር 
ወዘአልቦ ፡ ልበ ፡ ኢይሌብዎ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡፡
verses.textEnglish: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ ይበቍሉ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ወይሠርጹ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ
verses.textEnglish: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ይሠረዉ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ወአንተሰ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ለዓለም ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ናሁ ፡ ጸላእትከ ፡ ይትሐጐሉ 
ወይዘረዉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትሌዐል ፡ ቀርንየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘአሐዱ ፡ ቀርኑ 
ወይጠልል ፡ በቅብእ ፡ ሲበትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.textGeez:
ወርእየት ፡ ዐይንየ ፡ በጸላእትየ ፡
ወሰምዐት ፡ እዝንየ ፡ ዲቤሆሙ ፡ ለእኩያን ፡ እለ ፡ ቆሙ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.textGeez:
ጻድቅከ ፡ ከመ ፡ በቀልት ፡ ይፈሪ 
ወይበዝኅ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘግባ ፡ ዘሊባኖስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.textGeez:
ትኩላን ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይበቍሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐጸዱ ፡ ለአምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይበዝኁ ፡ በርሥኣን ፡ ጥሉል 
ወይከውኑ ፡ ዕሩፋነ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.textGeez:
ወይነግሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ በኀቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፫ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ለብሰ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፺፫ (93) - እግዚአብሔር፡ነገሠ ፥ ክብርንም፡ለበሰ እግዚአብሔር፡ኀይልን፡ለበሰ ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 93 - The Lord Knows the Thoughts of Man
psalms.heading: በዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ አመ ፡ ኅድረተ ፡ ምድር ፤ ሰብሐተ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ለብሰ 
ለብሰ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኀይሎ ፡ ወቀነተ
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ነገሠ ፥ ክብርንም፡ለበሰ እግዚአብሔር፡ኀይልን፡ለበሰ ፥ ታጠቀም ዓለምን፡እንዳትናወጥ፡አጸና ት።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

verses.textGeez: ወአጽንዓ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢታንቀልቅል ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

verses.textGeez: ድልው ፡ መንበርከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምትካት ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ አንተ ፡ ክመ ።
verses.textEnglish: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.textGeez:
አልዐሉ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ እግዚኦ 
አልዐሉ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ቃላቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.textGeez: ያሌዕሉ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ድምፆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እምቃለ ፡ ማያት ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ መንክር ፡ ተላህያ ፡ ለባሕር 
መንክርሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በአርያሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ እሙን ፡ ፈድፋደ ለቤትከ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ስብሐት 
እግዚኦ ፡ ለነዋኅ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፬ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ እግዚእ ፡ መስተበቅል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 94 - Oh Come, Let Us Sing to the Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘበረቡዕ ሰንበት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ እግዚእ ፡ መስተበቅል 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ መስተበቅል ፡ ገሀደ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ ዘይኴንና ፡ ለምድር 
ፍድዮሙ ፡ ፍዳሆሙ ፡ ለዕቡያን ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እግዚኦ 
እስከ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ይዜሀሩ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.textGeez:
ይትዋሥኡ ፡ ወይነቡ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወይነቡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.textGeez:
ወአኅሰሩ ፡ ሕዝበከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወሣቀዩ ፡ ርስተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተሉ ፡ እቤረ ፡ ወእጓለ ፡ ማውታ 
ወቀተሉ ፡ ፈላሴ ።
verses.textEnglish: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ ኢይሬኢ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወኢያአምር ፡ አምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

verses.textGeez:
ለብዉ ፡ አብዳነ ፡ ሕዝብ 
አብዳንኬ ፡ ማእዜኑ ፡ ይጠቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

verses.textGeez:
ወተከላሁ ፡ ለእዝን ፡ ኢይሰምዕኑ 
ወዘፈጠራሁ ፡ ለዐይን ፡ ኢይሬኢኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.textGeez:
ዘይጌሥጾሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ኢይዛለፍኑ 
ዘይሜህሮሙ ፡ ለሰብእ ፡ ጥበበ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያአምር ፡ ሕሊናሆሙ ፡ ለጠቢባን ፡ ከመ ፡ ከንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘአንተ ፡ ገሠጽኮ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወዘመሀርኮ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይትገሐስ ፡ እምዋዕል ፡ እኩያት 
እስከ ፡ ይትከረይ ፡ ግብ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢይገድፎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሕዝቡ 
ወኢየኀድጎሙ ፡ ለርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.textGeez:
እስከ ፡ ይገብእ ፡ ፍትሕ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይጸድቅ 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ ርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ፡ እለ ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ ቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይትናሥአኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እኩያን 
ወመኑ ፡ ይትቃወመኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘረድአኒ 
ሕቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘእምኀደረት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ።
verses.textEnglish: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.textGeez:
ወሶበ ፡ እቤ ፡ ድኅፃ ፡ እገርየ 
ምሕረትከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ረድአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ ሕማማ ፡ ለልብየ 
ናዝዞትከ ፡ አስተፈሥሓ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይትቃወመከ ፡ መንበረ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ዘይፈጥር ፡ ጻማ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ትእዛዝ ።
verses.textEnglish: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.textGeez:
ወይንዕውዋ ፡ ለነፍሰ ፡ ጻድቅ 
ወይኴንኑ ፡ ደመ ፡ ንጹሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮነኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸወንየ 
አምላኪየ ፡ ወረድኤተ ፡ ተስፋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

verses.textGeez:
ወይፈድዮሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ እከዮሙ 
ወያጠፍኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፭ - ንዑ ፡ ንትፈሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፺፭ (95) - ኑ ፥ በእግዚአብሔር፡ደስ፡ይበለን ለአምላክ፡ለመድኀኒታችን፡እልል፡እንበል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 95 - Sing to the Lord a New Song
psalms.heading: ስብሐተ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ንዑ ፡ ንትፈሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወንየብብ ፡ ለአምላክነ ፡ ወመድኀኒነ ።
verses.textEnglish: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ወንብጻሕ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ በአሚን 
ወበመዝሙር ፡ ንየብብ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ 
ወንጉሥ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አማልክት ።
እስመ ፡ ኢይገድፎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሕዝቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር 
ወአድባር ፡ ነዋኃት ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እንቲአሁ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ፈጠራ 
ወለየብሰኒ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ገብራ ።
ንዑ ፡ ንስግድ ፡ ወንግነይ ፡ ሎቱ
verses.textEnglish: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

verses.textGeez: ወንብኪ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ፈጠረነ ።እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክነ
verses.textEnglish: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

verses.textGeez:
ወንሕነሰ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ አባግዐ ፡ መርዔቱ ዮም ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃሎ ።
ኢታጽንዑ ፡ ልበክሙ ፡
verses.textEnglish: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ አመ ፡ አምረርዎ ፡ በገዳም ፡ ወአመ ፡ አመከርዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.textGeez: ዘአመከሩኒ ፡ አበዊክሙ ፈተኑኒ ፡ ወርእዩ ፡ መግባርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.textGeez:
ወአርብዓ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተቈጣዕክዋ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ትውልድ ፡
ወእቤ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ይስሕት ፡ ልቦሙ
verses.textEnglish: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

verses.textGeez:
ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ኢያእመሩ ፡ ፍናውየ ።በከመ ፡ መሐልኩ ፡ በመዐትየ 
ከመ ፡ ኢይበውኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዕረፍትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፮ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 96 - The Lord Reigns, Let the Earth Rejoice
psalms.heading: ዘአመ ፡ ተሐንጸ ፡ ቤት ፡ ዘእምድኅረ ፡ ፂዋዌ ፤ ማኅሌት ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵላ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወባርኩ ፡ ለስሙ 
ወተዘያነዉ ፡ እምዕለት ፡ ዕለተ ፡ አድኅኖቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.textGeez:
ወንግርዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ 
ወለኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ተኣምሪሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብዙኅ ፡ አኰቴቱ 
ወግሩም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አማልክት ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ አጋንንት 
ወእግዚአብሔርሰ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.textGeez:
አሚን ፡ ወሠናይት ፡ ቅድሜሁ 
ቅድሳት ፡ ወዕበየ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መቅደሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.textGeez:
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በሓውርተ ፡ አሕዛብ 
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወስብሓተ ።
አምጽኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ለስሙ
verses.textEnglish: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.textGeez: ንሥኡ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወባኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጻዲሁ ።ስግዱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በዐጸደ ፡ መቅደሱ
verses.textEnglish: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.textGeez: ታድለቀልቅ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ኵላ ፡ ምድር ።በልዎሙ ፡ ለኣሕዛብ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡
verses.textEnglish: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

verses.textGeez: ወአጽንዓ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢታንቀልቅል ወይኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ በርትዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሓ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ወትትሐሠይ ፡ ምድር 
ወትትከወስ ፡ ባሕር ፡ በምልኣ ።
ትትሐሠይ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘውስቴታ
verses.textEnglish: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ገዳም ።እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ይመጽእ ፡
ወይመጽእ ፡ ወይኴንና ፡ ለምድር
verses.textEnglish: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

verses.textGeez: ወይኴንና ፡ ለዓለም ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ወለአሕዛብኒ ፡ በርትዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፯ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ትትሐሠር ፡ ምድር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፺፯ (97) - እግዚአብሔር፡ነገሠ ምድር፡ሐሤትን፡ታድርግ ፥ ብዙ፡ደሴቶችም፡ደስ፡ይበላቸው
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 97 - Make a Joyful Noise to the Lord
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘአመ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ምድሩ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ትትሐሠር ፡ ምድር 
ወይትሐሥያ ፡ ደሰያት ፡ ብዙኃት ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

verses.textGeez:
ደመና ፡ ወቆባር ፡ ዐውዶ 
ፍትሕ ፡ ወርትዕ ፡ ተድላ ፡ መንበሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

verses.textGeez:
እሳት ፡ ይሐውር ፡ ቅድሜሁ 
ወነድ ፡ የዐግቶሙ ፡ ለጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

verses.textGeez:
አስተርአየ ፡ መባርቅቲሁ ፡ ለዓለም 
ርእየት ፡ ወአድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድባርኒ ፡ ተመሰዉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ስምዕ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵላ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.textGeez:
ይነግራ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ዚአሁ 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.textGeez:
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሰግዱ ፡ ለግልፎ 
እለ ፡ ይትሜክሑ ፡ በአማልክቲሆሙ
verses.textEnglish: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

verses.textGeez: ወይስግዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ መላእክቲሁ ።ሰምዐት ፡ ወተፈሥሐት ፡ ጽዮን ፡
verses.textEnglish: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.

verses.textGeez: ወተሐሥያ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ይሁዳ በእንተ ፡ ፍትሕከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ልዑል ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር 
ፈድፋደ ፡ ተለዐልከ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ አማልክት ።
verses.textEnglish: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ታፈቅርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ጽልእዋ ፡ ለእኪት 
የዐቅብ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ፡
ወያድኅኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.textGeez: በርህ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ለጻድቃን ወለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ፡ ትፍሥሕት ።
verses.textEnglish: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ወይገንዩ ፡ ለዝክረ ፡ ቅድሳቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፰ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 98 - The Lord is Holy
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ 
እስመ ፡ መንክረ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
verses.textEnglish: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

verses.textGeez: ወአድኅኖተ ፡ የማኑ ፡ ወመዝራዕቲሂ ፡ ቅዱስ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

verses.textGeez: አርአየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አድኅኖቶ ወበቅድመ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ከሠተ ፡ ኪዳኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከረ ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡
ወጽድቀሂ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ እስራኤል
verses.textEnglish: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.textGeez: ርእዩ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ አድኅኖቶ ፡ ለአምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.textGeez: የብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር ሰብሑ ፡ ተፈሥሑ ፡ ወዘምሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

verses.textGeez:
ዘምሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በመሰንቆ 
በመሰንቆ፡ ወበቃለ ፡ መዝሙር ።
በቀርነ ፡ ዝብጦ ፡ ወበቃለ ፡ ቀርን
verses.textEnglish: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
የብቡ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንጉሥ ።ወትትከወስ ፡ ባሕር ፡ በምልኣ 
ዓለምኒ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

verses.textGeez:
ወአፍላግኒ ፡ ይጠፍሑ ፡ እደ ፡ ኅቡረ 
አድባርኒ ፡ ይትሐሠዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ በህየ ፡ ይኴንና ፡ ለምድር 
ወይኴንና ፡ ለዓለም ፡ በጽድቅ ፡
ወለአሕዛብኒ ፡ በርትዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፺፱ - እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ደንገፁ ፡ አሕዛብ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፺፱ (99) - እግዚአብሔር፡ነገሠ ፥ አሕዛብ፡ይደንግጡ በኪሩቤል፡ላይ፡ተቀመጠ ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 99 - His Steadfast Love Endures Forever
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ደንገፁ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ዘይነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኪሩቤል ፡ አድለቅለቃ ፡ ለምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ በጽዮን 
ወልዑል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ይገኒ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ዐቢይ 
እስመ ፡ ግሩም ፡ ወቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ።
ክቡር ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ያፈቅር
verses.textEnglish: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

verses.textGeez: አንተ ፡ አጽናዕካ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ፍትሐ ፡ ወጽድቀ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ አንተ ፡ ገበርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፈጣሪነ ፡
ወይሰግዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ መከየደ ፡ እገሪሁ
verses.textEnglish: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ እሙንቱ ።ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ በክህነቶሙ ፡
ወሳሙኤልኒ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼውዑ ፡ ስሞ
verses.textEnglish: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.

verses.textGeez: ይጼውዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ ይሰጠዎሙ ።ወይትናገሮሙ ፡ በዐምደ ፡ ደመና
verses.textEnglish: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

verses.textGeez: ወየዐቅቡ ፡ ስምዖ ፡ ወትእዛዞሂ ፡ ዘወሀቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ አንተ ፡ ሰማዕኮሙ እግዚኦ ፡ አንተ ፡ ተሣህልኮሙ ፡
ወትትቤቀል ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡
ወይሰግዱ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ 
እስመ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻ - የብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 100 - I Will Walk with Integrity of Heart
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘተጋንዮ ።

verses.textGeez:
የብቡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምድር ።
ተቀንዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በትፍሥሕት
verses.textEnglish: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

verses.textGeez: ወባኡ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ በሐሤት ።
verses.textEnglish: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.textGeez: ኣእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላክነ ወውእቱ ፡ ፈጠረነ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ንሕነ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.textGeez:
ወንሕነሰ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡ ወአባግዐ ፡ መርዔቱ ።ባኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አናቅጺሁ ፡ በተጋንዮ ፡
ወውስተ ፡ አዕጻዲሁ ፡ በስብሐት
verses.textEnglish: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

verses.textGeez: እመንዎ ፡ ወሰብሑ ፡ ለስሙ ።እስመ ፡ ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ወለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ጽድቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፩ - ምሕረተ ፡ ወፍትሕ ፡ አኀሊ ፡ ለከ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 101 - Do Not Hide Your Face from Me
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: ምሕረተ ፡ ወፍትሕ ፡ አኀሊ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

verses.textGeez:
እዜምር ፡ ወእሌቡ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ንጹሕ 
ማእዜ ፡ ትመጽእ ፡ ኀቤየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.textGeez: ወአሐውር ፡ በየዋሃተ ፡ ልብየ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ቤትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢረሰይኩ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እኩየ 
ጸላእኩ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡
verses.textEnglish: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

verses.textGeez: ወኢተለወኒ ፡ ልብ ፡ ጠዋይ ።ሶበ ፡ ተግሕሠ ፡ እኩይ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ኢያእመርኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.textGeez: ዘየሐሚ ፡ ቢጾ ፡ በጽሚት ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ ሰደድኩ
verses.textEnglish: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

verses.textGeez: ዕቡየ ፡ ዐይን ፡ ወሥሡዐ ፡ ልብ ፡ ኢይትሀወል ፡ ምስሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

verses.textGeez:
አዕይንትየሰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መሀይምናነ ፡ ምድር ፡ከመ ፡ ኣንብሮሙ ፡ ምስሌየ 
ዘየሐውር ፡ በፍኖት ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይትለአከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይነብር ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ቤትየ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ትዕቢተ 
ወኢያረትዕ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ዘይነብብ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
በጽባሕ ፡ እቀትሎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ኃጥኣነ ፡ ምድር 
ከመ ፡ እሠርዎሙ ፡ እምሀገረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፪ - ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፪ (102) - አቤቱ ፥ ጸሎቴን፡ስማኝ ፥ ጩኸቴም፡ወዳንተ፡ይድረስ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 102 - Bless the Lord, O My Soul
psalms.heading: ጸሎት ፡ ባሕታዊ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይቴክዝ ፤ ወይክዑ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስእለቶ ።

verses.textGeez:
ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸሎትየ 
ወይብጻሕ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ ገዐርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.

verses.textGeez: ወኢትሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ መንዳቤየ
verses.textEnglish: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.textGeez: አፅምእ ፡ እዝነከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እጼውዐከ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ስምዐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኀልቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጢስ ፡ መዋዕልየ 
ወነቅጸ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.textGeez:
ተቀሠፍኩ ፡ ወየብሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ ልብየ 
እስመ ፡ ተረስዐኒ ፡ በሊዐ ፡ እክል ።
verses.textEnglish: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

verses.textGeez: እምቃለ ፡ ገዐርየ ፡ ጠግዐ ፡ ሥጋየ ፡ ዲበ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.textGeez:
ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አዱገ ፡ መረብ ፡ ዘገዳም 
ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጉጓ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤት ፡ ሌሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

verses.textGeez: ተጋህኩ ፡ ወኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዖፍ ፡ ባሕታዊ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ናሕስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይጼእሉኒ ፡ ጸላእትየ 
ወእለኒ ፡ ይሰዱኒ ፡ ይሰካትዩ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሐመደ ፡ ከመ ፡ እክል ፡ ቀማሕኩ 
ወስቴየኒ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አንብዕየ ፡ ሰተይኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.textGeez:
እምገጸ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ መዐትከ 
እስመ ፡ አንሣእከኒ ፡ ወነፃኅከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

verses.textGeez:
ወመዋዕልየኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽላሎት ፡ ኀለፈ 
ወአነሂ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ የበስኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ትነብር 
ወዝክርከኒ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወተሣሀለ ፡ ለጽዮን 
እስመ ፡ ጊዜሃ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሣሀላ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ ዕድሜሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሠምሩ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ እበኒሃ 
ወአክበርዎ ፡ ለመሬታ ።
verses.textEnglish: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.textGeez:
ወይፍርሁ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ስመከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ለስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ የሐንጻ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለጽዮን 
ወያስተርኢ ፡ በስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

verses.textGeez:
ወነጸረ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ጸሎተ ፡ ነዳይ 
ወኢተቈጥዐ ፡ ስእለቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወተጽሕፈት ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ትውልድ 
ወሕዝብ ፡ ዘይትፈጠር ፡ ይሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሐወጸ ፡ እምሰማየ ፡ መቅደሱ 
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሐወጸ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይስማዕ ፡ ገዐሮሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን 
ወከመ ፡ ያሕይዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ቅቱላን ።
verses.textEnglish: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይንግሩ ፡ በጽዮን ፡ ስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወስብሐቲሁኒ ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኅቡረ 
ወነገሥትኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትቀነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

verses.textGeez:
ወተሠጥዎሙ ፡ በፍኖተ ፡ ኀይሉ 
ንግረኒ ፡ ውሕዶን ፡ ለመዋዕልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትሰደኒ ፡ በመንፈቀ ፡ ዐመትየ ።
ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ዐመቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

verses.textGeez:
አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አቅደምከ ፡ ሳርሮታ ፡ ለምድር 
ወግብረ ፡ እደዊከ ፡ እማንቱ ፡ ሰማያት ።
verses.textAmharic: እነርሱ፡ይጠፋሉ ፥ አንተ፡ግን፡ትኖራለኽ ዅላቸው፡እንደ፡ልብስ፡ያረጃሉ ፥ እንደ፡መጐናጸፊያም፡ትለውጣቸዋ ለኽ ፥ ይለወጡማል
verses.textEnglish: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.textGeez:
እማንቱሰ ፡ ይትሐጐላ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ትሄሉ 
ወኵሉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ይበሊ
verses.textEnglish: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

verses.textGeez:
ወከመ ፡ ሞጣሕት ፡ ትዌልጦሙ ፡ ወይትዌለጡ ።ወአንተሰ ፡ አንተ ፡ ክመ 
ወዐመቲከኒ ፡ ዘኢየኀልቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

verses.textGeez:
ወደቂቀ ፡ አግብርቲከ ፡ ይነብርዋ 
ወዘርዖሙኒ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይጸንዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፫ - ተባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፫ (103) - ነፍሴ፡ሆይ ፥ እግዚአብሔርን፡ባርኪ ፥ ዐጥንቶቼም፡ዅሉ ፥ የተቀደሰ፡ስሙን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 103 - O Lord My God, You are Very Great
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ተባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወኵሉ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡ ለስሙ ፡ ቅዱስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

verses.textGeez:
ተባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወኢትርሳዕ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሰብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሰሪ ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኃጢአትከ 
ዘይፌውሰከ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ደዌከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

verses.textGeez:
ዘያድኅና ፡ እሙስና ፡ ለሕይወትከ 
ዘይኬልለከ ፡ በሣህሉ ፡ ወበምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.textGeez:
ዘያጸግባ ፡ እምበረከቱ ፡ ለፍትወትከ 
ዘይሔድሳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንስር ፡ ለውርዙትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

verses.textGeez:
ገባሬ ፡ ሣህል ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይፈትሕ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ግፉዓን ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.textGeez:
አርአየ ፡ ፍናዊሁ ፡ ለሙሴ 
ወለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሥምረቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ርሑቀ ፡ መዐት ፡ ወብዙኀ ፡ ምሕረት ፡ ወጻድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.textGeez: ኢይቀሥፍ ፡ ወትረ ፡ ወኢይትመዓዕ ፡ ዘልፈ ።
verses.textEnglish: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

verses.textGeez:
አኮ ፡ በከመ ፡ ኀጢአትነ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ለነ 
ወኢፈደየነ ፡ በከመ ፡ አበሳነ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ልዑል ፡ ሰማይ ፡ እምድር 
አጽንዐ ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ይርሕቅ ፡ ሠርቅ ፡ እምዐረብ 
አርሐቀ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ኀጢአተነ ።
verses.textEnglish: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.textGeez:
ወበከመ ፡ ይምሕር ፡ አብ ፡ ውሉደ 
ከማሁ ፡ ይምሕሮሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ።
እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ያአመር ፡ ፍጥረተነ
verses.textEnglish: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘከር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሬት ፡ ንሕነ ።ወሰብእሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕር ፡ መዋዕሊሁ 
ወከመ ፡ ጽጌ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይፈሪ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ወኢይሄሉ ፡ እንከ 
ወኢያአምር ፡ እንከ ፡ መካኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.textGeez: ወሣህሉሰ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምዓለም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ዲበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ
verses.textEnglish: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

verses.textGeez: ወጽድቁኒ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።ለእለ ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ ሕጎ
verses.textEnglish: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

verses.textGeez: ወይዜከሩ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ አስተዳለወ ፡ መንበሮ ፡ በሰማያት ወኵሎ ፡ ይኴንን ፡ በመንግሥቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

verses.textGeez:
ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ መላእክቲሁ 
ጽኑዓን ፡ ወኀያላን ፡ እለ ፡ ትገብሩ ፡ ቃሎ ፡
ወእለ ፡ ትሰምዑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ነገሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

verses.textGeez:
ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀይሉ 
ላእካኑ ፡ እለ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ፈቃዶ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.textGeez:
ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተግባሩ 
ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በሐውርተ ፡ መለኮቱ 
ትባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፬ - ትባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፬ (104) - ነፍሴ፡ሆይ ፥ እግዚአብሔርን፡ባርኪ አቤቱ፡አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 104 - Tell of All His Wondrous Works
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ትባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ዐበይከ ፡ ፈድፋደ
verses.textAmharic: ነፍሴ፡ሆይ ፥ እግዚአብሔርን፡ባርኪ አቤቱ፡አምላኬ፡ሆይ ፥ አንተ፡እጅግ፡ታላቅ፡ነኽ ክብርንና፡ግርማን፡ለበ ስኽ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.textGeez: አሚነ ፡ ወዕበየ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ለበስከ ።ወለበስከ ፡ ብርሃነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ልብስ
verses.textEnglish: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.textGeez: ወረበብኮ ፡ ለሰማይ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሠቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

verses.textGeez: ዘይጠፍር ፡ በማይ ፡ ጽርሖ ፡ ወረሰየ ፡ ደመና ፡ መከየዶ ዘየሐውር ፡ በክነፈ ፡ ነፋስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሬስዮሙ ፡ ለመላእክቲሁ ፡ መንፈሰ 
ወለእለ ፡ ይትለአክዎ ፡ ነደ ፡ እሳት ።
verses.textEnglish: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ሳረራ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወአጽንዓ 
ከመ ፡ ኢታንቀልቅል ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀላይኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ዐጽፋ 
ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ ይቀውሙ ፡ ማያት ።
verses.textEnglish: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምተግሣጽከ ፡ ይጐዩ 
ወእምድምፀ ፡ ነጐድጓድከ ፡ ይደነግፁ ።
verses.textEnglish: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

verses.textGeez:
የዐርጉ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ወይወርዱ ፡ ገዳመ 
ውስተ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሳረርኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወሠራዕኮሙ ፡ ወሰኖሙ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ኢየኀልፉ 
ከመ ፡ ኢይትመየጡ ፡ ወኢይክድንዋ ፡ ለምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይፌኑ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቈላት 
ማእከለ ፡ አድባር ፡ የኀልፉ ፡ ማየት ።
verses.textEnglish: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.textGeez:
ወያሰትዩ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ገዳም 
ወይትወክፉ ፡ ሐለስትዮታት ፡ ለጽምኦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

verses.textGeez:
ወያጸሉ ፡ ህየ ፡ አዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ 
ወይነቅዉ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ጾላዓት ።
verses.textEnglish: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሰቅዮሙ ፡ ለአድባር ፡ እምውሳጥያቲሆሙ 
እምፍሬ ፡ ተግባርከ ፡ ትጸግብ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.textGeez:
ዘያበቍል ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ለእንስሳ ፡
ወኀመልማለ ፡ ለቅኔ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው
verses.textEnglish: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ያውፅእ ፡ እክለ ፡ እምድር ።ወወይን ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ ፡ ልበ ፡ ሰብእ ፡
verses.textEnglish: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

verses.textGeez: ወቅብእ ፡ ለአብርሆ ፡ ገጽ ወእክል ፡ ያጸንዕ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

verses.textGeez:
ወይጸግቡ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ገዳም አርዘ ፡ ሊባኖስ ፡ ዘተከልከ ።
ወበህየ ፡ ይትዋለዳ ፡ አዕዋፍ
verses.textEnglish: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትጋወሮን ፡ ቤተ ፡ ሄርድያኖስ ።አድባር ፡ ነዋኃት ፡ ለሀየላት ።
ወጾላዓት ፡ ምጕያዮን ፡ ለግሔያት ።
verses.textEnglish: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

verses.textGeez:
ወገበርከ ፡ ወርኀ ፡ በዕድሜሁ 
ፀሐይኒ ፡ አእመረ ፡ ምዕራቢሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.textGeez:
ታመጽእ ፡ ጽልመተ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሌሊተ 
ወይወፅኡ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

verses.textGeez:
እጕለ ፡ አናብስት ፡ ይጥሕሩ ፡ ወይመስጡ 
ወይስእሉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምከመ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ የአትዉ 
ወይውዕሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግበቢሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.textGeez:
ወይወፍር ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተግባሩ 
ወይውዕል ፡ ወይትቀነይ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይመሲ ።
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

verses.textGeez:
ጥቀ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ግብርከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡
ወኵሎ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ገበርከ 
መልአ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘፈጠርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.textGeez:
ዛቲ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዐባይ ፡ ወረሓብ 
ህየ ፡ ዘይትሐወስ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ኈልቁ ፡
verses.textEnglish: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

verses.textGeez: እንስሳ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቃቅ ።ህየ ፡ ይሐውራ ፡ አሕማር
verses.textEnglish: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

verses.textGeez:
ከይሲ ፡ ዘፈጠርከ ፡ ይሳለቅ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።ወኵሉ ፡ ይሴፎ ፡ ኀቤከ 
አንተ ፡ ትሁቦሙ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ በበጊዜሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

verses.textGeez:
ወእምከመ ፡ ወሀብኮሙ ፡ ያስተጋብኡ 
ወፈቲሕከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ታጸግብ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እምሕረትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.textGeez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ሜጥከ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ይደነግፁ 
ታወፅእ ፡ መንፈሶሙ ፡ ወየኀልቁ ፡
ወይገብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሬቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወትፌኑ ፡ መንፈሰከ ፡ ወይትፈጠሩ 
ወትሔድስ ፡ ገጻ ፡ ለምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.

verses.textGeez:
ለይኩን ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዓለም 
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በተግባሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይኔጽራ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወይሬስያ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትርዐድ 
ዘይገሶሙ ፡ ለአድባር ፡ ወይጠይሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.textGeez:
እሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በሕይወትየ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለአምላኪየ ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ሀሎኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወኣሠምሮ ፡ በቃልየ 
ወአንሰ ፡ እትፌሣሕ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወየኀልቁ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እምድር ፡
ወአማፅያንሂ ፡ ኢይሄልዉ ፡ እንከ 
ትባርኮ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፭ - ግኔዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጸውዑ ፡ ስሞ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፭ (105) - እግዚአብሔርን፡አመስግኑ ፥ ስሙንም፡ጥሩ ፥ ለአሕዛብም፡ሥራውን፡አውሩ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 105 - Give Thanks to the Lord, for He is Good
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ግኔዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጸውዑ ፡ ስሞ 
ወንግርዎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ምግባሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ወዘምሩ ፡ ሎቱ ወንግሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መንክሮ ።
ወትከብሩ ፡ በስሙ ፡ ቅዱስ
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
ለይትፌሣሕ ፡ ልብ ፡ ዘየኀሦ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።ኅሥዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወትጸንዑ 
ወኅሡ ፡ ገጾ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከሩ ፡ መንክሮ ፡ ዘገብረ 
ተኣምሪሁ ፡ ወኵነኔ ፡ አፉሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.textGeez:
ዘርዐ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ አግብርቲሁ 
ወደቂቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ኅሩያኒሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ 
ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ኵነኔሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከረ ፡ ሥርዐቶ ፡ ዘለዓለም 
ቃሎ ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡ ለዐሠርቱ ፡ ምእት ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.textGeez: ዘሠርዐ ፡ ለአብርሃም ወመሐለ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.textGeez:
ወአቀመ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ ለያዕቆብ 
ወለእስራኤል ፡ ኪዳኖ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤሎ ለከ ፡ እሁበከ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናዐን 
ትኩንክሙ ፡ ሐብለ ፡ ርስትክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

verses.textGeez: እንዘ ፡ ውኁዳን ፡ ጥቀ ፡ እሙንቱ ወፈላስያን ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.textGeez:
ወኀለፉ ፡ እምሕዝብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ 
ወእምነገሥት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ካልእ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢኀደገ ፡ ይስሐጦሙ ፡ ሰብእ 
ወገሠጸ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.textGeez:
ኢትግስሱ ፡ መሲሓንየ 
ወኢታሕሥሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ነቢያትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.textGeez:
ወአምጽአ ፡ ረኃበ ፡ ለብሔር 
ወአጥፍአ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ እክል ።
verses.textEnglish: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ 
ወተሰይጠ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ገብረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.textGeez:
ወሐማ ፡ እገሪሁ ፡ በመዋቅሕት 
ወአምሰጠት ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ እምኀጺን ።
ዘእንበለ ፡ ይብጻሕ ፡ ቃሉ
verses.textEnglish: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

verses.textGeez:
ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እመከሮ ።ወፈነወ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወፈትሖ 
ወሤሞ ፡ መልአከ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰዮ ፡ እግዚአ ፡ ለቤቱ 
ወአኰነኖ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጥሪቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይገሥጾሙ ፡ ለመላእክቲሁ ፡ ከማሁ 
ወከመ ፡ ያጥብቦሙ ፡ ለሊቃውንቲሁ ፡ ከማሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.textGeez:
ወቦአ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ 
ወያዕቆብኒ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ካም ።
verses.textEnglish: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.textGeez:
ወአብዝኆሙ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወአጽንዖሙ ፡ እምፀሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.textGeez:
ወሜጠ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይጽልኡ ፡ ሕዝቦ 
ወከመ ፡ ይሐብልይዎሙ ፡ ለአግብርቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.textGeez: ወፈነወ ፡ ሙሴሃ ፡ ገብሮ ወአሮንሃ ፡ ኅሩዮ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ወሤመ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ትእምርት ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ካም ።
verses.textEnglish: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈነወ ፡ ጽልመተ ፡ ወአጽለሞሙ 
ወአምረርዎ ፡ ለቃሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.textGeez: ወረሰየ ፡ ማዮሙ ፡ ደመ ወቀተለ ፡ ዐሣቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅአት ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ቈርነነዓተ 
ውስተ ፡ አብያተ ፡ ነገሥቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.textGeez: ይቤ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ አኮት ወትንንያ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰየ ፡ ዝናሞሙ ፡ በረደ 
ወነደ ፡ እሳት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ወይኖሙ ፡ ወበለሶሙ 
ወቀጥቀጠ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

verses.textGeez:
ይቤ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ አንበጣ 
ወደጎብያ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ኈልቈ ።
verses.textEnglish: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.textGeez:
[ወበልዐ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ]
ወበልዐ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ምድሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በኵረ ፡ ብሔሮሙ 
ወቀዳሜ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተግባሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ወበብሩር 
ወአልቦ ፡ ደዌ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕዝቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.textGeez:
ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በፀአቶሙ 
እስመ ፡ ፈርሀዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንጦልዐ ፡ ደመና ፡ ወሰወሮሙ 
ወእሳትኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያብርህ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በሌሊት ።
verses.textEnglish: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.textGeez:
ወሰአሉ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ ፍርፍርት 
ወአጽገቦሙ ፡ ኅብስተ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንቅዐ ፡ ኰኵሐ ፡ ወአውሐዘ ፡ ማየ 
ወሖሩ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በድው ።
verses.textEnglish: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተዘከረ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ቅዱሰ 
ዘኀበ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ገብሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ በትፍሥሕት 
ወለኅሩያኒሁ ፡ በሐሤት ።
verses.textEnglish: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ በሐውርተ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወወረሱ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ባዕድ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕጎ ወይኅሥሡ ፡ ሥርዐቶ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፮ - ግኔዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፮ (106) - ሃሌ፡ሉያ ቸር፡ነውና ፥ ምሕረቱም፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነውና ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 106 - Let the Redeemed of the Lord Say So
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ግኔዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይነግር ፡ ኀይለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወይገብር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስማዕ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዓን ፡ እለ ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ ፍትሐ 
ወይገብሩ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘከረነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ብሣህልከ ፡ ሕዝበከ 
ወተሣሀለነ ፡ በአድኅኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ንርአይ ፡ ሠናይቶሙ ፡ ለኅሩያኒከ 
ወከመ ፡ ንትፈሣሕ ፡ በፍሥሓ ፡ ሕዝብከ 
ወከመ ፡ ንክበር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ርስትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

verses.textGeez: አበስነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊነ ዐመፅነ ፡ ወጌገይነ ።
verses.textEnglish: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.textGeez:
ወአበዊነሂ ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ኢያእመሩ ፡ መንክረከ 
ወኢተዘከሩ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ምሕረትከ
verses.textEnglish: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

verses.textGeez: ወአምረሩከ ፡ አመ ፡ የዐርጉ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ኤርትራ ።
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.textGeez: ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስሙ ከመ ፡ ያርእዮሙ ፡ ኀይሎ ።
verses.textEnglish: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.textGeez:
ወገሠጻ ፡ ለባሕረ ፡ ኤርትራ ፡ ወየብሰት 
ወመርሖሙ ፡ በቀላይ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘበገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ጸላእቶሙ 
ወአንገፎሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.textGeez:
ወደፈኖሙ ፡ ማይ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ሮድዎሙ 
ወኢተርፈ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.textGeez:
ወተአመኑ ፡ በቃሉ 
ወሰብሕዎ ፡ በስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

verses.textGeez:
ወአፍጠኑ ፡ ረሲዐ ፡ ምግባሩ 
ወኢተዐገሡ ፡ በምክሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈተዉ ፡ ፍትወተ ፡ በገዳም 
ወአምረርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በበድው ።
verses.textEnglish: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.textGeez: ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ዘሰአሉ ወገነወ ፡ ጽጋበ ፡ ለነፍሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወአምዕዕዎ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በትዕይንት 
ወለአሮን ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.textGeez:
ወአብቀወት ፡ ምድር ፡ ወውኅጠቶ ፡ ለዳታን 
ወደፈነቶሙ ፡ ለተዓይነ ፡ አቤሮን ።
verses.textEnglish: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ወነደ ፡ እሳት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተዓይንቲሆሙ 
ወአውዐዮሙ ፡ ነበልባል ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.textGeez: ወገብሩ ፡ ላህመ ፡ በኮሬብ ወሰገዱ ፡ ለግልፎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

verses.textGeez:
ወወለጡ ፡ ክብሮሙ 
በአምሳለ ፡ ላህም ፡ ዘይትረዐይ ፡ ሣዕረ ።
verses.textEnglish: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.textGeez:
ወረስዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአድኅኖሙ 
ዘገብረ ፡ ዐቢያተ ፡ በግብጽ ።
ወመንክረ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ካም ወግሩመ ፡ በባሕረ ፡ ኤርትራ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.textGeez:
ወይቤ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሠርዎሙ 
ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ኅሩዮ ፡ ቆመ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ አመ ፡ ብድብድ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ይሚጥ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ መዐቱ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ኢይሠርዎሙ ።ወመነኑ ፡ ምድረ ፡ መፍትወ
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.textGeez:
ወኢተአመኑ ፡ በቃሉ ።ወአንጐርጐሩ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ 
ወኢሰምዑ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሥአ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ 
ከመ ፡ ይንፅኆሙ ፡ በገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.textGeez:
ወከመ ፡ ይንፃኅ ፡ ዘርዖሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወከመ ፡ ይዝርዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በሓውርት ።
verses.textEnglish: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.textGeez:
ወተፈጸሙ ፡ በብዔል ፡ ፌጎር 
ወበልዑ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ምዉተ ።
verses.textEnglish: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሐክዎ ፡ በምግባሪሆሙ 
ወበዝኀ ፡ ብድብድ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.textGeez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ ፊንሐስ ፡ ወአድኀኖሙ 
ወኀደገ ፡ ብድብድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.textGeez:
ወተኈለቀ ፡ ጽድቅ 
ልትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
ወአምዕዕዎ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ማየ ፡ ቅሥት 
ወሐመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ ።
እስመ ፡ አምረርዋ ፡ ለነፍሱ
verses.textEnglish: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.textGeez: ወአዘዘ ፡ በከናፍሪሁ ።ወኢሠረዉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ዘይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.textGeez:
ወተደመሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አሕዛብ ወተመሀሩ ፡ ምግባሮሙ ።
ወተቀንዩ ፡ ለግልፎሆሙ ወኮኖሙ ፡ ጌጋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

verses.textGeez: ወዘብሑ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ወአዋልዲሆሙ ፡ ለአጋንንት ።
verses.textEnglish: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.textGeez:
ወከዐዉ ፡ ደመ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡
ደመ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ወአዋልዲሆሙ 
ወሦዑ ፡ ለግልፎ ፡ ከናዐን
verses.textEnglish: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.textGeez:
ወተቀትለት ፡ ምድር ፡ በደም ።ወረኵሰት ፡ ምድር ፡ በምግባሪሆሙ 
ወዘመዉ ፡ በጣዖቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.textGeez:
ወተምዕዐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መዐተ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሕዝቡ 
ወአስቆረሮሙ ፡ ለርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.textGeez:
ወአግብኦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ፀሮሙ 
ወቀነይዎሙ ፡ ጸላእቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.textGeez:
ወአሕመምዎሙ ፡ ፀሮሙ 
ወኀስሩ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ።
ወዘልፈ ፡ ያድኅኖሙ
verses.textEnglish: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.textGeez: ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ አምረርዎ ፡ በምክሮሙ ፡ወሐሙ ፡ በኀጢአቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.textGeez:
ወርእዮሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተመንደቡ 
ወሰምዖሙ ፡ ጸሎቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከረ ፡ ኪዳኖ 
ወነስሐ ፡ በከመ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሣህሎ 
በቅድመ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ፀወውዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላክነ ፡
ወአስተጋብአነ ፡ እምአሕዛብ
verses.textEnglish: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ንግበይ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ወከመ ፡ ንትመካሕ ፡ በስብሐቲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል 
እምቅድመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም 
ወይበል ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ለይኩን ፡ ለይኩን ።
verses.textEnglish: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፯ - ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፯ (107) - ቸር፡ነውና ፥ ምሕረቱ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነውና ፥ እግዚአብሔርን፡አመስግኑ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 107 - My Heart is Steadfast, O God
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ለይበሉ ፡ እለ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እለ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀሮሙ ።
ወአስተጋብኦሙ ፡ እምበሓውርት
verses.textEnglish: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.textGeez: እምጽባሕ ፡ ወእምዐረብ ፡ ወመስዕ ፡ ወባሕር ።
verses.textEnglish: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.textGeez: ወሳኰዩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በድው ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ማየ ወኢረከቡ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ብሔሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.textGeez: ጸምኡ ፡ ወርኅቡ ወኀልቀት ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐውየዉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደቡ 
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.textGeez:
ወመርሖሙ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ርቱዐ 
ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ሀገሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምሕረቶ 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አጽገበ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ርኅብተ 
ወመልአ ፡ ነፍሰ ፡ ዕራቃ ፡ በረከተ ።
verses.textEnglish: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.textGeez:
ለእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት 
ወመቁሓን ፡ በንዴት ፡ ወበኀጺን ።
verses.textEnglish: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አምረሩ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወአምዕዑ ፡ ምክረ ፡ ልዑል ።
verses.textEnglish: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

verses.textGeez:
ወሰርሐ ፡ በሕማም ፡ ልቦሙ 
ደወዩ ፡ ወኀጥኡ ፡ ዘይቀብሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐውየዉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደቡ 
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ እምጽልመት ፡ ወጽላሎተ ፡ ሞት 
ወሰበረ ፡ መዋቅሕቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምሕረቶ 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሰበረ ፡ ኆኃተ ፡ ብርት 
ወቀጥቀጠ ፡ መናስግተ ፡ ኀጺን ።
verses.textEnglish: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.textGeez:
ወተወክፎሙ ፡ እምፍኖተ ፡ ጌጋዮሙ 
እስመ ፡ ሐሙ ፡ በኃጢአቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.textGeez:
ወኵሎ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ አስቆረረት ፡ ነፍሶሙ 
ወቀርቡ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አናቅጸ ፡ ሞት ።
verses.textEnglish: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐውየዉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደቡ 
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈነወ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ወአሕየዎሙ 
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እሞቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምሕረቶ 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.textGeez:
ወይሡዑ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ስብሐት 
ወይንግሩ ፡ ግብሮ ፡ በትፍሥሕት ።
verses.textEnglish: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕር ፡ በአሕማር 
ወይትጌበሩ ፡ ተግባሮሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማይ ፡ ብዙኅ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.textGeez:
እሙንቱሰ ፡ ያአምሩ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ልጐት ።
verses.textEnglish: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.textGeez:
ይቤ ፡ ወመጽአ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ዐውሎ 
ወተለዐለ ፡ ማዕበል ።
verses.textEnglish: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

verses.textGeez:
የዐርጉ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወይወርዱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ቀላይ 
ወተመስወት ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ በሕማም ።
verses.textEnglish: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ደንገፁ ፡ ወተሀውኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ስኩር 
ወተሰጥመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጥበቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

verses.textGeez:
ወዐውየዉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደቡ 
ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ እምንዳቤሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

verses.textGeez:
ወአጥፍኦ ፡ ለዐውሎ ፡ ወአርመመ ፡ ባሕር 
ወአርመመ ፡ ማዕበል ።
verses.textEnglish: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.textGeez:
ወተፈሥሑ ፡ እስመ ፡ አዕረፉ 
ወመርሖሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መርሶ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈቀዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ምሕረቶ 
ወመንክሮሂ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.textGeez:
ወያዐብይዎ ፡ በማኅበረ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወይሴብሕዎ ፡ በመንበረ ፡ ሊቃውንት ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰዮሙ ፡ ለአፍላግ ፡ በድወ 
ወረሰየ ፡ ምጽማአ ፡ ሙሓዘ ፡ ማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰየ ፡ ጼወ ፡ ለምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ትፈሪ 
በእከዮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይነብርዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.textGeez:
ወረሰዩ ፡ ለበድው ፡ ሙሓዘ ፡ ማይ 
ወለምድረ ፡ በድው ፡ ቀላያተ ፡ ማያት ።
verses.textEnglish: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንበረ ፡ ህየ ፡ ርኁባነ 
ወሐነጹ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይነብርዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.textGeez:
ወዘርዑ ፡ ገራውሀ ፡ ወተከሉ ፡ ወይነ 
ወገብሩ ፡ ማእረረ ፡ እክል ።
verses.textEnglish: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.textGeez:
ወባረኮሙ ፡ ወበዝኁ ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወኢያውኀደ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እንስሳሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

verses.textGeez: ወደወዩ ፡ ወውኅዱ በሕማም ፡ እኩይ ፡ ወበጻዕር ።
verses.textEnglish: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.textGeez:
ወተክዕወ ፡ ኀሳር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መላእክት 
ወአስሐቶሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በድው ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ፍኖተ ።
verses.textEnglish: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

verses.textGeez:
ወረድኦ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ በተጽናሱ 
ወረሰዮ ፡ ከመ ፡ አባግዐ ፡ ብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

verses.textGeez:
ይርአዩ ፡ ራትዓን ፡ ወይትፌሥሑ 
ወትትፈፀም ፡ አፉሃ ፡ ኵላ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ጠቢብ ፡ ዘየዐቅቦ ፡ ለዝ 
ወያአምር ፡ ከመ ፡ መሓሪ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፰ - ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፰ (108) - ልቤ፡ጽኑ፡ነው ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ልቤ፡ጽኑ፡ነው እቀኛለኹ፡በክብሬም፡እዘምራለኹ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 108 - Help Me, O Lord My God
psalms.heading: ማኅኬት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጥቡዕ ፡ ልብየ 
እሴብሕ ፡ ወእዜምር ፡ ወይትነሣእ ፡ ክብርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.textGeez:
ወእትነሣእ ፡ በመዝሙር ፡ ወበመሰንቆ 
ወእትነሣእ ፡ በጽባሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዐብየት ፡ እስከ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወእስከ ፡ ደመናት ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

verses.textGeez:
ተለዐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት 
ወበኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
ከመ ፡ ይድኀኑ ፡ ፍቁራኒከ
verses.textEnglish: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

verses.textGeez: አድኅን ፡ በየማንከ ፡ ወስምዐኒ ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነበበ ፡ በመቅደሱ ፡
verses.textEnglish: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.textGeez: እትሐሠይ ፡ ወእትካፈል ፡ ሰቂማ ወእሳፈር ፡ አዕጻዳተ ፡ ቈላት ።
verses.textEnglish: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.textGeez:
ዚአየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ገላዐድ ፡ ወዚአየ ፡ ምናሴ ፡
ወኤፍሬም ፡ ስዋቀ ፡ ርእስየ
verses.textEnglish: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

verses.textGeez: ወይሁዳ ፡ ንጉሥየ ።ወሞአብ ፡ ካህን ፡ ተስፋየ
verses.textEnglish: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.textGeez: ዲበ ፡ ኢዶምያስ ፡ እሰፍሕ ፡ መካይድየ ሊተ ፡ ይገንዩ ፡ አሎፍሊ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ይወስደኒ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ጥቅም 
ወመኑ ፡ ይመርሐኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኢዶምያስ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

verses.textGeez:
አኮኑ ፡ አንተ ፡ ዘገዳፍከነ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወኢትወፅእ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኀይልነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.textGeez:
ሀበነ ፡ ረድኤተ ፡ በምብዳቤነ 
ወከንቱ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በሰብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.textGeez:
በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ንገብር ፡ ኀይለ 
ወወእቱ ፡ ያኀስሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሣቅዩነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፱ - እግዚኦ ፡ ኢትጸመመኒ ፡ ስእለትየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 109 - Sit at My Right Hand
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ኢትጸመመኒ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
እስመ ፡ አፈ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ወአፈ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ አብቀወ ፡ ላዕሌየ
verses.textEnglish: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.textGeez: ወነበቡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ በልሳነ ፡ ዐመፃ ።ወዐገቱኒ ፡ በጽልእ ወፀብኡኒ ፡ በከንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.textGeez: ወዘእምአፍቀሩኒ ፡ አስተዋደዩኒ ወአንሰ ፡ እጼሊ ።
verses.textEnglish: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.textGeez:
ገደዩኒ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ሠናይት 
ወጸልኡኒ ፡ ህየንተ ፡ ዘአፍቀርክዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.textGeez: ሢም ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ኃጥአ ወሰይጣን ፡ ይቁም ፡ በየማኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.textGeez:
ወሶበሂ ፡ ይትዋቀሥ ፡ ይፃእ ፡ ተመዊኦ 
ወጸሎቱሂ ፡ ትኩኖ ፡ ጌጋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኩና ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ኅዳጠ 
ወሢመቶሂ ፡ ይንሣእ ፡ ባዕድ ።
verses.textEnglish: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኩኑ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ እጓለ ፡ ማውታ 
ወብእሲቱሂ ፡ ትኩን ፡ መበለተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.textGeez:
ወይትሀውኩ ፡ ደቂቁ ፡ ወይፍልሱ ፡ ወያስተፍእሙ 
ወይስድድዎሙ ፡ እምአብያቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.textGeez:
ወይበርበሮ ፡ ባዕለ ፡ ዕዳ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ንዋዮ 
ወይሐብልዩ ፡ ነቢር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ተግባሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይርከብ ፡ ዘይረድኦ 
ወኢይምሐርዎሙ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሠረዉ ፡ ደቂቁ 
በአሕቲ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ትደምሰስ ፡ ስሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.textGeez:
ወትዘከር ፡ ኅጢአተ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወኢይደምሰስ ፡ ጌጋያ ፡ ለእሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.textGeez:
ወየሀሉ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ 
ወይጥፋእ ፡ እምድር ፡ ዝክሩ ።
እስመ ፡ ኢተዘከረ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ምጽዋተ
verses.textEnglish: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.textGeez: ወሰደደ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ነዳየ ፡ ወምስኪነ ፡ወጥቡዕ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ለቀቲል ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወአብደረ ፡ መርገመ ፡ ወትመጽኦ 
ወአበያ ፡ ለበረከት ፡ ወትርሕቅ ፡ አምኔሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.textGeez:
ወለብሳ ፡ ለመርገም ፡ ከመ ፡ ልብስ 
ወቦአት ፡ ከመ ፡ ማይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አማዑቱ 
ወከመ ፡ ቅብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጽምቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.textGeez:
ወትኩኖ ፡ ከመ ፡ ልብስ ፡ ዘይትዐጸፍ 
ወከመ ፡ ቅናት ፡ ዘይቀንት ፡ ዘልፈ ።
verses.textEnglish: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.textGeez:
ዝግብር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያስተዋድዩኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወለእለ ፡ ይነቡ ፡ እኩየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንተሰ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ግበር ፡ ሣህለከ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ስምከ 
እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ አድኅነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ነዳይ ፡ ወምስኪን ፡ አነ 
ልብየኒ ፡ ደንገፀኒ ፡ በውስጥየ ።
verses.textEnglish: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኀለቁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽላሎት ፡ ዘኀለፈ 
ወተነገፍኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንበጣ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.textGeez:
ወደክመኒ ፡ ብረክየ ፡ በጾም 
ወስሕከ ፡ ሥጋየ ፡ በኀጢአ ፡ ቅብእ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ተጸአልኩ ፡ በኀቤሆሙ 
ሶበ ፡ ይሬእዩኒ ፡ የሐውሱ ፡ ርእሶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.textGeez:
ርድአኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አምላኪየ 
ወአድኅነኒ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምሕረትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.textGeez:
ወያእምሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዛቲ 
ወአንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ገበርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.textGeez:
እሙንቱሰ ፡ ይረግሙ ፡ ወአንተ ፡ ባርክ 
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትነሥኡ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡
ወገብርከሰ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

verses.textGeez:
ለይልበሱ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ እለ ፡ ያስተዋድዩኒ 
ወይትዐጸፍዋ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐጽፍ ፡ ለኃጢአቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ በአፉየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወእሴብሖ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ብዙኃን ።
verses.textEnglish: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ቆመ ፡ በየማነ ፡ ነዳይ 
ከመ ፡ ያድኅና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ሮድዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲ - ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ለእግዚእየ ፡ ንበር ፡ በየማንየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 110 - Great are the Works of the Lord
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: ይቤሎ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ለእግዚእየ ፡ ንበር ፡ በየማንየ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.textGeez: እስከ ፡ ኣገብኦሙ ፡ ለጸላእትከ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ መከየደ ፡ እገሪከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

verses.textGeez: በትረ ፡ ኀይል ፡ ይፈኑ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምጽዮን ወትኴንን ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ጸላእትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

verses.textGeez:
ምስሌከ ፡ ቀዳማዊ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ኀይል ።
ወብርሃኖሙ ፡ ለቅዱሳን ፡
ወለድኩከ ፡ እምከርሥ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ኮከበ ፡ ጽባሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.textGeez:
መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኢይኔስሕ 
አንተ ፡ ካህኑ ፡ ለዓለም በከመ ፡ ሢመቱ ፡ ለመልከ ፡ ጼዴቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ በየማንከ 
ይቀጠቅጦሙ ፡ ለነገሥት ፡ በዕለተ ፡ መዐቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኴንኖሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ወያበዝኅ ፡ አብድንተ 
ወይሰብር ፡ አርእስተ ፡ ብዙኃን ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.textGeez:
እምውሒዝ ፡ ሰትዩ ፡ ማየ ፡ በፍኖት 
ወበእንተዝ ፡ ይትሌዐል ፡ ርእስ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፩ - እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 111 - Praise the Lord! Blessed is the Man Who Fears the Lord
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ 
በምክረ ፡ ራትዓን ፡ ወበማኅበር ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቢይ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወትትኀሠሥ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፈቃዱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.textGeez:
አሚን ፡ ወዕበየ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ ምግባሩ 
ወጽድቁኒ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ተዝካረ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ለስብሐቲሁ 
መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ
verses.textEnglish: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.textGeez: ወተዘከረ ፡ ኪዳኖ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።ወአርአዮሙ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ምግባሩ
verses.textEnglish: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ የሀቦሙ ፡ ርስተ ፡ ዘአሕዛብ ።ግብረ ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ወርትዕ
verses.textEnglish: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.textGeez:
ወእሙን ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዙ ።ወጽኑዕ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወግቡር ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወበርትዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

verses.textGeez:
መድኀኒተ ፡ ፈነወ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡
ወአዘዘ ፡ ሥርዐቶ ፡ ዘለዓለም
verses.textEnglish: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.textGeez: ቅዱስ ፡ ወግሩም ፡ ስመ ፡ ዚአሁ ።ቀዳሚሃ ፡ ለጥበብ ፡ ፈሪሀ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
verses.textEnglish: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.textGeez: ወምክር ፡ ሠናይት ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዘይገብራ ወስብሐቲሁኒ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፪ - ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 112 - From the Rising of the Sun to Its Setting
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወዘይፈቅድ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

verses.textGeez:
ወይከውን ፡ ጽኑዐ ፡ ዘርዑ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር 
ትውልደ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ይትባረኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.textGeez:
ክብር ፡ ወብዕል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቱ 
ወጽድቁኒ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ሠረቀ ፡ ብርሃን ፡ ለራትዓን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽልመት 
መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጻድቅ ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.textGeez:
ብእሲ ፡ መሓሪ ፡ መስተሣህል ፡ ወኄር 
ወይዔቅም ፡ ቃሎ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፍትሕ ።
ወኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዓለም
verses.textEnglish: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.textGeez: ዝክረ ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይሄሉ ።ወኢይፈርህ ፡ እምነገር ፡ እኩይ
verses.textEnglish: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.textGeez:
ጥቡዕ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ለተወክሎ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።ጽኑዕ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ወኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዓለም 
እስከ ፡ ይሬኢ ፡ በጸላእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ዘረወ ፡ ወወሀበ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡
ወጽድቁኒ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ወይትሌዐል ፡ ቀርኑ ፡ በክብር ።
verses.textEnglish: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ይሬኢ ፡ ኃጥእ ፡ ወይትመዓዕ ፡
ወይሐቂ ፡ ስነኒሁ ፡ ወይትመሰው 
ወተኀልቅ ፡ ፍትወቶሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡፡
verses.textEnglish: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፫ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 113 - Tremble, O Earth, at the Presence of the Lord
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወሰብሑ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኩን ፡ ብሩከ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.textGeez:
እምሥራቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወእስከነ ፡ ዐርብ 
ይትአኰት ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.

verses.textGeez:
ልዑል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወውስተ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.textGeez:
መኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ 
ዘይነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ አርያም ።
ወይሬኢ ፡ ዘበታሕቱ በሰማይኒ ፡ ወበምድርኒ ።
