verses.textEnglish: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

verses.textGeez:
ዘያነሥኦ ፡ ለነዳይ ፡ እምድር 
ወያሌዕሎ ፡ እመሬት ፡ ለምስኪን ።
verses.textEnglish: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ያንብሮ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መላእክቲሁ 
ወምስለ ፡ መላእክተ ፡ ሕዝቡ ።
verses.textEnglish: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.textGeez:
ዘያነብራ ፡ ለመካን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቱ 
ወያስትፌሥሓ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ውሉድ ።
verses.textEnglish: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፬ - አመ ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምግብጽ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 114 - I Love the Lord, Because He Has Heard
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
አመ ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እምግብጽ 
ወቤተ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ እምሕዝበ ፡ ፀር ።
verses.textEnglish: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.textGeez: ወኮነ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ መቅደሶ ወእስራኤልኒ ፡ ምኵናኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

verses.textGeez: ባሕርኒ ፡ ርእየት ፡ ወጐየት ወዮርዳኖስኒ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ድኅሬሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.textGeez:
ወአድባር ፡ አንፈርዐጹ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐራጊት 
ወአውግርኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሓስአ ፡ አባግዕ
verses.textEnglish: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.textGeez: ምንተ ፡ ኮንኪ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዘጐየይኪ ወአንተኒ ፡ ዮርዳኖስ ፡ ዘገባእከ ፡ ድኅሬከ ።
verses.textEnglish: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

verses.textGeez:
ወአድባር ፡ ዘአንፈርዐጽክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐራጊት 
ወአውግርኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሓስአ ፡ አባግዕ
verses.textEnglish: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

verses.textGeez: እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አድለቅለቀት ፡ ምድር እምቅድመ ፡ ገጹ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሬስያ ፡ ለኰኵሕ ፡ አንቅዕተ ፡ ማያት 
ወለእዝኅ ፡ ዐዘቃተ ፡ ማያት ።
verses.textEnglish: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፭ - አኮ ፡ ለነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አኮ ፡ ለነ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፲፭ (115) - ለእኛ፡አይደለም ፥ አቤቱ ፥ ለእኛ፡አይደለም ፥ ነገር፡ግን ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 115 - What Shall I Render to the Lord?

verses.textGeez:
አኮ ፡ ለነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አኮ ፡ ለነ 
ለስመ ፡ ዚአከ ፡ ሀብ ፡ ስብሐተ
verses.textEnglish: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

verses.textGeez: በምሕረትከ ፡ ወበጽድቅከ ።ከመ ፡ ኢይበሉነ ፡ አሕዛብ አይቴ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አምላኮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

verses.textGeez:
አምላክነሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ላዕለ 
በሰማይኒ ፡ ወበምድርኒ ፡
ኵሎ ፡ ዘፈቀደ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

verses.textGeez:
አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር 
ግብረ ፡ እደ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.textGeez: አፈ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይነቡ ዐይነ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይሬእዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.textGeez:
እዝነ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይሰምዑ 
አንፈ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢያጼንዉ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.textGeez:
እደ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይገሱ እግረ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢየሐውሩ 
ወኢይነቡ ፡ በጐራዒቶሙ ።
ወአልቦሙ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.textGeez:
ከማሆሙ ፡ ለይኩኑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ገብርዎሙ 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ ቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.textGeez:
ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ረዳኢሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወምእመኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

verses.textGeez:
ቤተ ፡ አሮን ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ረዳኢሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወምእመኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ትፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
ረዳኢሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወምእመኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ተዘከረነ ፡ ወባረከነ
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.textGeez: ባርክ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ወባርክ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አሮን ።
verses.textEnglish: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.

verses.textGeez: ባርኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ለንኡሶሙ ፡ ወለዐቢዮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.textGeez:
ይዌስክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌክሙ 
ላዕሌክሙ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ውሉድክሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

verses.textGeez:
ብሩካን ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

verses.textGeez:
ሰማየ ፡ ሰማያት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወምድረሰ ፡ ወሀበ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአኮ ፡ ምዉታን ፡ ይሴብሑከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወኢኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሲኦል ።
verses.textEnglish: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ንሕነ ፡ ሐያዋን ፡ ንባርኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፮ - አፍቀርኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 116 - Praise the Lord, All Nations
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez: አፍቀርኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰምዐኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

verses.textGeez:
ወአፅምአ ፡ እዝኖ ፡ ኀቤየ 
ወጸዋዕክዎ ፡ በመዋዕልየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.textGeez: አኀዘኒ ፡ ጻዕረ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወረከበኒ ፡ ሕማመ ፡ ሲኦል
verses.textEnglish: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.textGeez: ሕማም ፡ ወምንዳቤ ፡ ረከበኒ ።ወጸዋዕኩ ፡ ስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ባልሓ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።መሓሪ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወጻድቅ 
ወአምላክነሂ ፡ መስተሣህል ።
verses.textEnglish: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

verses.textGeez:
የዐቅብ ፡ ሕፃናተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ተመንደብኩሂ ፡ ወአድኀነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.textGeez:
ግብኢ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዕረፍትኪ 
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ረዳኢኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አድኀና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እሞት 
ወለአዕይንትየኒ ፡ እምአንብዕ ፡
ወለእገርየኒ ፡ እምዳኅፅ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ አሥምሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በብሔረ ፡ ሕያዋን ።
verses.textEnglish: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፯ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ አሕዛብ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፲፯ (117) - አሕዛብ፡ዅላችኹ ፥ እግዚአብሔርን፡አመስግኑት ፥ ወገኖችም፡ዅሉ፡ያመስግኑት
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 117 - His Steadfast Love Endures Forever
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወይሴብሕዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.textEnglish: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጸንዐት ፡ ምሕረቱ ፡ ላዕሌነ 
ወጽድቁሰ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሄሉ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ሀሌሉያ ።
verses.textEnglish: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፰ - ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፲፰ (118) - እግዚአብሔርን፡አመስግኑ ፥ ቸር፡ነውና ምሕረቱ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ናትና
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 118 - Your Word is a Lamp to My Feet

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኄር 
ከመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አሮን ፡ ከመ ፡ ኄር 
ከመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ንግሩ ፡ ኵልክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ትፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ኄር 
ከመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ተመንደብኩ ፡ ጸዋዕክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወሰምዐኒ ፡ ወአርሐበ ፡ ሊተ ።
verses.textEnglish: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይረድአኒ ፡ ኢይፈርህ 
እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው፡ ምንተ ፡ ይሬስየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይረድአኒ ወአነ ፡ እሬእዮሙ ፡ ለጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

verses.textGeez: ይኄይስ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር እምተአምኖ ፡ በእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

verses.textGeez: ይኄይስ ፡ ተአምኖ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር እምተሰፍዎ ፡ በመላእክት ።
verses.textEnglish: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ዐገቱኒ 
ወበስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሞአክዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.

verses.textGeez:
ዐጊተሰ ፡ ዐገቱኒ 
ወበስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሞአክዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.textGeez:
ዐገቱኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንህብ ፡ መዓረ ፡
ወነዱ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሳት ፡ ውስተ ፡ አስዋክ 
ወበስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሞአክዎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.

verses.textGeez: ተንተንኩ ፡ ለወዲቅ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ አንሥአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.

verses.textGeez:
ኀይልየኒ ፡ ወዝክርየኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወውእቱ ፡ ኮነኒ ፡ መድኀንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.textGeez: ቃለ ፡ ትፍሥሕት ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን
verses.textEnglish: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.textGeez:
የማነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ገብረት ፡ ኀይለ ።የማነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አልዐለተኒ 
የማነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ገብረት ፡ ኀይለ ።
verses.textEnglish: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይመውት ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘአሐዩ 
ወእነግር ፡ ግብሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ገሥጾሰ ፡ ገሠጸኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወለሞትሰ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ኢመጠወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

verses.textGeez:
አርኅዉ ፡ ሊተ ፡ አናቅጸ ፡ ጽድቅ 
እባእ ፡ ውስቴቶን ፡ ወእግነየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
ዝአንቀጽ ፡ እንተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ጻድቃን ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.textEnglish: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ 
ወኮንከኒ ፡ መድኀንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.textGeez:
እብን ፡ ዘመነንዋ ፡ ነደቅት 
ይእቲ ፡ ኮነት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ማዕዘንት ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

verses.textGeez:
እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኮነት ፡ ዛቲ 
ወነካር ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ለአዕይንቲነ ።
verses.textEnglish: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

verses.textGeez:
ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ንትፈሣሕ ፡ ወንትሐሠይ ፡ ባቲ ።
verses.textEnglish: This is the LORD'S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.textGeez:
ኦእግዚኦ ፡ አድኅንሶ ኦእግዚኦ ፡ ሠርሐሶ ።
ቡሩክ ፡ ዘይመጽእ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.textGeez: በረክናክሙ ፡ እምቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ወአስተርአየ ፡ ለነ
verses.textAmharic: አቤቱ ፥ እባክኽ ፥ አኹን፡አድን አቤቱ ፥ እባክኽ ፥ አኹን፡አቅና።
verses.textEnglish: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

verses.textGeez: ግበሩ ፡ በዓለ ፡ በትፍሥሕት ፡ በኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ያስተሓምምዎ ፡እስከ ፡ አቅርንቲሁ ፡ ለምሥዋዕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወእገኒ ፡ ለከ 
አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወኣሌዕለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ ፡
ወኮንከኒ ፡ መድኀንየ ።
verses.textAmharic: አንተ፡አምላኬ፡ነኽ፡አመሰግንኽማለኹ።አንተ፡አምላኬ፡ነኽ ፥ ከፍ፡ከፍ፡አደርግኻለኹ ሰምተኸኛልና ፥ መድኀ ኒትም፡ኾነኸኛልና ፥ አመሰግንኻለኹ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፲፱ - ፩ አሌፍ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 119 - Deliver Me, O Lord, from Lying Lips
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
፩ አሌፍ ።
ብፁአን ፡ እለ ፡ ንጹሓን ፡ በፍኖቶሙ 
እለ ፡ ይሐውሩ ፡ በሕገ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዓን ፡ እለ ፡ ይኀሡ ፡ ስምዖ 
ወበኵሉ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ይኀሥዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

verses.textGeez: ወእለሰ ፡ ይገብሩ ፡ ዐመፃ ፍኖተ ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ ኢሖሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.textGeez: አንተ ፡ አዘዝከ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

verses.textGeez:
ይረትዕሰ ፡ ይርታዕ ፡ ፍኖትየ 
ከመ ፡ እዕቀብ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

verses.textGeez:
ውእቱ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ኢይትኀፈር 
በርእየ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በልብ ፡ ርቱዕ 
ሶበ ፡ ተመሀርኩ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ወአዐቅብ ፡ ኵነኔከ 
ወኢትግድፈኒ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

verses.textGeez:
፪ ቤት ።
በምንተ ፡ ያረትዕ ፡ ወሬዛ ፡ ፍኖቶ 
በዐቂበ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

verses.textGeez:
በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ኀሠሥኩከ 
ኢታርሕቀኒ ፡ እምትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
ውስተ ፡ ክብየ ፡ ኀባእኩ ፡ ነቢበከ 
ከመ ፡ ኢየአብስ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

verses.textGeez: ብሩክ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez: በከናፍርየ ፡ ነገርኩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኰነኔ ፡ አፉከ ።
verses.textEnglish: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

verses.textGeez:
በፍኖተ ፡ ስመዕከ ፡ ተፈሣሕኩ 
ከመ ፡ ዘበኵሉ ፡ ብዕል ።
verses.textEnglish: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.textGeez: ወእዛዋዕ ፡ በትእዛዝከ ወአኀሥሥ ፡ ፍናዊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

verses.textGeez: ወኣነብብ ፡ ትእዛዛቲከ ወኢይረስዕ ፡ ቃለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

verses.textGeez:
፫ ጋሜል ።
ዕስዮ ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሕዮ 
ወእዕቀብ ፡ ነቢበከ ።
verses.textEnglish: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ክሥቶን ፡ ለአዕይንትየ ፡ ወእርአይ 
መድምመከ ፡ እምሕግከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

verses.textGeez:
ፈላሲ ፡ አነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር 
ኢትኅባእ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

verses.textGeez: አፍቀረት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ወፈተወት ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

verses.textGeez:
ገሠጽኮሙ ፡ ለዕቡያን 
ርጉማን ፡ እለ ፡ ይትገሐሡ ፡ እምትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
ኣእትት ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ወኀሳረ 
እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ነበሩ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወኪያየ ፡ ሐመዩ 
ወገብርከሰ ፡ ይዛዋዕ ፡ በኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ስምዕከ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ 
ወምክርየኒ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ዚአከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

verses.textGeez:
፬ ዳሌጥ ።
ጠግዐት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በምድር 
ኣሕይወኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ነገርኩ ፡ ፍናዊከ ፡ ወሰማዕከኒ 
ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez: ፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅከ ፡ አለብወኒ ወእዛዋዕ ፡ በመንክርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
ደቀሰት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ እምሐዘን 
አጽንዐኒ ፡ በነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

verses.textGeez: ፍኖተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ አርሕቅ ፡ እምኔየ ወበሕግከ ፡ ተሣሀለኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

verses.textGeez: ፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅከ ፡ አብደርኩ ወኵነኔከሰ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

verses.textGeez: ተለውኩ ፡ ስምዐከ እግዚኦ ፡ ኢታስተኀፍረኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

verses.textGeez: ፍኖተ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ፡ ሮጽኩ ሶበ ፡ አርሐብኮ ፡ ለልብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

verses.textGeez:
፭ ሄ ።
ምህረኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅከ 
ወእኅሥሣ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

verses.textGeez:
አለብወኒ ፡ ወእኅሥሥ ፡ ሕገከ 
ወእዕቀቦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.textGeez: ምርሐኒ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ትእዛዝከ እስመ ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ ፈቀድኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.textGeez: ሚጥ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ስምዕከ ወአኮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትዕግልት ።
verses.textEnglish: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.textGeez:
ሚጦን ፡ ለአዕይንትየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይርአያ ፡ ከንቶ 
ወኣሕይወኒ ፡ በፍኖትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

verses.textGeez: አቅም ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ ዘነበብከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

verses.textGeez:
ኣእትት ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ጽእለተ ፡ ዘተሐዘብኩ 
እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ ፈተውኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ወኣሕይወኒ ፡ በጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
፮ ዋው ።
ወይምጻእ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
እግዚኦ ፡ አድኅኖትከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

verses.textGeez:
አውሥኦሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይጼእሉኒ 
እስመ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ በቃልከ ።
verses.textEnglish: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢታእትት ፡ ቃለ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ እምአፉየ ፡ ለግሙራ 
እስመ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ በኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ወአዐቅብ ፡ ሕገከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ 
ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez: ወአሐውር ፡ ስፉሕ እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

verses.textGeez: ወእነግር ፡ ስምዐከ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ነገሥተ ወኢይትኀፈር ።
verses.textEnglish: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.textGeez: ወኣነብብ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ዘአፍቀርኩ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.textEnglish: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.textGeez:
ወኣነሥእ ፡ እደውየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ፡ ዘአፍቀርኩ 
ወእዛዋዕ ፡ በትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
፯ ዛይ ።
ተዘከር ፡ ቃለከ ፡ ዘአሰፈውኮ ፡ ለገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

verses.textGeez:
ወይእቲ ፡ አስተፈሥሐተኒ ፡ በሕማምየ 
እስመ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ኣሕየወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

verses.textGeez: ዕቡያን ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ፈድፋደ ወእምሕግከሰ ፡ ኢተገሐሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከርኩ ፡ ፍትሐከ ፡ ዘእምዓለም 
ወተፈሣሕኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

verses.textGeez: ሐዘን ፡ አኀዘኒ ፡ እምኃጥኣን እለ ፡ ኀደጉ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

verses.textGeez:
መዝሙር ፡ ኮነኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ 
በብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈለስኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.textGeez: ተዘከርኩ ፡ በሌሊት ፡ ስመከ ፡ እግዚኦ ወዐቀብኩ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

verses.textGeez: ወይእቲ ፡ ኮነተኒ እስመ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
፰ ሔት ።
ክፍልየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወእቤ ፡ ይዕቀቡ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: CHETH. Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

verses.textGeez:
ሰአልኩ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ 
ተሣሀለኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ወሐለይኩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍናዊከ 
ወሜጥኩ ፡ እግርየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ስምዕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez: አጥባዕኩ ፡ ወኢናፈቁ ለዐቂበ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
አሕባለ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ተፀፍራ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወሕገከሰ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

verses.textGeez:
መንፍቀ ፡ ሌሊት ፡ እትነሣእ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግነይ ፡ ለከ 
በእንተ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ከማሆሙ ፡ አነ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ 
ወለእለ ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

verses.textGeez: ሣህልከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ መልአ ፡ ምድረ ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
፱ ጤት ።
ሠናይተ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገብርከ 
እግዚኦ ፡ በከመ ፡ ቃልከ ።
verses.textEnglish: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ሠናይተ ፡ ምክር ፡ ወጥበበ ፡ ምህረኒ 
እስመ ፡ ተአመንኩ ፡ በትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሰ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እሕምም ፡ ነሳሕኩ 
ወበእንተዝ ፡ አነ ፡ ዐቀብኩ ፡ ነቢበከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

verses.textGeez: ኄር ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ወበኂሩትከ ፡ ምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
በዝኀ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ ፡ ለዕቡያን 
ወአንሰ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

verses.textGeez:
ረግዐ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐሊብ ፡ ልቦሙ 
ወአንሰ ፡ ኣነብብ ፡ በሕግከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

verses.textGeez: ደለወኒ ፡ ዘኣሕመምከኒ ከመ ፡ አእምር ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

verses.textGeez: ይኄይሰኒ ፡ ሕገ ፡ አፉከ እምኣእላፍ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ።
verses.textEnglish: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.textGeez:
፲ ዮድ ።
እደቂከ ፡ ገብራኒ ፡ ወለሐኳኒ 
ኣለብወኒ ፡ ወእትመሀር ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ ፡ ይርእዩኒ ፡ ወይትፌሥሑ 
እስመ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ በነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ኣእመርኩ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ኵነኔከ 
ወበርቱዕ ፡ ኣሕመምከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

verses.textGeez:
ይኩነኒ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተፈሥሐኒ 
ወበከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ፡ ይኩኖ ፡ ለገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

verses.textGeez:
ይምጽአኒ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ ወእሕየው 
እስመ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕግከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

verses.textGeez:
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ዕቡያን ፡ እስመ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ መከሩ ፡ ላዕሌየ 
ወአንሰ ፡ እዛዋዕ ፡ በትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

verses.textGeez: ይግብኡኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርሁከ ወእለ ፡ ያአምሩ ፡ ስምዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez: ለይኩን ፡ ልብየ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ በኵነኔከ ከመ ፡ ኢይተኀፈር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

verses.textGeez:
፲፩ ካፍ ።
ኀለፈት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድኅኖትከ 
ወተወከልኩ ፡ በቃልከ ።
verses.textEnglish: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ደክማ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ለመድኀኒትከ 
እንዘ ፡ ይብላ ፡ ማእዜ ፡ ታስተፌሥሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኮንኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዝቅ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አስሐትያ 
ወኵነኔከሰ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
ሚመጠን ፡ እማንቱ ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ለገብርከ 
ወማእዜ ፡ ትፈትሕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ይሰዱኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.textGeez:
ነገሩኒ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ዘውዐ 
ወአኮሰ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሕግከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ፡ ጽድቅ 
በዐመፃ ፡ ሰደዱኒ ፡ ርድአኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

verses.textGeez:
ሕቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘእምደምሰሱኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር 
ወአንሰ ፡ ኢኀደጉ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
በከመ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ ኣሕይወኒ 
ወእዕቀብ ፡ ስምዐ ፡ አፉከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

verses.textGeez:
፲፪ ላሜድ ።
እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ይነብር ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

verses.textGeez:
ወለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ጽድቅከ 
ሳረርካ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወትነብር ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

verses.textGeez: ወበትእዛዝከ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ዕለት እስመ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቀነይከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ ሕግከ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ 
ትካት ፡ እምተሐጐልኩ ፡ በኀሳርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

verses.textGeez:
ለዓለም ፡ ኢይረስዕ ፡ ኵነኔከ 
እስመ ፡ ቦቱ ፡ አሕየውከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

verses.textGeez: ዘዚአከ ፡ አነ ፡ አድኅነኒ እስመ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
ኪያየ ፡ ይጸንሑ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ይቅትሉኒ 
እስመ ፡ ስምዐከ ፡ ለበውኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
ለኵሉ ፡ ግብር ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ማኅለቅቶ 
ወትእዛዝከሰ ፡ ርሒብ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

verses.textGeez:
፲፫ ሜም ።
ጥቀ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ፡ ሕገከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ተምሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.textGeez:
እምጸላእትየ ፡ አጥበበኒ ፡ ትእዛዝከ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ሊተ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.textGeez:
እምኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ መሀሩኒ ፡ ጠበብኩ 
እስመ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.textGeez: ወእምአእሩግኒ ፡ ጠበብኩ እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
እምኵሉ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ከላእኩ ፡ እግርየ 
ከመ ፡ እዕቀብ ፡ ነቢበከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

verses.textGeez: ወኢተገሐስኩ ፡ እምኵነኔከ እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ መሀርከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

verses.textGeez:
ጥዑም ፡ ለጕርዔየ ፡ ነቢብከ 
እምዓር ፡ ወሶከር ፡ ጥዕመኒ ፡ ለአፉየ ።
verses.textEnglish: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.textGeez:
እምትእዛዝከ ፡ ለበውኩ 
በእንተዝ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ጸላእኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.textGeez:
፲፬ ኖን ።
ማሕቶት ፡ ለእግርየ ፡ ሕግከ 
ብርሃን ፡ ለፍኖትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.textGeez: መሐልኩ ፡ ወአጥባዕኩ ከመ ፡ እዕቀብ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

verses.textGeez: ሐመምኩ ፡ ፈድፋደ እግዚኦ ፡ ኣሕይወኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

verses.textGeez: ሥመር ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉየ ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ነፍስየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ 
ወኢረሳዕኩ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

verses.textGeez:
ሠርዑ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ መሥገርተ 
ወኢስሕትኩ ፡ እምትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
ወረስኩ ፡ ስምዐከ ፡ ለዓለም 
እስመ ፡ ሐሤቱ ፡ ለልብየ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.textGeez:
ሜጥኩ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግበር ፡ ትእዛዘከ 
ለዓለም ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ሒስ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

verses.textGeez:
፲፭ ሳምኬት ።
ዐማፂያነ ፡ ጻላእኩ ወሕገከሰ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

verses.textGeez:
ረዳኢየ ፡ ወምስካይየ ፡ አንተ 
ወበቃልከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ተገሐሡ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ዐማፂያን 
ወእኅሥሥ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለአምላኪየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

verses.textGeez:
ተወከፈኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ ፡ ወእሕየው 
ወኢታስተኀፍረኒ ፡ እምተስፋየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.textGeez: ርድእኒ ፡ ወአድኅነኒ ወኣነብብ ፡ በኵነኔከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

verses.textGeez:
ኣኅሰርኮሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይርሕቁ ፡ እምትእዛዝከ 
እስመ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ፍትወቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

verses.textGeez:
ዐላውያን ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ኃጥኣነ ፡ ምድር 
በእንተዝ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ፡ ስምዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
አውድድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሥጋየ ፡ ፈሪሆተከ 
እስመ ፡ ፈራህኩ ፡ እምኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
፲፮ ዔ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ወጽድቀ 
ኢትመጥወኒ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይሣቅዩኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

verses.textGeez: ጽንሖ ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሠናይ ወኢይትዐገሉኒ ፡ ዕቡያን ።
verses.textEnglish: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.textGeez:
ደክማ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ለአድኅኖትከ 
ወለቃለ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ግበር ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez: ገብርከ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣለብወኒ ወኣእምር ፡ ስምዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez: ጊዜ ፡ ለገቢር ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ወዐለዉ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.

verses.textGeez: በእንተዝ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ እምወርቅ ፡ ወእምጳዝዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተዝ ፡ አርታዕኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዝከ 
ኵሎ ፡ ፈኖተ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ጸላእኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

verses.textGeez:
፲፯ ፌ ።
መንክር ፡ ስምዕከ 
በእንተዝ ፡ ኀሠሠቶ ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

verses.textGeez: ነገረ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ያበርህ ወያጠብብ ፡ ሕፃናተ ።
verses.textEnglish: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

verses.textGeez:
አፉየ ፡ ከሠትከ ፡ ወነፍስየ ፡ አናኅኩ 
እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ አፍቀርኩ
verses.textEnglish: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

verses.textGeez: ነጽር ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወተሣሀለኒ በከመ ፡ ፍትሖሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፍቅሩ ፡ ስመከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

verses.textGeez:
አርትዕ ፡ ፍኖትየ ፡ ወሑረትየ ፡ በከመ ፡ ነቢብከ 
ወአይምአኒ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀጢአት ።
verses.textEnglish: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምትእግልተ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው 
ወእዕቀብ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

verses.textGeez: አብርህ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገብርከ ወምህረኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
ሙሓዘ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወረደ ፡ እምአዕይንትየ 
ወእመአኮሰ ፡ እምኢዐቅብኩ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

verses.textGeez:
፲፰ ጻዴ ።
ጻድቅ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ወርቱዕ ፡ ኳነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ወአዘዝከ ፡ ስምዐከ ፡ በጽድቅ 
ወርቱዓ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

verses.textGeez:
መሰወኒ ፡ ቅንአተ ፡ ቤትከ 
እስመ ፡ ረስዑ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ጸላእትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

verses.textGeez:
ርሱን ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወገብርከሰ ፡ አፍቀሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

verses.textGeez: ወሬዛ ፡ አነ ፡ ወትሑት ወሕገከሰ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

verses.textGeez: ጽድቅከሰ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ዘለዓለም ወቃልከኒ ፡ እሙን ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

verses.textGeez:
ሕማም ፡ ወምንዳቤ ፡ ረከበኒ 
ወትእዛዝከሰ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

verses.textGeez:
ጽድቅ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ስምዕከ ፡ ለዓለም 
ኣለብወኒ ፡ ወኣሕይወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.textGeez:
፲፱ ቆፍ ።
ጸራኅኩ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወኀሠሥኩ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ወአድኅነኒ 
ወእዕቀብ ፡ ስምዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
በጻሕኩ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አድባር ፡ ወከላሕኩ 
እስመ ፡ ቃለከ ፡ ተሰፈውኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

verses.textGeez: በጽሓ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ ለገዪስ ከመ ፡ ኣንብብ ፡ ቃለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ሰማዕ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ በከመ ፡ ሣህልከ 
ወኣሕይወኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ፍትሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

verses.textGeez:
ቀርቡ ፡ እለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ በዐመፃ 
ወእምሕግከሰ ፡ ርሕቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

verses.textGeez: ቅሩብ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ወርቱዕ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.

verses.textGeez:
እምትካት ፡ አእመርኩ ፡ እምስምዕከ 
ከመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ሳረርኮን ።
verses.textEnglish: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

verses.textGeez:
፳ ሬስ ።
ርኢ ፡ ሕማምየ ፡ ወአድኅነኒ 
እስመ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ፡ ሕገከ ።
verses.textEnglish: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

verses.textGeez:
ፍታሕ ፡ ፍትሕየ ፡ ወባልሐኒ 
ወበእንተ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ኣሕይወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

verses.textGeez: ርሑቅ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ እምኃጥኣን እስመ ፡ ኢኀሠሡ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኅ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፈድፋደ 
ወኣሕይወኒ ፡ በከመ ፡ ፍትሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኃን ፡ እለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ ወአመንደቡኒ 
ወኢተገሐስኩ ፡ እምስምዕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

verses.textGeez:
ርኢኩ ፡ አብደነ ፡ ወተከዝኩ 
እስመ ፡ ኢዐቀቡ ፡ ቃለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ርኢ ፡ ከመ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ 
እግዚኦ ፡ ኣሕይወኒ ፡ በሣህልከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

verses.textGeez:
ቀዳሜ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ውእቱ 
ወለዓለም ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኵነኔከ ፡ ጽድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
፳፩ ሳን ።
መላእክት ፡ ሰደዱኒ ፡ በከንቱ 
ወእምቃልከ ፡ ደንገፀኒ ፡ ልብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

verses.textGeez: ወበቃልከ ፡ ተፈሣሕኩ ከመ ፡ ዘረከበ ፡ ምህርካ ፡ ብዙኀ ።
verses.textEnglish: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

verses.textGeez:
ዐመፃ ፡ ጸላእኩ ፡ ወአስቆረርኩ 
ወሕገከሰ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

verses.textGeez: ስብዐ ፡ ለዕለትየ ፡ እሴብሐከ በእንተ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

verses.textGeez:
ሰላም ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፍቅሩ ፡ ስመከ 
ወአልቦሙ ፡ ዕቅፍተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.textGeez:
ተሰፈውኩ ፡ አድኅኖተከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወዐቀብኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቀበት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ስምዐከ 
ወአፍቀረቶ ፡ ፈድፋደ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቀብኩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ወስምዐከኒ 
እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊየ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

verses.textGeez:
፳፪ ታው ።
ለትቅረብ ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወበከመ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ አለብወኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

verses.textGeez:
ትብጻሕ ፡ አስተብቍዖትየ ፡ ቅድሜከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወበከመ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ አድኅነኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

verses.textGeez: ጐሥዐ ፡ ከናፍርየ ፡ ስብሐቲከ እስመ ፡ መሀርከኒ ፡ ኵነኔከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

verses.textGeez: ነበበ ፡ ልሳንየ ፡ ቃለከ እስመ ፡ ጽድቅ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ።
verses.textEnglish: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ይኩነኒ ፡ የማንከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያድኅነኒ 
እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ አፍቀርኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

verses.textGeez:
አፍቀርኩ ፡ አድኅኖተከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወሕግከሰ ፡ ተመሀርየ ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.

verses.textGeez:
ትሕየወኒ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ወእሰብሐከ 
ወይርድአኒ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ዚአከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

verses.textGeez:
ተረሳዕኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ዘተገድፈ ፡
ኅሥሦ ፡ ለገብርከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፡ ኢረሳዕኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳ - ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደብኩ ፡ ወሰማዕከኒ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 120 - My Help Comes from the Lord
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተመንደብኩ ፡ ወሰማዕከኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አድኅና ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ እምከናፍረ ፡ ዐመፃ 
ወእምልሳነ ፡ ጽልሑት ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.textGeez: ምንተ ፡ ይሁብከ ፡ ወምንተ ፡ ይዌስኩከ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ከናፍረ ፡ ጕሕሉት ።
verses.textEnglish: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

verses.textGeez: አሕጻሁ ፡ ለኀያል ፡ ስሑል ከመ ፡ አፍሓመ ፡ ሐቅል ።
verses.textEnglish: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.textGeez:
ሴልየ ፡ ዘርሕቀ ፡ ማኅደርየ 
ወኀደርኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጻዳተ ፡ እለ ፡ ቄዳር ።
verses.textEnglish: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.textGeez:
ብዙኀ ፡ ተዐገሠት ፡ ነፍስየ 
ምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልኡ ፡ ሰላመ ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

verses.textGeez:
እንዘ ፡ ሰላማዊ ፡ አነ 
ወሶበ ፡ እትነገሮሙ ፡ ይፀብኡኒ ፡ በከንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፩ - አንሣእኩ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አድባር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 121 - I Was Glad When They Said to Me
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
አንሣእኩ ፡ አዕይንትየ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አድባር 
እምአይቴ ፡ ይምጻእ ፡ ረድኤትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

verses.textGeez:
ረድኤትየሰ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይሁቦን ፡ ሁከተ ፡ ለእገሪከ 
ወኢይዴቅስ ፡ ዘየዐቅበከ ።
verses.textEnglish: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ ኢይዴቅስ ፡ ወኢይነውም ፡ ዘየዐቅቦ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይዕቀብከ 
ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይክድንከ ፡ በየማነ ፡ እዴሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.textGeez: መዐልተ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ኢያውዒከ ወኢወርኅ ፡ በሌሊት ።
verses.textEnglish: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይዕቀብከ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ እኩይ 
ወይትማኅፀና ፡ ለነፍስከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይዕቀብከ ፡ በንግደትከ ፡ ወበእትወትከ 
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፪ - ተፈሣሕኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይቤሉኒ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነሐውር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 122 - Our Eyes Look to the Lord Our God
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ተፈሣሕኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይቤሉኒ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነሐውር ።
verses.textEnglish: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ወቆማ ፡ እገሪነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕጻዲኪ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.textGeez:
ኢየሩሳሌምሰ ፡ ሕንጽት ፡ ከመ ፡ ሀገር 
እለ ፡ ከማሃ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ህየ ፡ ዐርጉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡
ሕዝበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ስምዐ ፡ እሰአኤል 
ከመ ፡ ይግነዩ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ህየ ፡ አንበሩ ፡ መናብርቲሆሙ ፡ ለኰንኖ 
መናብረተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ዳዊት ።
verses.textEnglish: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.textGeez:
ተዘያነዉ ፡ ደኅናሃ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም 
ወፍሥሓሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፍቅሩ ፡ ስመከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

verses.textGeez:
ይኩን ፡ ሰላመ ፡ በኀይልከ 
ወትፍሥሕት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅፈደ ፡ ክበዲከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተ ፡ አኀውየ ፡ ወቢጽየ 
ይትናገሩ ፡ ሰላመ ፡ በእንቲአኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.textGeez: ወበእንተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ ኀሠሥኩ ፡ ሠናይተኪ ።
verses.textEnglish: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፫ - ኀቤከ ፡ አንቃዕዶነ ፡ አዕይንቲነ ዘትነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 123 - Our Help is in the Name of the Lord
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ኀቤከ ፡ አንቃዕዶነ ፡ አዕይንቲነ ዘትነብር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ አዕይንተ ፡ አግብርት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ አጋእስቲሆሙ
verses.textEnglish: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.textGeez:
ወከመ ፡ ዐይነ ፡ አመት ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ እግዝእታ ከማሁ ፡ አዕይንቲነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡
እስከ ፡ አመ ፡ ይሣሀለነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.textGeez:
ተሣሀለነ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ተሣሀለነ 
እስመ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ጸገብነ ፡ ጽእለተ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.textGeez:
ወፈድፋደ ፡ ጸግበት ፡ ነፍስነ 
ጽእለተ ፡ ብዑላን ፡ ወኀሳረ ፡ ዕቡያን ።
verses.textEnglish: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፬ - ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌነ ይብል ፡ እስራኤል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 124 - The Lord Surrounds His People
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌነ ይብል ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ አኮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌነ 
እንተ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ላዕሌነ ።
አሕዛብ ፡ ሕያዋኒነ ፡ እምውኅጡነ
verses.textEnglish: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.textGeez: በከመ ፡ አንሥኡ ፡ ቍጥዓ ፡ መዐቶሙ ፡ ላዕሌነ ።አሕዛብ ፡ በማይ ፡ እምአስጠሙነ
verses.textEnglish: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.textGeez: እምውሒዝ ፡ አምሰጠት ፡ ነፍስነ ።አምሰየት ፡ ነፍስነ ፡ እማየ ፡ ሀከክ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ 
ዘኢያግብአነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥገርተ ፡ ማዕገቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.textGeez: ነፍስነሰ ፡ አምሰጠት ፡ ከመ ፡ ዖፍ ፡ እመሥገርት ፡ ነዓዊት
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.textGeez: መሥገርትሰ ፡ ተቀጥቀጠት ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ ድኅነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.textGeez: ረድኤትነ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፭ - እለ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ጽዮን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 125 - Restore Our Fortunes, O Lord
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ተወከሉ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ጽዮን 
ኢይትሀወክ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ዘየኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
አድባር ፡ የዐውዳ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ይሜግብ ፡ ሕዝቦ ፡
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ኢየኀድግ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በትረ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ ዲበ ፡ መክፈልተ ፡ ጻድቃን 
ከመ ፡ ኢያንሥኡ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ በዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.textGeez: አሠኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለኄራን ፡ ወለርቱዓነ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.textGeez:
ወእለሰ ፡ ይትመየጡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፁግ 
ይወስዶሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
ሰላም ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፮ - አመ ፡ ሜጠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፄዋ ፡ ጽዮን
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 126 - Unless the Lord Builds the House
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
አመ ፡ ሜጠ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ፄዋ ፡ ጽዮን 
ኮነ ፡ ፍሡሓን ።
verses.textEnglish: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.textGeez: አሜሃ ፡ መልአ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ አፉነ ወተሐሥየ ፡ ልሳንነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

verses.textGeez:
አሜሃ ፡ ይቤሉ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ኣዕበየ ፡ ገቢረ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

verses.textGeez:
ሚጥ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፄዋነ 
ከመ ፡ ውሒዝ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዜብ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ ይዘርዑ ፡ በአንብዕ ፡ በሐሤት ፡ የአርሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፯ - ሶበሰ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ወፈሩ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይበክዩ ፡ ወጾሩ ፡ ዘርዖሙ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 127 - Blessed is Everyone Who Fears the Lord

verses.textGeez: ሶበሰ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ወፈሩ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይበክዩ ፡ ወጾሩ ፡ ዘርዖሙ
verses.textEnglish: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.textGeez: ወሶበ ፡ የአትዉ ፡ ምጽኡ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትፌሥሑ ፡ ወጾሩ ፡ ከላስስቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

verses.textGeez:
ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።1 እመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢሐነጸ ፡ ቤተ ፡
ከንቶ ፡ ይጻምዉ ፡ እለ ፡ የሐንጹ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

verses.textGeez:
እመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኢዐቀበ ፡ ሀገረ ፡
ከንቶ ፡ ይተግሁ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሔልዉ ።
verses.textEnglish: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

verses.textGeez:
ወከንቱ ፡ ገይሶትክሙ 
ተንሥኡ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ነበርክሙ ፡
እለ ፡ ትሴሰዩ ፡ እክለ ፡ ሕማም ፡
ሶበ ፡ ይሁቦሙ ፡ ንዋመ ፡ ለፍቁራኒሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ጸጋሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ውሉድ 
ዕሤተ ፡ ፍሬሃ ፡ ለከርሥ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ አሕጻ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ኀያል 
ከማሁ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ለንጉፋን ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፌጽም ፡ ፍትወቶ ፡ እምኔሆሙ 
ወኢይትኀፈር ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይትናገሮሙ ፡ ለጸላእቱ ፡ በአናቅጽ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.textGeez: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፰ - ብፁዓን ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 128 - The Lord is Righteous

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዓን ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እለ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ በፍናዊሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

verses.textGeez:
ፍሬ ፡ ጻማከ ፡ ትሴሰይ ።
ብፁዕ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወሠናይ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.textGeez: ብእሲትከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ወይን ፡ ስሙር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ ቤትከ
verses.textEnglish: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.textGeez: ወውሉድከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተክለ ፡ ዘይት ፡ ሐይት ፡ ሐዲስ ፡ ዐውድ ፡ ማእድከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ይትባረክ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘይፈርሆ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

verses.textGeez:
ይባርከከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምጽዮን 
ወትሬኢ ፡ ሠናይታ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡
በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕይወትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ወትሬኢ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ውሉድከ 
ሰላም ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፳፱ - ዘልፈ ፡ ይፀብኡኒ ፡ እምንእስየ ይብል ፡ እስራኤል
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 129 - Out of the Depths I Cry to You
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ዘልፈ ፡ ይፀብኡኒ ፡ እምንእስየ ይብል ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

verses.textGeez:
ዘልፈ ፡ ይፀብኡኒ ፡ እምንእስየ 
ወባሕቱ ፡ ኢክህሉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.textGeez:
ዲበ ፡ ዘባንየ ፡ ዘበጡ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
ወአስተርሐቅዋ ፡ ለኃጢአቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጻድቅ ፡ ሰበረ ፡ አሕዳፊሆሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ።
ይትኀፈሩ ፡ ወይግብኡ ፡ ድኅሬሆሙ 
ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልእዋ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.textGeez:
ወይኩኑ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ አንሕስት 
ወይየብስ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ይምሐውዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይመልእ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለዘ ፡ የዐፅዶ 
ወኢሕፅኖ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ያስተጋብእ ፡ ከላስስቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይበሉ ፡ እለ ፡ የኀልፉ ፡ በረከተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌሆሙ 
ባረክናክሙ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴ - እምዕምቅ ፡ ጸዋዕኩከ ፡ እግዚኦ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 130 - I Have Calmed and Quieted My Soul
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
እምዕምቅ ፡ ጸዋዕኩከ ፡ እግዚኦ ።
እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ቃልየ
verses.textEnglish: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

verses.textGeez: ወይኩን ፡ እዝንከ ፡ ዘያፀምእ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.textGeez: እመሰ ፡ ኃጢአተኑ ፡ ትትዐቀብ ፡ እግዚኦ እግዚኦ ፡ መኑ ፡ ይቀውም ።
verses.textEnglish: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ እምኀቤከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሣህል በእንተ ፡ ስምከ ።
verses.textEnglish: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

verses.textGeez:
ተሰፈውኩከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ተዐገሠት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በሕግከ ።
ተወከለት ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በእግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.textGeez: እምሰዓት ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሌሊት ።እምሰዓት ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ተወከለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሣህል 
ወብዙኅ ፡ አድኅና ፡ በኀቤሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.textGeez: ወውእቱ ፡ ያድኅኖ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ኃጢአቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፩ - እግዚኦ ፡ ኢይትዐበየኒ ፡ ልብየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፴፩ (131) - አቤቱ ፥ ልቤ፡አይታበይብኝ ፥ ዐይኖቼም፡ከፍ፡ከፍ፡አይበሉብኝ...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 131 - The Lord Has Chosen Zion
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ኢይትዐበየኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡
ወኢይዛዋዕ ፡ አዕይንትየ ።
verses.textAmharic: አቤቱ ፥ ልቤ፡አይታበይብኝ ፥ ዐይኖቼም፡ከፍ፡ከፍ፡አይበሉብኝ ከትልልቆች፡ጋራ ፥ ከእኔም፡ይበልጥ፡ከሚከበሩ፡ ጋራ፡አልኼድኹም።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢሖርኩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዐበይት ፡
ወኢምስለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይከብሩ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.textGeez: ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘአትሐትኩ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ ወከላሕኩ ፡ በቃልየ
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ዘአኅደግዎ ፡ ጥበ ፡ እሙ ከመ ፡ ትዕስያ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ተወከለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በእግዚአብሔር 
እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፪ - ተዘከሮ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዳዊት ወለኵሉ ፡ የዋሀቱ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 132 - When Brothers Dwell in Unity
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez: ተዘከሮ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዳዊት ወለኵሉ ፡ የዋሀቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: A Song of degrees. LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:

verses.textGeez: ዘከመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ወበፅአ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይበውእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽላሎተ ፡ ቤትየ 
ወከመ ፡ ኢያዐርግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐራተ ፡ ምስካብየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ኢይሁቦን ፡ ንዋመ ፡ ለአዕይንትየ 
ወኢድቃሰ ፡ ለቀራንብትየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

verses.textGeez:
ወኢዕረፍተ ፡ ለመላትሕየ ።እስከ ፡ እረክብ ፡ መካኖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ወማኅደሮ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ።
verses.textEnglish: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ሰማዕናሁ ፡ በኤፍራታ 
ወረከብናሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዖመ ፡ ገዳም ።
verses.textEnglish: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.textGeez:
ንበውእ ፡ እንከሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሁ 
ወንሰግድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ቆመ ፡ እግረ ፡ እግዚእነ ።
verses.textEnglish: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.textGeez:
ተንሥእ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዕረፍትከ 
አንተ ፡ ወታቦተ ፡ መቅደስከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

verses.textGeez:
ካህናቲከ ፡ ይለብሱ ፡ ጽድቀ 
ወጻድቃኒከ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ፡ ይትፍፈሥሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

verses.textGeez:
በእንተ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ገብርከ 
ወኢትሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እመሲሕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

verses.textGeez:
መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወኢይኔስሕ 
እስመ ፡ እምፍሬ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ኣነብር ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.textGeez:
ወለእመ ፡ ዐቀቡ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ሕግየ ፡
ወሰምዑኒ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ዘእሜህሮሙ
verses.textEnglish: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.textGeez: ወደቂቆሙኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ይበንሩ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ኀረያ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለጽዮን ወአብደራ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኩኖ ፡ ማኅደሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.textGeez:
ዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምዕራፍየ ፡ ለዓለም 
ዝየ ፡ አኀደር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀረይክዋ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.textGeez:
ለእቤራቲሃኒ ፡ ባርኮ ፡ እባርኮን 
ወለነዳያኒሃኒ ፡ ኣጸግቦሙ ፡ እክለ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.textGeez:
ወለካህናቲሃኒ ፡ ኣለብሶሙ ፡ ሕይወተ 
ወጻድቃኒሃኒ ፡ ትፍሥሕተ ፡ ይትፍፌሥሑ ።
verses.textEnglish: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

verses.textGeez:
ወበህየ ፡ ኣበቍል ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ለዳዊት 
ወኣስተዳሉ ፡ ማኅቶተ ፡ ለመሲሕየ ።
verses.textEnglish: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.textGeez:
ወኣለብሶሙ ፡ ኀፍረተ ፡ ለጸላእቱ 
ወቦቱ ፡ ይፈሪ ፡ ቅድሳትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፫ - ናሁ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አዳም
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፴፫ (133) - ወንድሞች፡በኅብረት፡ቢቀመጡ ፥ እንሆ ፥ መልካም፡ነው ፥ እንሆም ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 133 - Come, Bless the Lord
psalms.heading: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወናሁ ፡ አዳም 
ሶበ ፡ ይሄልዉ ፡ አኀው ፡ ኅቡረ ።
verses.textEnglish: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ዕፍረት ፡ ዘይውሕዝ ፡ እምርእሱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ጽሕሙ 
ጽሕሙ ፡ ለአሮን ፡ ዘይወርድ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኅባኔ ፡ መልበሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.textGeez: ከመ ፡ ጠለ ፡ አርሞንኤም ፡ ዘይወርድ ፡ ዲበ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ጽዮን
verses.textEnglish: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ህየ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በረከቶ ፡ወሕይወተ ፡ እምይእዜ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.textGeez: ማኅሌት ፡ ዘበመዓርጊሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፬ - ናሁ ፡ ይባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 134 - Your Name, O Lord, Endures Forever

verses.textGeez:
ናሁ ፡ ይባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
ኵሎሙ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ ይቀውሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
በሌሊት ፡ አንሥኡ ፡ እደዊክሙ ፡ በቤተ ፡ መቅደስ 
ወባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

verses.textGeez:
ይባርከከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምጽዮን 
ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፭ - ሰብሑ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 135 - Give Thanks to the Lord, for His Steadfast Love Endures
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሑ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ትቀውሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አምላክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወዘምሩ ፡ ለስሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ኀረዮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወለእስራኤልኒ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለርስቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ ኣእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ወአምላክነሂ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ አማልክት ።
verses.textEnglish: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎ ፡ ዘፈቀደ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
በሰማይኒ ፡ ወበምድርኒ በባሕርኒ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡ ቀላያት ።
verses.textEnglish: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.textGeez:
ያዐርግ ፡ ደመናተ ፡ እምአጽናፈ ፡ ምድር 
ወገብረ ፡ መብረቀ ፡ ለጊዜ ፡ ዝናም ።
verses.textEnglish: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.textGeez:
ዘያወፅኦሙ ፡ ለነፋሳት ፡ እመዛግብቲሆሙ ።
ዘቀተለ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በኵሮሙ ፡ ለግብጽ 
እምሰብእ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ እንስሳ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.textGeez:
ፈነወ ፡ ተኣምረ ፡ ወመንክረ ፡ ማእከሌኪ ፡ ግብጽ 
ላዕለ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.textGeez:
ዘቀተለ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ብዙኃነ 
ወቀተለ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ጽኑዓነ
verses.textEnglish: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.textGeez: ለሴዎን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አሞሬዎን ፡ ወለዖግ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ባሳን ወለኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ከናዐን ።
verses.textEnglish: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ርስተ 
ርስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ገብሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

verses.textGeez:
ስምኬ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለዓለም 
ወዝክርከኒ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ይኴንን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሕዝቦ 
ወይትናበብ ፡ በእንተ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.textGeez:
አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ፡ ዘወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር 
ግብረ ፡ እደ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

verses.textGeez: አፈ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይነቡ አዕይንተ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይሬእዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.textGeez:
እዝነ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይሰምዑ 
አንፈ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢያጼንዉ ።
እደ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢይገሱ እግረ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወኢየሐውሩ 
ወኢይነቡ ፡ በጐራዒቶሙ ።
ወአልቦሙ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.textGeez:
ከማሆሙ ፡ ለይኩኑ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ገብርዎሙ 
ወኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትአመኑ ፡ ቦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

verses.textGeez:
ቤተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
ቤተ ፡ አሮን ፡ ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:

verses.textGeez:
ቤተ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር 
እለ ፡ ትፈርህዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ባርክዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ቡሩክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በጽዮን 
ዘየኀድር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፮ - ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፴፮ (136) - እግዚአብሔርን፡አመስግኑ ቸር፡ነውና ፥ ምሕረቱ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነውና
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 136 - By the Waters of Babylon
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ኄር 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez: ግነዩ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ አምልክት እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ግነዩ ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ አጋእዝት 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘገብረ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ መንክረ ፡ ባሕቲቱ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ በጥበቡ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአጽንዓ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ማይ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘገብረ ፡ ብርሃናተ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ በሕቲቱ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ለፀሐይ ፡ ዘአኰነኖ ፡ መዐልተ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ለወርኅ ፡ ወለከዋክብተ ፡ ዘአኰነኖሙ ፡ ሌሊተ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘቀተሎሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ ምስለ ፡ በኵሮሙ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እማእከሎሙ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
በእድ ፡ ጽንዕት ፡ ወበመዝራዕት ፡ ልዕልት 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘነፈቃ ፡ ለባሕረ ፡ ኤርትራ ፡ ወከፈላ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወአውፅኦሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ እንተ ፡ ማእከላ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ዘነፅኆ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፡ ወለኀይሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ኤርትራ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘአውፅኦሙ ፡ ለሕዝቡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
ዘአውፅአ ፡ ማየ ፡ እምኰኵሕ እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘቀተለ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ዐበይተ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወቀተለ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ጽኑዓነ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ለሴዎን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ አሞሬዎን 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወለዖግ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ባሳን 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ምድሮሙ ፡ ርስተ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ርስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ገብሩ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ተዘከረነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በሕማምነ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

verses.textGeez:
ወአድኀነነ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀርነ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሁብ ፡ ሲሳየ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.textGeez:
ግነዮ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ሰማይ 
እስመ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፯ - ውስት ፡ አፍላገ ፡ ባቢሎን ፡ ህየ ፡ ነበርነ ፡ ወበከይነ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 137 - Great is the Glory of the Lord
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ውስት ፡ አፍላገ ፡ ባቢሎን ፡ ህየ ፡ ነበርነ ፡ ወበከይነ 
ሶበ ፡ ተዘከርናሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.textGeez: ውስተ ፡ ኲሓቲሃ ፡ ሰቀልነ ፡ ዕንዚራቲነ ።
verses.textEnglish: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ በህየ ፡ ተስእሉነ ፡ እለ ፡ ፄወዉነ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ማኅሌት ፡
verses.textEnglish: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.textGeez: ወእለሂ ፡ ይወስዱነ ፡ ይቤሉነ ፡ ኅልዩ ፡ ለነ ፡ እምኃልዪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
verses.textEnglish: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?

verses.textGeez: ወእፈ ፡ ነኀሊ ፡ ማኅሌተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በምድረ ፡ ነኪር ።
verses.textEnglish: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.textGeez: እመሰ ፡ ረሳዕኩኪ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ለትርስዐኒ ፡ የማንየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

verses.textGeez: ወይጥጋዕ ፡ ልሳንየ ፡ በጕርዔየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢተዘከርኩኪ
verses.textEnglish: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

verses.textGeez: ወለእመ ፡ ኢበፃእኩ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ፡ በቀዳሚ ፡ ትፍሥሕትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

verses.textGeez: ተዘከሮሙ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኤዶም ፡በዕለተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ንሥቱ ፡ ንሥቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ መሰረታቲሃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

verses.textGeez:
ወለተ ፡ ባቢሎን ፡ ኅስርት 
ብፁዕ ፡ ዘይትቤቀለኪ ፡ በቀለ ፡ ተበቀልክነ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

verses.textGeez: ብፁዕ ፡ ዘይእኅዞሙ ፡ ለደቂቅኪ ፡ ወይነፅኆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኰኵሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፰ - እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፴፰ (138) - አቤቱ ፥ በፍጹም፡ልቤ፡አመሰግንኻለኹ ፥ የአፌን፡ነገር፡ሰምተኸኛልና...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 138 - O Lord, You Have Searched Me and Known Me
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez: እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልብየ ፡
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
በቅድመ ፡ መላእክቲከ ፡ እዜምር ፡ ለከ እስመ ፡ ሰማዕከኒ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉየ ።
ወእሰግድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅደስከ ፡ ወእገኒ ፡ ለስምከ
verses.textEnglish: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

verses.textGeez: በምሕረትከ ፡ ወበጽድቅከ እስመ ፡ ኣዕበይከ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ስመከ ፡ ቅዱሰ ።
verses.textEnglish: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

verses.textGeez:
አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እጼውዐከ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ስምዐኒ 
ብዙኀ ፡ አጽናዕካ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡ በኀይልከ ።
verses.textEnglish: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

verses.textGeez:
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ምድር 
እስመ ፡ ሰምዑ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ አፉከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወየኀልዩ ፡ በስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
እስመ ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ክቡረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ልዑል ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወይሬኢ ፡ ዘበታሕቱ 
ወለነዋኅኒ ፡ እምርሑቅ ፡ ያአምሮ ።
verses.textEnglish: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ምንዳቤ ፡ አንተ ፡ ታሐይወኒ 
ዲበ ፡ መዐተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ሰፋሕከ ፡ እደውየ ።
ወአድኀነኒ ፡ የማንከ ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ብድራትን፡ይመልስልኛል አቤቱ ፥ ምሕረትኽ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነው አቤቱ ፥ የእጅኽን፡ሥራ፡ቸል፡አት በል።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይትቤቀል ፡ ሊተ 
እግዚኦ ፡ ሣህልከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ብድራትን፡ይመልስልኛል አቤቱ ፥ ምሕረትኽ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነው አቤቱ ፥ የእጅኽን፡ሥራ፡ቸል፡አት በል።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

verses.textGeez: እግዚኦ ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊከ ፡ ኢትትሀየድ ።
verses.textAmharic: እግዚአብሔር፡ብድራትን፡ይመልስልኛል አቤቱ ፥ ምሕረትኽ፡ለዘለዓለም፡ነው አቤቱ ፥ የእጅኽን፡ሥራ፡ቸል፡አት በል።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፴፱ - እግዚኦ ፡ አመከርከኒ ፡ ወኣእመርከኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፴፱ (139) - አቤቱ ፥ መረመርኸኝ ፥ ዐወቅኸኝም
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 139 - Deliver Me, O Lord, from Evil Men
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አመከርከኒ ፡ ወኣእመርከኒ ።
አንተ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ንብረትየ ፡ ወተንሥኦትየ
verses.textEnglish: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.

verses.textGeez: ወአንተ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሕሊና ፡ ልብየ ፡ እምርሑቅ ።ፍኖትየ ፡ ወአሰርየ ፡ አንተ ፡ ቀጻዕከ
verses.textEnglish: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.textGeez: ወኵሉ ፡ ፍናውየ ፡ አንተ ፡ አቅደምከ ፡ ኣእምሮ ።ከመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልሳንየ
verses.textEnglish: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

verses.textGeez: ናሁ ፡ አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኣእመርከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘቀዳሚ ፡ ወዘደኃሪ ።አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከኒ ፡ ወወደይከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ላዕሌየ ።
verses.textEnglish: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

verses.textGeez:
ተነክረ ፡ ኣእምሮትከ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
ጸንዐተኒ ፡ ወኢይክል ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.textAmharic: አቤቱ ፥ አንተ ፥ እንሆ ፥ የቀድሞውንና፡የዃላውን፡ዐወቅኽ አንተ፡ፈጠርኸኝ ፥ እጅኽንም፡በላዬ፡አደረግኽ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

verses.textGeez:
አይቴኑ ፡ አሐውር ፡ እመንፈስከ 
ወአይቴኑ ፡ እጐይይ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.textGeez:
እመኒ ፡ ዐረጉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ህየኒ ፡ አንተ 
ወእመኒ ፡ ወረድኩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቀላይ ፡ ህየኒ ፡ ሀሎከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

verses.textGeez:
ወእመኒ ፡ ነሣርኩ ፡ ክንፈ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንስር 
ወሠረርኩ ፡ እስከ ፡ ማሕለቅተ ፡ ባሕር ።
verses.textEnglish: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

verses.textGeez: ህየኒ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ትመርሐኒ ወታነብረኒ ፡ የማንከ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤ ፡ ጽልመትኑ ፡ እንጋ ፡ ኬደኒ 
ወሌሊትኒ ፡ ብሩህ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ትፍሥሕትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ጽልመትኒ ፡ ኢይጸልም ፡ በኀቤከ 
ወሌሊትኒ ፡ ብሩህ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዐልት 
በአምጣነ ፡ ጽልመታ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ብርሃነ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ አንተ ፡ ፈጠርከ ፡ ኵልያትየ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወተወከፍከኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኣእምር ።
verses.textEnglish: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

verses.textGeez:
እገኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እስመ ፡ ግሩመ ፡ ተሰባሕከ 
መንክር ፡ ግብርከ ፡ ወነፍስየ ፡ ትጤይቆ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.textEnglish: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢይትኀባእ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ አዕጽምትየ ፡ ዘገበርከ ፡ በኅቡእ 
ወኢአካልየ ፡ በመትሕት ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

verses.textGeez:
ወዘሂ ፡ ኢገበርኩ ፡ ርእያ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ፡
ወኵሊ ፡ ይጸሐፍ ፡ ወስተ ፡ መጽሐፍከ 
መዐልተ ፡ ይትፈጠሩ ፡ ወኢይሄሉ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ወበኀቤየሰ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ክቡራን ፡ አዕርክቲከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወፈድፋደ ፡ ጸንዑ ፡ እምቀደምቶሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

verses.textGeez:
ወእኌልቆሙ ፡ እምኆፃ ፡ ይበዝኁ 
ተንሣእኩሂ ፡ ወዓዲ ፡ ሀሎኩ ፡ ምስሌከ ።
verses.textEnglish: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

verses.textGeez:
እመሰ ፡ ቀተልኮሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ እግዚኦ 
ዕድወ ፡ ደም ፡ ተገሐሠ ፡ እምኔየ ።
verses.textEnglish: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ይዜሀሩ ፡ በሕሊናሆሙ 
ወይነሥእዎን ፡ ለአህጉሪከ ፡ በከንቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

verses.textGeez:
አኮኑ ፡ ጸላእተከ ፡ ጸላእኩ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ወተመንሰውኩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፀርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

verses.textGeez: ፍጹመ ፡ ጽልአ ፡ ጸላእክዎሙ ወኮኑኒ ፡ ፀርየ ።
