verses.textEnglish: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

verses.textGeez:
ፍትነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ወአመክር ፡ ልብየ 
አመክረኒ ፡ ወርኢ ፡ ፍናውየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

verses.textGeez:
ወርኢ ፡ እመ ፡ ትረክብ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
ወምርሐኒ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵ - አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምብእሲ ፡ እኩይ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 140 - Give Ear to My Voice When I Cry to You
psalms.heading: ፍጻሜ ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምብእሲ ፡ እኩይ 
ወእምሰብእ ፡ ዐመፂ ፡ ባልሐኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ዐመፃ ፡ መከሩ ፡ በልቦሙ 
ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይረውዱኒ ፡ ይቅትሉኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

verses.textGeez:
ወአብልኁ ፡ ልሳኖሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር 
ሕምዘ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ታሕተ ፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ዕቅበኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡
ወእምብእሲ ፡ ዐመፂ ፡ አድኅነኒ
verses.textEnglish: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ መከሩ ፡ ያዕቅጹ ፡ መከየድየ ።ወኀብኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ መሥገርተ ፡ ዕቡያን
verses.textEnglish: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ወሠተሩ ፡ አሕባለ ፡ መሣግር ፡ ለእገርየ ወአንበሩ ፡ ዕቅፍተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወእቤሎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ 
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ መድኀኒትየ 
ሰወርከኒ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ቀትል ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ርእስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትመጥወኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምፍትወትየ ፡ ለኃጥኣን 
ተማከሩ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወኢትኅድገኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይዘሀሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.textGeez: ርእሰ ፡ ማዕገቶሙ ፡ ወጻማ ፡ ከናፍሪሆሙ ፡ ይድፍኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.textGeez:
ወይደቅ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ አፍሓመ ፡ እሳት 
ትንፅኆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ በምንዳበ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይክሀሉ ፡ ቀዊመ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.textGeez:
ብእሲ ፡ ነባቢ ፡ ኢያረትዕ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር 
ወለብእሲ ፡ ዐማፂ ፡ ትንዕዎ ፡ እኪት ፡ ለአማስኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

verses.textGeez:
ኣእመርኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይገብር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ለነዳያን 
ወፍትሐ ፡ ለምስኪናን ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

verses.textGeez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ይገንዩ ፡ ለስምከ 
ወይነብሩ ፡ ራትዓን ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፩ - እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ስምዐኒ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፵፩ (141) - አቤቱ ፥ ወዳንተ፡ጮኽኹ ስማኝ ወዳንተ፡ስጮኽም፡የልመናዬን፡ቃል፡አድምጥ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 141 - You are My Refuge
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ስምዐኒ 
ወአፅምእ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ ዘጸራኅኩ ፡ ኀቤከ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ተወከፈኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕጣን ፡ በቅድሜከ 
አንሥኦ ፡ እደውየ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ሰርክ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.textGeez:
ሢም ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ዐቃቤ ፡ ለአፉየ 
ወማዕጾ ፡ ዘዐቅም ፡ ለከናፍርየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትሚጦ ፡ ለልብየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነገር ፡ እኩይ ፡
ወአመክንዮ ፡ ምክንያት ፡ ለኃጢአት ፡
verses.textEnglish: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.textGeez: ምስለ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ወኢይትኀበር ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኅሩያኒሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

verses.textGeez:
ገሥጸኒ ፡ በጽድቅ ፡ ወተዛለፈኒ ፡ በምሕረት 
ወቅብአ ፡ ኃጥኣንሰ ፡ ኢይትቀባእ ፡ ርእስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ጸሎትየኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢተሣሀሎሙ 
ተሰጥሙ ፡ በጥቃ ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ጽኑዓኒሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

verses.textGeez:
ሰምዑኒ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተክህለኒ ።
ከመ ፡ ግዝፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ተሠጥቁ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር
verses.textEnglish: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘርወ ፡ አዕጽምቲሆሙ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሲኦል ፡እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ አዕይንትየ 
ብከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ ኢታውፅኣ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.textGeez:
ዕቀበኒ ፡ አመሥገርት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀብኡ ፡ ሊተ 
ወእማዕቀፎሙ ፡ ለገበርተ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

verses.textGeez:
ለይደቁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥገርቶሙ ፡ ኃጥኣን 
እስመ ፡ አኀልፍ ፡ አነ ፡ ባሕቲትየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፪ - ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸራኅኩ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 142 - Hear My Prayer, O Lord
psalms.heading: ኣእምሮ ፡ ዘዳዊት ፤ አመ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ በአት ።

verses.textGeez:
ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ጸራኅኩ 
ቃልየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሰአልኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

verses.textGeez:
ወእክዑ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ስእለትየ 
ወእነግር ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ሕማምየ ።
verses.textEnglish: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.textGeez:
ሶበ ፡ ተኀልቅ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
አንተ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ታአምር ፡ ፍናትየ
verses.textEnglish: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.textGeez: በዛቲ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ ኀብኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ መሥገርተ ።
verses.textEnglish: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.textGeez: ተመየጥኩ ፡ መንገለ ፡ የማንየ ፡ ወርኢኩ ወኀጣእኩ ፡ ዘያአምረኒ
verses.textEnglish: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.textGeez: ወኀበሂ ፡ ኣመስጥ ፡ አልብየ ፡ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትኃሠሥ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍስይ ።
verses.textEnglish: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.textGeez:
ኀቤከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ጸራኅኩ ወእቤለከ ፡ አንተ ፡ ተስፋየ 
ወአንተ ፡ መክፈልትየ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ሕያዋን ።
verses.textEnglish: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.textGeez: ነጽር ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሐመምኩ ፡ ፈድፋደ
verses.textEnglish: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ሮዱኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይኄይሉኒ ።ወአውፅኣ ፡ እሞቅሕ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡
ከመ ፡ እግነይ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ እግዚኦ 
ኪያየ ፡ ይፀንሑ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ እስከ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተዐስየኒ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፫ - እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፵፫ (143) - አቤቱ ፥ ጸሎቴን፡ስማ በእውነትኽ፡ልመናዬን፡አድምጥ ፥...
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 143 - Blessed Be the Lord, My Rock
psalms.heading: መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ፤ ዘአመ ፡ ይሰዶ ፡ ወልዱ ።

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ ጸሎትየ ፡
ወአፅምአኒ ፡ ስእለትየ ፡ በጽድቅከ 
ወስምዐኒ ፡ በርትዕከ ።
verses.textEnglish: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
ወኢትባእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅሥት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ገብርከ 
እስመ ፡ ኢይጸድቅ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕያው ፡ በቅድሜከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሮዳ ፡ ጸላኢ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡
ወኣኅሰራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለሕይወትየ
verses.textEnglish: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንበሩኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ከመ ፡ ምዉተ ፡ ትካት ።ወቀብጸተኒ ፡ በፍስየ ፡ በላዕሌየ 
ወደንገፀኒ ፡ ልብየ ፡ በውስጥየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

verses.textGeez:
ወተዘከርኩ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ትካት ፡
ወአንበብኩ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብርከ 
ወአንብብ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እደቂከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

verses.textGeez:
ወአንሣእኩ ፡ እደውየ ፡ ኀቤከ 
ነፍስየኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ምድረ ፡ በድው ፡ ጸምአተከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

verses.textGeez: ፍጡነ ፡ ስምዐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኀለፈት ፡ ነፍስየ
verses.textEnglish: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.textGeez: ወኢትሚጥ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔየ ወኢይኩን ፡ ከመ ፡ እለ ፡ ይወርዱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐዘቅት ።
verses.textEnglish: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሰማዕ ፡ ግበር ፡ ሊተ ፡ ምሕረትከ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡
እስመ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ እግዚኦ
verses.textEnglish: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

verses.textGeez: ምርሐኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ አሐውር እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ አንቃዕደኩ ፡ ነፍስየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ እምፀርየ 
እስመ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ተማኅፀንኩ ።
ምህረኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ለገቢረ ፡ ፈቃድከ ፡ እስመ ፡ አምላኪየ ፡ አንተ
verses.textEnglish: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.textGeez: ወመንፈስከ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ይምርሐኒ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ጽድቅ ።በእንተ ፡ ስምከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኣሕይወኒ ፡ በጽድቅከ ፡
verses.textEnglish: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

verses.textGeez: ወአውፅኣ ፡ እምንዳቤሃ ፡ ለነፍስየ ።ወበሥምረትከ ፡ ሠርዎሙ ፡ ለፀርየ
verses.textEnglish: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

verses.textGeez: ወታጠፍኦሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ያሐምዋ ፡ ለነፍስየ ፡እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ ገብርከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፬ - ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 144 - I Will Extol You, My God and King
psalms.heading: ዘዳዊት ፡ ዘአመ ፡ ይትባአስ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጎልያድ ።

verses.textGeez:
ይትባረክ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ ፡
ዘመሀሮን ፡ ፀብአ ፡ ለእደውየ 
ወቀትለ ፡ ለአጻብእየ ።
verses.textEnglish: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

verses.textGeez: መሓሪየ ፡ ወጸወንየ ፡ ምስካይየ ፡ ወመድኀኒየ
verses.textEnglish: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

verses.textGeez: ምእመንየ ፡ ወኪያሁ ፡ ተወከልኩ ፡ዘያገርር ፡ ሊተ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ በመትሕቴየ ።
verses.textEnglish: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታስተርኢ ፡ ሎቱ 
ወእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ዘተሐስቦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብእሰ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ይመስል 
ወመዋዕሊሁኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽላሎት ፡ የኀልፍ ።
verses.textEnglish: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ አጽንን ፡ ሰማያቲከ ፡ ወረድ 
ግስሶሙ ፡ ለአድባር ፡ ወይጠይሱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

verses.textGeez:
አብርቅ ፡ መባርቅቲከ ፡ ወዝርዎሙ 
ፈኑ ፡ አሕጻከ ፡ ወሁኮሙ
verses.textEnglish: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

verses.textGeez:
ፈኑ ፡ እዴከ ፡ እምአርያም አድኅነኒ ፡ ወባልሐኒ ፡ እማይ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡
ወእምእዴሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ነኪር ።
verses.textEnglish: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.textGeez:
እለ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ነበበ ፡ አፉሆሙ 
ወየማኖሙኒ ፡ የማነ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

verses.textGeez:
እግዚኦ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ ፡ እሴብሐከ 
ወበመዝሙር ፡ ዘዐሠርቱ ፡ አውታሪሁ ፡ እዜምር ፡ ለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሁቦሙ ፡ ለነገሥት ፡ መድኀኒተ 
ዘአድኀኖ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ገብሩ ፡ አምኲናት ፡ እኪት ።
verses.textEnglish: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

verses.textGeez:
አድኅነኒ ፡ ወባልሐኒ ፡ እምእዲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ነኪር 
እለ ፡ ከንቶ ፡ ነበበ ፡ አፉሆሙ ።
ወየማኖሙኒ ፡ የማነ ፡ ዐመፃ ።
verses.textEnglish: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

verses.textGeez: እለ ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተክል ፡ ሐዲስ ፡ ጽኑዓን ፡ በውርዙቶሙ
verses.textEnglish: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

verses.textGeez: ወአዋልዲሆሙኒ ፡ ርሱያት ፡ ወስርግዋት ፡ ከመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ጽርሕ ።
verses.textEnglish: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

verses.textGeez: ወአብያቲሆሙኒ ፡ ምሉእ ፡ወይሰወጥ ፡ እምዝ ፡ ውስተዝ
verses.textEnglish: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወአባግዒሆሙኒ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ ይትዋለዱ ፡ወይትባዝኃ ፡ በሙፋሪሆን ።
ወአልህምቲሆሙኒ ፡ ሥቡሓን
verses.textEnglish: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
ወአልቦ ፡ ድቀተ ፡ ለቅጽሮሙ ፡ወአልቦ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ያበውእዎሙ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ዐውያተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

verses.textGeez:
አስተብፅዕዎ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ሕዝብ 
ብፁዕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፭ - ኣሌዕለከ ፡ ንጉሥየ ፡ ወአምላኪየ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 145 - Put Not Your Trust in Princes
psalms.heading: አኰቴት ፡ መዝሙር ፡ ዘዳዊት ።

verses.textGeez:
ኣሌዕለከ ፡ ንጉሥየ ፡ ወአምላኪየ 
ወእባርክ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ኵሎ ፡ አሚረ ፡ እባርከከ 
ወእሴብሕ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወብዙኅ ፡ አኰቴቱ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ጽንፈ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ዚአሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.textGeez:
ትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ ይንእዱ ፡ ምግባሪከ 
ወይዜንዉ ፡ ኀይለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

verses.textGeez:
ወይነግሩ ፡ ዕበየ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ቅዱሳቲከ 
ወያየድዑ ፡ መንክረከ ።
verses.textEnglish: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

verses.textGeez:
ወይብሉ ፡ ግሩም ፡ ኀይልከ 
ወይነግሩ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ግርማከ 
ወያየድዑ ፡ ጽንዐከ ።
verses.textEnglish: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

verses.textGeez:
ወይጐሥዑ ፡ ተዝካረ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ምሕረትከ 
ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ በጽድቅከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

verses.textGeez:
መሓሪ ፡ ወመስተሣህል ፡ እግዚአብሔር 
ርሑቀ ፡ መዐት ፡ ወብዙኀ ፡ ምሕረት ፡ ወጻድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

verses.textGeez:
ኄር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይትዔገስዎ 
ወሣህሉ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተግባሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.textGeez:
ይገንዩ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተግባርከ 
ወይባርኩከ ፡ ጻድቃኒከ ።
verses.textEnglish: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

verses.textGeez:
ስብሐት ፡ ይብሉ ፡ ለመንግሥትከ 
ወይነግሩ ፡ ኀይለከ ።
verses.textEnglish: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይንግርዎሙ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ኀይለከ 
ወዕበየ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ መንግሥትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

verses.textGeez:
መንግሥትከሰ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ዘለኵሉ ፡ ዓለም 
ወምኵናኒከኒ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

verses.textGeez:
ምእመን ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ቃሉ 
ወጽድቅ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምግባሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

verses.textGeez:
ያሰውቆሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተንተኑ 
ወያነሥኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ወድቁ ።
verses.textEnglish: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

verses.textGeez:
ዐይነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ይሴፎ ፡ ኪያከ 
ወአንተ ፡ ትሁቦመ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ በጊዜሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.textGeez: ተሰፍሕ ፡ የማነከ ወታጸግብ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ እንስሳ ፡ ዘበሥርዐትከ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

verses.textGeez:
ጻድቅ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍናዊሁ 
ወኄር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ምግባሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

verses.textGeez:
ቅሩብ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼውዕዎ 
ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼውዕዎ ፡ በጽድቅ ።
verses.textEnglish: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.textGeez:
ይገብር ፡ ፈቃዶሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ 
ወይሰምዖሙ ፡ ጸሎቶሙ ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

verses.textGeez:
የዐቅቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ 
ወይሤርዎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.textGeez:
ስብሐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይነግር ፡ አፉየ 
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘሥጋ ፡ ይባርክ ፡ ለስሙ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡
ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
verses.textEnglish: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፮ - ታአኵቶ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 146 - He Heals the Brokenhearted
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ፡ ዘሐጌ ፡ ወዘካርያስ ።

verses.textGeez:
ታአኵቶ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
እሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በሕይወትየ 
ወእዜምር ፡ ለአምላኪየ ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ሀለውኩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

verses.textGeez:
ኢትትአመኑ ፡ በመላእክት 
ወኢበእጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ እለ ፡ ኢይክሉ ፡ አድኅኖ ።
verses.textEnglish: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

verses.textGeez:
ትወፅእ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ ወይገብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሬቶሙ 
ውእተ ፡ አሚረ ፡ ይጠፍእ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምክሮሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

verses.textGeez:
ብፁዕ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘአምላከ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ረዳኢሁ 
ወትውክልቱኒ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ።
ዘገብረ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘውስቴታ
verses.textEnglish: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

verses.textGeez:
ዘየዐቅባ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ ለዓለም ።ወይፈትሕ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ለግፉዓን ፡
ዘይሁቦሙ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ ለርኁባን
verses.textEnglish: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ይፈትሖሙ ፡ ለሙቁሓን ።እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያነሥኦሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ወድቁ
verses.textEnglish: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

verses.textGeez: እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያጠብቦሙ ፡ ለዕዉራን እግዚአብሔር ፡ ያፍቅሮሙ ፡ ለጻድቃን ።
verses.textEnglish: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:

verses.textGeez:
እግዚአብሔር ፡ የዐቅቦሙ ፡ ለፈላስያን ፡
ወይትወከፎሙ ፡ ለአቤራት ፡ ወለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ 
ወያመስን ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ኃጥኣን ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

verses.textGeez:
ይነግሥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዓለም 
አምላክኪ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፯ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ መዝሙር
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 147 - Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ መዝሙር 
ወለአምላክነ ፡ ሐዋዝ ፡ ሰብሖ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

verses.textGeez:
የሐንጻ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም 
ወያስተጋብእ ፡ ዝርወቶሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይፌውሶሙ ፡ ለቍሱላነ ፡ ልብ 
ወይፀምም ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ቍስሎሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይኌልቆሙ ፡ ለከዋክብት ፡ በምልኦሙ 
ወይጼውዖሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ በበአስማቲሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

verses.textGeez:
ዐቢይ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዐቢይ ፡ ኀይሉ 
ወአልቦ ፡ ኍልቆ ፡ ጥበቢሁ ።
verses.textEnglish: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

verses.textGeez:
ያነሥኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለየዋሃን 
ወያኀስሮሙ ፡ ለኃጥኣን ፡ እስከ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በአሚን 
ወዘምሩ ፡ ለአምላክነ ፡ በመሰንቆ ።
verses.textEnglish: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

verses.textGeez:
ዘይገለብቦ ፡ ለሰማይ ፡ በደመና ፡
ወያስተዴሉ ፡ ክረምተ ፡ ለምድር
verses.textEnglish: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

verses.textGeez: ዘያበቍል ፡ ሣዕረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አድባር ፡ወኀመልማል ፡ ለቅኔ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ።
verses.textEnglish: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

verses.textGeez:
ዘይሁቦሙ ፡ ሲሳዮሙ ፡ ለእንስሳ 
ወለእጕለ ፡ ቋዓት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼውዕዎ ።
verses.textEnglish: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.textGeez:
ኢይፈቅድ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ፈረስ 
ወኢይሠምር ፡ በአቍያጸ ፡ ብእሲ ።
verses.textEnglish: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

verses.textGeez:
ይሠምር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእለ ፡ ይፈርህዎ 
ወበኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትዌከሉ ፡ በምሕረቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፰ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምሰማያት
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 148 - Praise the Lord from the Heavens
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ፡ ዘሐጌ ፡ ወዘዘካርያስ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምሰማያት 
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ በአርያም ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

verses.textGeez:
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ መላእክቲሁ 
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ኀይሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

verses.textGeez:
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ ወወርኅ 
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ከዋክብት ፡ ወብርሃን ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

verses.textGeez:
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ሰማያተ ፡ ሰማያት 
ወማይኒ ፡ ዘመልዕልተ ፡ ሰማያት ።
ይሴብሕዎ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
verses.textEnglish: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

verses.textGeez: እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ወኮኑ ፡ወውእቱ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ወተፈጥሩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.textGeez:
ወአቀሞሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም 
ትእዛዘ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ወኢኀለፉ ።
verses.textEnglish: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምድር 
አክይስትኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ቀላያት ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

verses.textGeez:
እሳት ፡ ወበረድ ፡ አስሐትያ ፡ ወሐመዳ 
መንፈሰ ፡ ዐውሎ ፡ ዘይገብር ፡ ነቢቦ ።
verses.textEnglish: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.textGeez:
አድባርኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አውግር 
ዕፀውኒ ፡ ዘይፈሪ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አርዝ ።
verses.textEnglish: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.textGeez:
አራዊትኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ እንስሳ 
ዘይትሐወስኒ ፡ ወአዕዋፍ ፡ ዘይሠርር ።
verses.textEnglish: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

verses.textGeez:
ነገሥተ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ 
መላእክትኒ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.textEnglish: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.textGeez:
ወራዙትኒ ፡ ወደናግል 
ሊቃናትኒ ፡ ወመሐዛት ።
ይሰብሑ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
እስመ ፡ ተለዐለ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ለባሕቲቱ
verses.textEnglish: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

verses.textGeez: ይገንዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ በሰማይ ፡ ወበምድር ።ወያሌዕል ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ሕዝቡ ፡
verses.textEnglish: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

verses.textGeez: ወስብሐተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘቅሩብ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፵፱ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 149 - Sing to the Lord a New Song
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ስብሐተ ፡ ሐዲሰ 
ስብሐቲሁ ፡ በማኅበረ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

verses.textGeez:
ይትፌሣሕ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በፈጣሪሁ 
ወደቂቀ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ይትሐሠዩ ፡ በንጉሦሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.textGeez:
ወይሴብሑ ፡ ለስሙ ፡ በትፍሥሕት 
በከብሮ ፡ ወበመዝሙር ፡ ይዜምሩ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

verses.textGeez:
እስመ ፡ ሠምረ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በሕዝብ 
ወያሌዕሎሙ ፡ ለየዋሃን ፡ በአድኅኖቱ ።
verses.textEnglish: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

verses.textGeez:
ይትሜክሑ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ በክብሩ 
ወይትሐሠዩ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምስካቢሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

verses.textGeez:
ወያሌዕልዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በጐራዒቶሙ 
ሰይፍ ፡ ዘክልኤ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ።
verses.textEnglish: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ በቀለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ 
ወከመ ፡ ይዛለፎሙ ፡ ለአሕዛብ ።
verses.textEnglish: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይእሥሮሙ ፡ ለነገሥቶሙ ፡ በመዋቅሕት 
ወለክቡራኒሆሙኒ ፡ በእደ ፡ ሰናስለ ፡ ኀጺን ።
verses.textEnglish: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.textGeez:
ከመ ፡ ይግብር ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ዘጽሑፍ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡
ክብር ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ጻድቃኑ ።
verses.textEnglish: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፶ - ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በቅዱሳኑ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 150 - Let Everything That Has Breath Praise the Lord
psalms.heading: ሀሌሉያ ።

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ በቅዱሳኑ 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በጽንዐ ፡ ኀይሉ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በክሂሎቱ 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በከመ ፡ ብዝኀ ፡ ዕበዩ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በቃለ ፡ ቀርን 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በመዝሙር ፡ ወበመሰንቆ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በከበሮ ፡ ወበትፍሥሕት 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በአውታር ፡ ወበዕንዚራ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

verses.textGeez:
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በጸናጽል ፡ ዘሠናይ ፡ ቃሉ 
ሰብሕዎ ፡ በጸናጽል ፡ ወበይባቤ ።
verses.textEnglish: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

verses.textGeez: ኵሉ ፡ ነፍስ ፡ ይሴብሖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.textEnglish: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.

psalms.titleGeez: ተወሳኪ መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ፻፶፩ - ንኡስ አነ በውስተ አኀውየ
psalms.titleAmharic: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ፻፶፩ (151) - በወንድሞቼ መካከል ታናሽ ነበርሁ
psalms.titleEnglish: Psalm 151 - I Was Small Among My Brothers (Orthodox Canon)
psalms.heading: ተወሳኪ መዝሙር ዘዳዊት ውእቱ።

verses.textGeez: ንኡስ አነ በውስተ አኀውየ፤ ወወሬዛ በቤተ አቡየ፤ እሬዒ አባግዐ አቡየ።
verses.textAmharic: በወንድሞቼ መካከል ታናሽ ነበርሁ፥ በአባቴም ቤት ብላቴና ነበርሁ፤ የአባቴን በጎች እጠብቅ ነበር።
verses.textEnglish: I was small among my brothers, and the youngest in my father's house; I tended my father's sheep.

verses.textGeez: እደውየ ገብራ መዝሙረ፤ ወአጻብዕየ አስተጋብኣ መሰንቆ።
verses.textAmharic: እጆቼ መዝሙርን ሠሩ፥ ጣቶቼም መሰንቆን አዘጋጁ።
verses.textEnglish: My hands made an instrument, and my fingers shaped a lyre.

verses.textGeez: ወመኑ ይነግሮ ለእግዚእየ፤ ውእቱ እግዚእ ኵሎ ይሰምዕ ወውእቱ ይስምዐኒ።
verses.textAmharic: ለጌታዬ ማን ይነግረዋል? እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ይሰማል እርሱም ሰማኝ።
verses.textEnglish: And who shall tell my Lord? The Lord Himself, He hears all and He heard me.

verses.textGeez: ውእቱ ፈነወ መልአኮ፤ ወአንሥአኒ እምአባግዐ አቡየ፤ ወቀብአኒ ቅብአ ቅዱሰ ዘመንግሥቱ።
verses.textAmharic: እርሱ መልአኩን ላከ፤ ከአባቴም በጎች ዘንድ አነሣኝ፥ የቅድስናውንም ዘይት ቀባኝ።
verses.textEnglish: He sent His angel and took me from my father's sheep, and anointed me with the oil of His anointing.

verses.textGeez: አኀውየሰ ሠናያን ወዐበይት፤ ወኢሠምረ ቦሙ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.textAmharic: ወንድሞቼ ያማሩና ታላላቆች ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን በእነርሱ ደስ አላለውም።
verses.textEnglish: My brothers were handsome and tall, but the Lord took no pleasure in them.

verses.textGeez: ወወፃእኩ ከመ እትቀበሎ ለኢሎፍላዊ፤ ወረገመኒ በጣዖታቲሁ።
verses.textAmharic: ፍልስጥኤማዊውን ለመገናኘት ወጣሁ፤ እርሱም በጣዖቶቹ ረገመኝ።
verses.textEnglish: I went out to meet the Philistine, and he cursed me by his idols.

verses.textGeez: ወአነሰ መዘዝኩ ሰይፎ ዘውእቱ ኀቤሁ፤ ወመተርኩ ርእሶ።
verses.textAmharic: እኔ ግን የእርሱን ሰይፍ ከእርሱ መዘዝሁ፥ ራሱንም ቆረጥሁ።
verses.textEnglish: But I drew his own sword and beheaded him with it.

verses.textGeez: ወአሰሰልኩ ዕዳ እምደቂቀ እስራኤል፤ ወተፈሥሑ ኵሎሙ ሕዝብ።
verses.textAmharic: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ስድብን አራቅሁ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው።
verses.textEnglish: And removed the reproach from the children of Israel, and all the people rejoiced.
